scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Hello!
Now ^4d4dffthe palace is hosting a banquet for the returning heroes from Vacuum^000000.
Please tell me ^4d4dffwhere the heroes who have participated in the expedition are^000000 if you know any.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
您好！
现在^4d4dff宫殿正在为从Vacuum归来的英雄们举办宴会^000000。
如果您知道^4d4dff参与远征的英雄们在哪里^000000，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I wonder where they are. They are so scattered that it is difficult to locate each one of them. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
不知道他们在哪里。他们太分散了，很难找到每一个人。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Oh, wait. You are...
{0}, right?
Let's see.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
哦，等等。你是...
{0}，对吧？
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I am right. You look exactly the same as the montage from the guild. Hahahaha!
My eyes are doing what they are supposed to do now, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
没错。你看起来和公会里的照片一模一样。哈哈哈！
看来我的眼睛终于正常工作了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
It is difficult to find the freelance adventurers who don't belong to the military.
It was very difficult to find you since you are not bound to anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
寻找那些不属于军队的自由冒险者很困难。
因为你没有隶属于任何地方，所以找到你非常困难。

scripts.text: May I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Help? Sure thing!
You know that there is a banquet taking place in celebration of subjugating Morocc.
An invitation has been issued for you. But it was just impossible to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
帮忙？当然没问题！
你知道为了庆祝击败Morocc，正在举办一场宴会。
已经为你发出了邀请函。但之前一直没能找到你。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I am sure that all the Royal Messengers of the city must be looking for with the portrait of you.
Hey, since we don't have enough time, please take this invitation for you.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
我相信城里所有的皇家信使都在拿着你的画像寻找你。
嘿，既然时间紧迫，请收下这张给你的邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
You must attend the banquet. Do you understand? ^4d4dffYou've been invited as a special guest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你必须参加宴会。明白吗？^4d4dff你是作为特邀嘉宾被邀请的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
The people in the palace will fill you up with the details.
I am just a messenger after all.
Although the banquet will be held for quite a while, don't take too much time to get there.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
宫殿里的人会向你详细介绍详情。
毕竟我只是个信使。
虽然宴会会持续相当长的时间，但请不要花太多时间赶路。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Make sure to bring the invitation with you. Don't forget!
Why don't you go right now? ^4d4dffI can teleport you there now if you want^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
记得带上邀请函。别忘了！
为什么不现在就去呢？^4d4dff如果你愿意，我现在就可以瞬间移动你过去^000000。

scripts.text: I'll go on my own.
scripts.translation: 我自己去

scripts.text: I'll go right away.
scripts.translation: 我马上就去

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
You can visit the Prontera Palace.
You may show the invitation to the guard at the gate or
A servant in charge of the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你可以前往普隆德拉宫殿。
你可以向门口的卫兵或
负责宴会的侍从出示邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Since I have delivered the invitation to you, I shall wait for another one.
I hope you have a good time there, dear hero.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
既然我已经把邀请函交给你了，我就去等下一位了。
祝你在那里玩得开心，亲爱的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
让我马上瞬间移动你过去。
到达后，会有接待的侍从。届时你可以出示邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Why are you still here?
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你为什么还在这里？
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Send me to the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 送我去宴会厅

scripts.text: I have lost the invitation.
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了邀请函

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
What a shame! What happened?
Well, since the message that you'll be there has already been sent there,
You may not really need the invitation anyways.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
真遗憾！发生什么事了？
不过，既然已经通知那边你会到场，
你可能根本不需要邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
When you go to the palace, the servant in charge will recognize you.
Don't worry, and you may go to the palace now.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
当你去宫殿时，负责接待的侍从会认出你。
别担心，你现在就可以去宫殿了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Eh? What is that you have in your pocket? It looks like an invitation to me.
I may have a tiny set of eyes, but I wouldn't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
咦？你口袋里拿的是什么？看起来像是邀请函。
虽然我眼睛小，但不会看走眼的。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Since you have found your invitation, let's get going! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
既然你找到了邀请函，那就出发吧！哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
让我马上瞬间移动你过去。
到达后，会有接待的侍从。届时你可以出示邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I have heard that you have attended the banquet safely.
I need to find the others and send them to the banquet as well.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
我听说你安全地参加了宴会。
我需要找到其他人，并送他们去宴会。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Here comes the hero!
The Banquet Hall is inside the palace. You may follow the passage to get there.
Let me send a message for the Chamberlain to find you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
英雄来了！
宴会厅在宫殿内部。你可以沿着走廊过去。
让我通知侍从长来找你。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
You must be Sir {0}... Am I right?
You are here at last.
I've been waiting for you.
I am glad that the invitation have found you in time.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长 贝尔]
您一定是{0}大人……没错吧？
您终于来了。
我一直在等您。
很高兴邀请函及时找到了您。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I am Chamberlain Bell Twilight. I will be at your service during your stay at the palace.
You can call me Belle.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我是侍从长贝尔·特威莱特。在您逗留宫殿期间，我将为您服务。
您可以叫我贝尔。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
{0} since you have been invited as a special guest here, a separate guest room is prepared for you.
You may go upstairs and walk ^4d4dffstraight to the left corridor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
{0}，既然您被邀请为特别嘉宾，已为您准备了单独的客房。
您可以上楼，然后^4d4dff一直向左走^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me go ahead and mall all the preparations.
Come with me, please.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
让我先去安排所有的准备工作。
请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
The special guestroom is prepared this way.
It is the ^4d4dfffirst room^000000 you'll see in there.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长 贝尔]
特别客房已经准备好了。
就是里面的^4d4dff第一间房^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
Let me tell you the story in detail after moving into the room.
Come this way.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长 贝尔]
让我在您入住后详细告诉您故事。
请这边走。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
Let me tell you about the detailed schedule inside.
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长 贝尔]
让我进去后告诉您详细的日程安排。
我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
I'll be waiting for you here in this room at all times.
You may find me when you need a help.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长 贝尔]
我会一直在这里等您。
如果您需要帮助，随时可以找我。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This is the guest room for the officially invited guest.
Since this place forbids the access of outsiders, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是正式受邀嘉宾的客房。
由于此处禁止外人进入，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You must have come a long way here. Thank you.
Since you are a special guest, you have been assigned with a room in the royal villa.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您一定走了很远的路才到这里。谢谢。
既然您是特别嘉宾，已为您分配了皇家别墅的房间。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I'll tell you about the schedule at all times. You can ask me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我会随时告诉您日程安排。您可以随时问我。

scripts.text: What do you mean by the special guest?
scripts.translation: 什么是特别嘉宾？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The banquet hosted by the palace is to celebrate the return of the expedition and cherish their hard work...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
宫殿举办的宴会是为了庆祝远征归来，并珍惜他们的辛勤工作……

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, more importantly, it is to fulfill the Royal Assembly.
The candidates for the throne have been evaluated before.
And heir to the throne will be determined.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
然而，更重要的是，这是为了履行皇家议会。
王位候选人之前已经接受了评估。
王位继承人将被确定。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There is a secret ritual passed down in the palace, which is held before the official coronation. The heir will be named the king upon passing the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
宫殿中有一个秘密仪式，在正式加冕前举行。继承人通过仪式后将被命名为国王。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Unless the heavens fall, the ritual will be finished safely, and Rune-Midgarts will meet the new king.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
除非天塌下来，否则仪式会顺利结束，卢恩·米德加兹将迎来新的国王。

scripts.text: What's it got to do with me?
scripts.translation: 这跟我有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I have told you just before.
There is a ritual to be held after the final decision.
You have been invited as an observer to the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我刚才已经告诉过您了。
最终决定之后会举行一场仪式。
您被邀请作为观察者参加这场仪式。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
It is the secret ritual of the palace to designate the king for the eternal glory of the seven royal families.
So that our new king is acknowledged by all the people of this land.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是宫殿的秘密仪式，旨在为七大皇族带来永恒的荣耀，并确立国王。
这样，我们的新国王就能得到这片土地上所有人的认可。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, since special evaluation is allowed by the Royal Assembly,
It has been decided to select a personnel recommended by each guild
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
不过，由于皇家议会允许特别评估，
已决定从各公会推荐的人员中挑选一名

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Or a hero who made a great contribution in the expedition as the observer of this ritual.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
或者在远征中做出巨大贡献的英雄，作为本次仪式的观察者。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Consequently, you have been assigned. I have heard that you were recommended unanimously.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
因此，您被指派了。我听说您是全票推荐当选的。

scripts.text: When will the ritual take place?
scripts.translation: 仪式什么时候举行？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
As far as I know, it is supposed to be in the final stage.
Since the late king passed away all of a sudden, the palace has been in a state of disorder.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
据我所知，目前正处于最后阶段。
由于先王突然驾崩，宫殿一直处于混乱状态。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Fortunately, Rune-Midgarts is supported by the seven royal families.
It is the time to welcome our new king.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
幸运的是，卢恩·米德加兹有七大皇族的支持。
是时候迎接我们的新国王了。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Since you are invited as the observer,
You need to visit each facility and exchange greetings before attending the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
既然您被邀请作为观察者，
在参加宴会之前，您需要拜访各个设施并交换问候。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This royal villa happens to be the place where the people from each family stays when they come to the capital. All other rooms except this one are occupied by other families.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这座皇家别墅恰好是各皇族成员来到首都时的住所。除了这里，其他房间都被其他家族占用了。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
They must have heard the news of your arrival by now.
How about ^4d4dffvisiting the Heine family near here^000000?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
他们现在一定已经听到您到达的消息了。
要不要去拜访一下附近的^4d4dff海尔内家族^000000？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
In the west villa, I mean, where we are now,
There are the residences for Heine, Nerius and Walther.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
在西边的别墅，也就是我们现在所在的地方，
有海尔内、内里乌斯和瓦尔特家族的住所。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
In the east across the corridor, there are residences for Wigner, Richard, Geoborg and Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
在走廊对面的东边，有维格纳、理查德、乔博格和罗根堡家族的住所。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You need to exchange greetings with the members of each families so make sure to visit them all.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您需要与各家族的成员交换问候，所以请务必拜访他们所有人。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The news of your arrival must have reached each family by now.
They must be waiting. Pay a visit and exchange greetings.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您到达的消息现在一定已经传到了各个家族。
他们一定在等着。请去拜访并交换问候。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You have not visited the
{0}
family yet.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您还没有拜访
{0}
家族。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
They are the most blue-blooded people, not used to be kept waiting.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
他们是血统最纯正的人，不习惯被人让等。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
In order to keep a smooth relationship with them, you may to there quickly.
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
为了与他们保持顺畅的关系，您最好快点过去。
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Oh, you are back.
The assembly seems to take some time.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
哦，你回来了。
看来集会花了不少时间。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Since you have some time to spare, why don't you go enjoy the banquet in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
既然你有空闲时间，不妨去宴会厅享受一下宴会吧。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The ^4d4dffladies of the Nerius family have just asked to see you in the Banquet Hall^000000 .
{0}, you must have made a good impression.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
^4d4dff内里乌斯家族的女士们刚刚请求在宴会厅见你^000000。
{0}，看来你给她们留下了很好的印象。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
到时候，宫廷魔法师会来引导你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴会。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
And this is some sort of reward which has been sent to you as a token of gratitude...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这些是作为感谢的礼物寄给你的...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You can collect them and exchange with useful items.
You may get more in return for your help around the palace.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
你可以收集它们并兑换成有用的物品。
如果你在宫殿周围帮忙，可能会得到更多回报。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There must be someone ^4d4dffnear the Crusader's Office who would exchange^000000 them.
If you have some time, pay a visit.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
^4d4dff十字军办事处附近应该有人可以兑换^000000。
如果你有时间，不妨去拜访一下。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
到时候，宫廷魔法师会来引导你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴会。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
如果你去宴会厅，^4d4dff一定要找到内里乌斯家族的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
到时候，宫廷魔法师会来引导你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴会。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
如果你去宴会厅，^4d4dff一定要找到内里乌斯家族的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Oh, how was the banquet?
The banquet is supposed to last long since it is held to welcome all the returning heroes from Ash-Vacuum...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
哦，宴会怎么样？
宴会通常持续很久，因为它是为了欢迎所有从阿什-真空回来的英雄们...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
By the way, the Court Mage has visited just before.
The Court Magician will be back soon after visiting other families.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
顺便说一下，宫廷魔法师刚才来过。
宫廷魔法师在拜访其他家族后很快就会回来。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There... Is the magician.
The Court Mage will give you the details.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
那里...就是魔法师。
宫廷魔法师会给你详细说明。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You are back.
There has been a message for you.
It says 'There will be an important meeting. Please wait until then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
你回来了。
有一封给你的消息。
上面写着“将有一个重要会议。请等到那时。”

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You will be notified as soon as everything is settled.
Please enjoy the banquet until then.'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
“一切安排妥当后，我们会立即通知你。
在那之前，请享受宴会。”

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This is about it.
Apart from it, well, I am not supposed to be curious about this kind of things...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
大概就是这样。
除此之外，嗯，我不应该对这类事情感到好奇...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, ^4d4dffI saw the court doctors and priests moving fast to the Heine family^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
不过，^4d4dff我看到宫廷医生和牧师匆忙赶往海尔内家族^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
They seemed to be in a hurry. Do you know what has happened?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
他们看起来很着急。你知道发生了什么吗？

scripts.text: This is a difficult question for me to answer...
scripts.translation: 这个问题对我来说很难回答...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I am sorry that I asked.
Well, there is one more news.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
抱歉问了这个问题。
嗯，还有一条新闻。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The lady of the ^4d4dffNerius^000000 family has invited you to have a cup of tea with her.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
^4d4dff内里乌斯^000000家族的女士邀请你去和她喝杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
She asked me to let her know as soon as you come. Shall I send her a message now?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
她让我一看到你过来就通知她。我现在给她发消息吗？

scripts.text: I'll visit her now.
scripts.translation: 我现在就去拜访她。

scripts.text: I'll visit her later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再去拜访她。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您准备好了请告诉我。
到时我会给她发消息。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我现在就给她发消息。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Would you accept the invitation from the Nerius family now?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您现在要接受内里乌斯家族的邀请吗？

scripts.text: I'll visit her now.
scripts.translation: 我现在就去拜访她。

scripts.text: I'll visit her later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再去拜访她。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您准备好了请告诉我。
到时我会给她发消息。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我现在就给她发消息。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The Nerius family stays in the second room from this room.
The room next to the room of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
内里乌斯家族住在离这里第二间的房间里。
就在海尔内家族房间的隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I have sent the message that you would visit them soon. You may go there anytime.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
我已经通知他们您很快就会过去。您可以随时前往。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There has been a request from the Heine family to meet you.
They asked you to visit the Heine family as soon as you come back.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
海尔内家族请求与您见面。
他们希望您回来后立即拜访他们。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Oh, you are back!
Let me call the Mage.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
哦，您回来了！
我去叫那位魔法师。

scripts.text: What is that about?
scripts.translation: 那是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Court Mage Nillem opened the door and left right away.
Saying, 'Where are you?' {0} The magician must be looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
宫廷魔法师尼勒姆开了门就立刻离开了。
他说：“你在哪里？” {0} 那位魔法师一定是在找您。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
I am at your service.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
我随时为您效劳。

scripts.text: Call Nillem
scripts.translation: 叫尼勒姆

scripts.text: What is the next thing on the schedule?
scripts.translation: 日程上接下来是什么？

scripts.text: Please prepare some refreshments.
scripts.translation: 请准备一些点心。

scripts.text: Call Convenience Service
scripts.translation: 呼叫便利服务

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Shall I call the Court Mage for you?
Wait a second.
I have just sent a message. The magician will arrive here soon.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
需要我为您叫宫廷魔法师吗？
请稍等。
我刚发了消息，那位魔法师很快就会到。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There is no special invitation for today.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
今天没有特别的邀请。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here are some chamomile tea and ginger cookies. They will help you take a rest and get recovered from fatigue.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是洋甘菊茶和姜饼。它们能帮助您休息并恢复疲劳。
您喜欢吗？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You seemed hungry, so I have prepared some afternoon tea, scones and clotted cream.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
看您似乎饿了，所以我准备了一些下午茶、司康饼和凝脂奶油。
您喜欢吗？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here are some chocolate and cinnamon-flavored rooibos tea for refreshment.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是巧克力肉桂风味的路易波士茶，供您提神。
您喜欢吗？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here is some strong mint tea mixed with milk and chocolate chips. A great after-meal treat.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是混合了牛奶和巧克力豆的浓郁薄荷茶。是餐后甜点的好选择。
您喜欢吗？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here is some cold milk with citron jelly and cream. It is a sweet and sour drink.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
这是加了柠檬果冻和奶油的冰牛奶。是一款酸甜口味的饮品。
您喜欢吗？

scripts.text: ^4d4dff All HP and SP are recovered!
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff 所有HP和SP已恢复！

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Which service should I call for you?
All calls are available, but additional charge may apply to each service.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
需要为您呼叫哪项服务？
所有服务均可呼叫，但每项服务可能会产生额外费用。

scripts.text: Kafra
scripts.translation: 卡普拉

scripts.text: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.translation: 巨兽管理员

scripts.text: No need.
scripts.translation: 不需要

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You want the Kafra Service.
Let me make a call right away.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您需要卡普拉服务。
我这就为您呼叫。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You need a Giant Beast Manager.
Let me make a call right away.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
您需要巨兽管理员。
我这就为您呼叫。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔]
明白了。

scripts.text: I am managing the Dragons and Griffons for the Rune Knights and Royal Guards.
scripts.translation: 我负责管理卢恩骑士和皇家卫士的龙和狮鹫。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you for calling me. Shall I bring a {0} for you?
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
感谢您的呼叫。需要为您带一只{0}吗？

scripts.text: Use
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
明白了。那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a {0} first.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您需要先学会如何骑乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您已经在骑乘{0}了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already riding something else.
You need to take off the ride to ride a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您正在骑乘其他生物。
您需要先下马，才能骑乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello. This is Kafra Service.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好。这里是卡普拉服务。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Use Cargo Service
scripts.translation: 使用货运服务

scripts.text: Use Cart Service
scripts.translation: 使用手推车服务

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, dear customer.
You need to raise the novice skill level to 6 or higher to use the cargo service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，亲爱的顾客。
您需要将初心者技能等级提升至6级或以上，才能使用货运服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You don't have enough money.
The Cargo Service costs 50 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您的资金不足。
货运服务需要50 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let me open the warehouse for you.
Thank you for using Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
让我为您打开仓库。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry,
The Cart Service is available for Merchant classes only.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，
手推车服务仅限商人职业使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You are already equipped with a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您已经装备了手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can use the cart after learning the 'Push Cart' skill.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
学习“手推车”技能后，您才能使用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.
Would you use it?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
手推车服务需要800 Zeny。
您确定要使用吗？

scripts.text: Use
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You don't have enough money, dear customer.
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，亲爱的顾客，您的资金不足。
手推车服务需要800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using Kafra Service as always.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
感谢您一如既往地支持卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, it's you, darling! I've been waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，是你呀，亲爱的！我一直在等你呢！

scripts.text: Darling...
scripts.translation: 亲爱的...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, I am sorry that I was overly excited.
Exploring through the fissure of dimensions to uncover the secret of the palace...!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
啊，抱歉我太激动了。
探索维度裂缝，揭开宫殿的秘密...！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
No mage would say no to that! No wonder I am excited!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
没有哪个魔法师会拒绝这样的机会！难怪我会这么兴奋！

scripts.text: By the way, why did you choose me?
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，你为什么选我？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, because a royalty is picky and useless...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，因为皇室成员既挑剔又没用...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
See, the current head of the family and the heir are not supposed to do anything dangerous.
So are the heirs to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看，现任家主和继承人都不应该从事任何危险的工作。
王位继承人也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Did you see Peter in bed?
......No harm should be done to him, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到彼得躺在床上吗？
......你知道的，不能让他受到任何伤害。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Not this, not that... After removing all those things, there aren't many left for the aristocrats other than paper work and socializing.
What can they do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这个不行，那个也不行...排除掉所有那些事情后，贵族们剩下的就只有文书工作和社交应酬了。
他们还能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Moreover, it doesn't suit me to take care of them. Hahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
而且，照顾他们也不适合我。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: And, why are you working as a Court Mage.
scripts.translation: 那么，你为什么要在宫廷当魔法师呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
For the stability and high income-
The palace has paid the tuition during my study in Eclage as well! How generous!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
为了稳定和高薪——
我在埃克拉珠学习期间的学费也是由宫殿支付的！多么慷慨啊！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Ahem. Anyways, it has all been prepared.
Since the distortion appeared in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, I installed the gate there.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
咳。总之，一切都已经准备好了。
既然王室的过去记忆中出现了扭曲，我就在那里设置了传送门。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
From now on, you can ^4d4dffcome to the Past Memories of the Royal Family right away^000000, or...
Right. Let me give you the ^4d4dffmillion Nillem call ticket^000000.
My treat!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
从现在开始，你可以^4d4dff直接前往王室的过去记忆^000000，或者...
对了，给你一张^4d4dff百万尼勒姆召唤券^000000。
我请客！

scripts.text: The... Million Nillem call ticket?
scripts.translation: 那...百万尼勒姆召唤券？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes. You can call me anytime via this Chamberlain here if you wan to see me!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
是的。如果你想见我，随时可以通过这位侍从长召唤我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll be here immediately like a flash of lightning-
Well, then, shall we get going?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我会像闪电一样立刻赶到——
那么，我们要出发了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go now!
scripts.translation: 现在就走！

scripts.text: I need to make some preparations.
scripts.translation: 我需要做一些准备。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, let me know when you are ready.
If I don't show up, come to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 right away.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，准备好了告诉我。
如果我没出现，请立刻前往^4d4dff王室的过去记忆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
You know how to get there.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你知道怎么去的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, close your eyes...
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，闭上眼睛...
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, then, let's go to the Past Memories of the Royal Family!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，那么，让我们去王室的过去记忆吧！

scripts.text: Move to the Past Memories of the Royal Family
scripts.translation: 前往王室的过去记忆

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I like how you refuse so flatly
May I hang out here for a while since I am already here?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我喜欢你如此干脆地拒绝。
既然我已经在这里了，可以让我在这里待一会儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, close your eyes...
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，闭上眼睛...
一！

scripts.text: I hear voices from somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我听到某处传来声音。

scripts.text: I happen to eavesdrop on a fishy conversation.
scripts.translation: 我无意中听到了一段可疑的对话。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I get to see you again. {0}.
Chamberlain must have been a great messenger.
I saw you coming this way right away.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
又能见到你了，{0}。
侍从长一定是个出色的信使。
我立刻就看到你朝这边过来了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was surprised when you were introduced as a special guest. You seem to be more extraordinary than I have thought.
You were introduced as...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
当你被介绍为特别嘉宾时，我有些惊讶。你似乎比我想象的更非凡。
你被介绍为...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But it is true.
This banquet is for the heroes like you.
You should be proud.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
但这是事实。
这场宴会就是为你这样的英雄举办的。
你应该感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That's right!
No one will stop you from hanging out with us. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
没错！
没人会阻止你和我们在一起。请常来拜访我们。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Since there are only us around here, we can loosen up a little...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
既然这里只有我们，稍微放松一点也无妨...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hahaha.... I'll make sure the words don't get out.
Did you hear, Crux?
My sister wants to hang out quietly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈...我会确保这些话不会传出去的。
你听到了吗，克鲁克斯？
我妹妹想安静地待一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I mean, my ladies?
What do you mean by...?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我是说，我的女士们？
您是指...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You know that I am on your side, my lady, right?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
您知道我是站在您这边的，女士，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, don't make me laugh.
I know you have come here to spy on us this time.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
噢，别逗我笑了。
我知道你这次来是为了监视我们。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
No! No, please!
...Oh? Isn't that Lord Heine?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
不！不，请别误会！
...噢？那不是海尔内家的领主吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, you are right? Nyhill! This way!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
噢，你说得对？尼希尔！这边！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You don't have to scream like that, Skia.
{0} is here too.
Indeed, you won't be mistaken when you hang out with the people of the Nerius family.
Good decision.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯基亚，你不用那样大喊大叫。
{0}也在这里。
确实，和内里乌斯家族的人在一起，你不会看错人的。
是个明智的决定。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia and Lord of the Heine family.
Since when did you call each other by the first name?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亚和海尔内家的领主。
你们什么时候开始直呼彼此的名字了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum, we exchanged greetings earlier in the corridor.
The Heine residence is next to that of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯，我们刚才在走廊里打过招呼。
海尔内家的宅邸就在内里乌斯家族宅邸的旁边。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
It was refreshing, and I am grateful to you.
And...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
那让人感觉很清爽，我很感激。
还有...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
{0}, I visited your room to give you my apology, but you had already left for the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}，我去你的房间想向你道歉，但你已经去宴会厅了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Earlier...
I was rude to you out of impulse.
Please forgive me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
刚才...
我一时冲动对你无礼了。
请原谅我。

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Haha... Hahaha... Poor Lord Nyhill, what a pity.
He has not been selected as the heir to the throne...
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的女子]
哈哈...哈哈哈...可怜的尼希尔领主，真可惜。
他没能被选为王位继承人...

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Oh, well! Who are these?
Aren't they the Nerius sisters who are from that famous family led by a woman?
Lord, are you even going to ditch your own household for the Nerius family?
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的女子]
噢，好吧！这些是谁？
难道不是那个由女性领导的名门望族内里乌斯家的姐妹吗？
领主，您难道要抛弃自己的家族，转而投靠内里乌斯家吗？

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
I am not telling a lie. Am I?
You are not welcome in your own family anyway. Why don't you flirt with a lady here to change your life?
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[薇奥莱塔]
我可没有说谎，不是吗？
反正你在自己家族里也不受欢迎。为什么不去和这里的一位女士调调情，改变一下你的生活呢？
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Oh, my! My lord, I didn't know you could get angry.
That's right. You better get angry and show your emotions...
scripts.translation:
[薇奥莱塔]
噢，天哪！我的领主，我没想到您会生气。
没错。您最好生气，表现出您的情绪...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
...I don't know which family you are from, but you need to strop.
If you keep insulting my lady, I won't let it pass.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
...我不知道您出自哪个家族，但您需要停止这种行为。
如果您继续侮辱我的女士，我不会善罢甘休。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hold it, Crux.
You shouldn't regard me on the same level as the coarse thing who doesn't even know what she is talking about.
I don't tend to bear a grudge against the Heine family for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
住手，克鲁克斯。
你不应该把我和一个连自己在说什么都不知道的粗俗之人相提并论。
我不会因为这件事而怨恨海尔内家族。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Isn't it right? Violeta Collette Heine?
I understand your feelings for the lord, but your behavior will just bring disgrace to your family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
是这样吗？薇奥莱塔·科莱特·海尔内？
我理解您对领主的情感，但您的行为只会给您的家族带来耻辱。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You do what you please if you want to damage his reputation.
However, you should keep us, the Nerius family, out of the mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果你想损害他的名声，那就随你便吧。
但是，请不要把内里乌斯家族也卷入这场混乱中。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
That is true.
Violeta. I will let it slide this time. You should get back now.
Or, I'll have to punish you in the name of the family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
确实如此。
薇奥莱塔，这次我就放过你。你最好现在回去。
否则，我将以家族的名义惩罚你。

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Well, I'll get back.
Since things have turned out this way, you better go to join the Nerius family, then! He!
scripts.translation:
[薇奥莱塔]
哼，那我就回去了。
既然事情已经变成这样，你最好去加入内里乌斯家族吧！真是的！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
How does the story go that way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
事情怎么会发展到这一步？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am sorry, I apologize for her bad manners.
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
抱歉，请原谅她的无礼。
......

scripts.text:
[Skia]
You keep saying sorry.
But you didn't do anything wrong, Nyhill.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
你一直在道歉。
但你并没有做错什么，尼希尔。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, Skia. You don't understand.
Whether willing or not, as the head of the family, every fault of the family becomes his burden.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
唉，斯基亚，你不明白。
无论是否情愿，作为家主，家族的一切过错都会成为他的负担。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
She is right. I bear the name of Heine, and I am in the position to take care of every matter which comes with the family.
Whether willing or not...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
她说得对。我背负着海尔内的姓氏，处于必须处理家族一切事务的位置。
无论是否情愿...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Skia, it is the same for you. You sometimes have to become a shadow yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯基亚，对你来说也是如此。有时候，你也必须成为一道影子。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
However, I didn't know you have been treated like that by the members of your own family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不过，我没想到你竟然被自己家族的成员这样对待。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I must have interrupted the joy of the banquet. I should get going.
I hope we get to share more stories sometime.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我一定是打扰了宴会的欢乐气氛了。我该走了。
希望以后有机会能多听听你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Not at all. Let us give you the official invitation next time.
Please don't turn down then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
完全没有打扰。下次我们会给你正式的邀请函。
到时候请不要再拒绝了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
How can I turn down the invitation from the next head of the Nerius family?
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我怎么能拒绝内里乌斯家族下一任家主的邀请呢？
那么...再见。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Hum...
Umm...
Skia, can I take a look at the drink you got?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...哼...
嗯...
斯基亚，我能看看你拿的那杯饮料吗？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And, Crux.
Go dig out the Chamberlain who has given us the drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
还有，克鲁克斯。
去把给我们倒酒的那位侍从长找出来。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
No one can fool my eyes like this.
{0}, you take a look too.
Doesn't something seem strange to you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
没有人能这样欺骗我的眼睛。
{0}，你也来看看。
你不觉得有什么奇怪的地方吗？

scripts.text: Well, you do seem to talk a little casually now...
scripts.translation: 嗯，你现在的说话方式似乎随意了一些...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not used to talk in the formal form.
I tried to be courteous to you since you are a special guest. But I'd rather bite my own tongue than keep talking that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不习惯用那种正式的语气说话。
因为你是特别的客人，所以我试着对你客气一点。但我宁愿咬断自己的舌头，也不愿继续那样说话。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, shaking. He is shaking!
Crux, did you see? Nyhill's steps shook.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
噢，他在发抖！他在发抖！
克鲁克斯，你看到了吗？尼希尔的脚步在颤抖。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The champagne is supposed to be as light as fruit juice.
He must have not been drunk on that.
I think there must be something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
香槟应该像果汁一样轻盈。
他肯定不是被那酒灌醉的。
我觉得一定有什么不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Don't you think something funny is about to happen now?
Oh, how suspicious.
Since it seems suspicious, let's get back now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
你不觉得现在有什么有趣的事情要发生了吗？
噢，真是可疑。
既然觉得可疑，那我们现在就回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Eh? Are you going off like that?
What if he is sick? What if he passes out on the way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
诶？就这样走了吗？
万一他生病了怎么办？万一他在路上晕倒怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If you are curious, you may follow him.
I am well taken care of by Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果你好奇的话，可以跟着他。
克鲁克斯会照顾好我的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, hero?
Would you follow him first?
If I follow him like this, everyone will find me strange.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯，英雄？
你要先跟着他吗？
如果我这样跟上去，大家都会觉得我很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I'll be after you quietly.
Spica never jokes about something like that.
There must be something.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我会悄悄跟在你后面的。
斯皮卡从不开这种玩笑。
一定有什么事。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看来我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
尼希尔一定已经离开宴会厅了。
他应该是去了皇家别墅。我们往那边走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Iwine.
How are you enjoying the banquet?
I am a little nervous since it's my first time to attend a banquet like this...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
艾温。
你享受宴会吗？
这是我第一次参加这样的宴会，所以有点紧张...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Not that I have never been to a banquet...
How can I explain?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
并不是说我以前没参加过宴会...
该怎么说呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You don't have to explain.
It is just a family matter.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你不用解释。
这只是家里的事。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Right.
Please excuse my babbling.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
是的。
请原谅我的唠叨。
对不起。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
尼希尔一定已经离开宴会厅了。
他应该是去了皇家别墅。我们往那边走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Bad things seem to keep happening.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
坏事似乎接二连三地发生。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are here to enjoy the banquet, right?
Have you visit all other families?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你是来享受宴会的，对吧？
你去拜访其他家族了吗？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
It is almost impossible to meet them usually. What a great chance you have to be able to visit them officially.
They are even waiting for you...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
平时几乎不可能见到他们。你能有机会正式拜访他们，真是难得。
他们甚至都在等你...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
What a successful debut to the society!
Do not miss the chance when you have it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
多么成功的社交首秀啊！
有机会就不要错过。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You never know what would happen!
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你永远不知道会发生什么！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hum? You are still here. I thought you went after the lord from the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯？你还在这里。我以为你去跟海尔内家的领主了。

scripts.text: Didn't you go back to your room?
scripts.translation: 你不是回房间了吗？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was just giving my sister a push in the back.
I was curious how Skia would react.
...Aren't you following him?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我只是在背后推了我妹妹一把。
我很好奇斯基亚会怎么反应。
...你没有去跟在他后面吗？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have a hunch that something big is about to happen.
You better go after the lord to make sure he is OK.
I have advised you as so, remember.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我有一种预感，有什么大事要发生了。
你最好去跟领主确认一下他没事。
我刚才已经建议过你了，记得吗。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I don't like how things have been going these days.
...I guess I am about to stop holding it down.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不喜欢最近事情发展的样子。
...我想我快要忍不住了。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't mind me.
I am just a bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
别在意我。
我只是个保镖。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I get to see you again.
The lady has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
又见到你了。
女士一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I am thinking about the order given by the lady.
I need to be apart from her to look into it...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我在思考女士下达的命令。
我需要离开她的身边去调查一下...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Frankly, it makes me feel uneasy leaving her alone.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
说实话，让她一个人待着让我很不安。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not a child, you know.
Or do I remind you of your daughter running along the river bank?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我又不是小孩子。
还是说，你把我当成了在河边奔跑的你女儿？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Daughter?
Hahaha. That is funny.
But you don't look your age to be honest.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
女儿？
哈哈哈哈哈。真有意思。
不过说实话，你看起来不像你的年纪。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You can be attacked by the kids again.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
你随时可能再次被那些孩子袭击。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
He! Who can top you?
You shouldn't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嘿！谁能比得过你？
你不用为我担心。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I guess we won't be able to return to the head house anytime soon.
Well, this actually could be a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
看来我们短时间内回不去主宅了。
嗯，这其实可能是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Who's there?
{0}...?
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...谁在那里？
{0}...？
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Am I drunk?
My head hurts.
...I feel dizzy...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...我喝醉了吗？
我的头好痛。
...我觉得头晕...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
你为什么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Oh... I felt tipsy and asked a chamberlain to guide me to somewhere I can take a rest.
......Umm...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...噢...我有点微醺，让侍从长带我去了一个可以休息的地方。
......嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
He told me it was light champagne...
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
他告诉我那是清淡的香槟...
.....

scripts.text: Has anything happened to you?
scripts.translation: 你发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I don't remember.
I believe there was a guest here...
By the way, what brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我不记得了。
我记得这里有位客人...
顺便问一下，是什么把你带到这里来的？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, it is almost the time, so...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯，时间差不多了，所以...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I see. I guess all the preparation must have been made by now.
I will be damned if I waste more time here.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我明白了。我想所有的准备工作现在应该都做好了。
如果我在这里再浪费时间，我就该被诅咒了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I should get back now.
Phew... Fortunately, my head is clearing up.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我该回去了。
呼...幸好，我的头清醒过来了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Well, then. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
那么，再见。请原谅我的失礼。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Whoa! He is fast.
Well, hero. Shall we get back too?
I'll see you again soon though.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
哇！他动作真快。
好了，英雄，我们也该回去了吧？
我们很快会再见的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
The Court Mage must have arrived by now.
You should go back to your room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
宫廷魔法师应该已经到了。
你该回房间了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Do you want to take a look at the material?
It is still here since I haven't taken it away.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
你想看看那份资料吗？
它还在这里，因为我还没收起来。

scripts.text: The document is the royal record about the Room of Consciousness.
scripts.translation: 这份文件是关于“意识之室”的皇家记录。

scripts.text: There are several blank pages in-between.
scripts.translation: 中间有几页是空白的。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Read the text written above.
Yes, it's here.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
读一下上面写的文字。
是的，就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^4d4dffOnly the ones who know the truth can read this.^000000
See?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
^4d4dff只有知道真相的人才能阅读这段文字。^000000
看到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Considering the time which has passed, there must be no one who knows this truth left now.
In other words, this part will remain a mystery forever.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
考虑到已经过去了这么久，现在应该没有知道这个真相的人了。
换句话说，这部分内容将永远是个谜。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
That's why Archduke Stoltze gave up and left.
Since you have seen this, let me put this back in place.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
这就是为什么大公爵斯托尔茨放弃并离开了。
既然你已经看过了，让我把它放回原处吧。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Oh, you are here.
Archduke Grantz has been waiting for you for a while.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
哦，你来了。
大公爵格兰茨已经等你一会儿了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
My family has been managing the Past Memories of the Royal Family for generations.
No wonder since it is the exclusive scriptorium for the royal family.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
我的家族世代管理着皇室的“过去记忆”。
毕竟这里是皇室专用的抄写室，这也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
It has not been long since I took over this position so I am not really that used to this.
I never expected to be visited by these many archdukes...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
我接手这个职位的时间还不长，所以还不太习惯。
我没想到会有这么多大公爵来访...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff这是一个作为纪念进行的活动。
只有队伍首领才能进行纪念活动。请组建队伍后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, did you see? We are the last ones entering.
Others must have entered already.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，你看到了吗？我们是最后进来的。
其他人应该已经进去了。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 现在进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，太迟了也不好...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum? I don't know what is going on. We don't seem to be able to enter now.
It is a secret area which is made to open upon showing magical power.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯？我不知道发生了什么。我们现在似乎进不去了。
这是一个秘密区域，需要展示魔力才能开启。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's wait until it stabilizes.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
让我们等它稳定下来。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下一个区域的门已经开启了！
好了，我们进去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Has anything happened in there?
What on earth...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
里面发生什么事了吗？
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It is nothing that I should know and nowhere I should be part of. But still, I am curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这不是我该知道的事，也不是我该参与的地方。但即便如此，我还是很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
The movement of magical flow seems peculiar.
...I wonder if it is my imagination that the gate looks unstable.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
魔力流动的轨迹似乎有些异常。
...难道是我的错觉吗？这扇门看起来不太稳定。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, this is troublesome.
There seems to be a problem with the gate now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎呀，真麻烦。
这扇门现在似乎出了点问题。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Use of magic is restricted in this area. All I can do is to activate the gate here...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
在这个区域使用魔法是受到限制的。我能做的只有激活这里的门...

scripts.text: Where you are going with this...
scripts.translation: 你打算用这个做什么...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, I mean...
You should get out here on foot.
Well, since things have turned out this way.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，我的意思是...
你应该从这里步行出去。
既然事情已经变成这样了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffHere is the material what the archduke has seen earlier.^000000
{0}, why don't you take a look too?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff这是大公之前看到的资料。^000000
{0}，你要不要也看看？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, not that I am curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，也不是说我对它有多好奇。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Just out of curiosity.... No, I mean ardor for study. Haha...
...Yes? Let's take a look... Make sure to share what is in there with me-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
只是出于好奇...不，我是说出于研究的渴望。哈哈...
...是吗？那我们就看看吧...记得把里面的内容分享给我-

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你不觉得好奇吗？
既然你和大公在一起，图书管理员肯定会把它展示给你的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我会想办法重新激活这扇门的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你不觉得好奇吗？
既然你和大公在一起，图书管理员肯定会把它展示给你的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我会想办法重新激活这扇门的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
...Oh well. ^4d4dffOnly open to the ones who know the truth^000000...
Argh, what a waste.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...算了。^4d4dff只有知晓真相的人才能开启^000000...
唉，真是浪费。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, it is no use to stick around here.
I could cut the air with a knife earlier. Let's get out now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，在这里逗留也没用了。
刚才我甚至能感觉到空气像刀一样锋利。我们赶紧出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I took a look at the gate.
Has there been a big explosion of magic inside before?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我检查了一下这扇门。
之前里面是不是发生过巨大的魔力爆发？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I sense some sort of magical distortion, which is similar to...
The ^4d4dffCrack of Dimension^000000!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我感觉到某种魔力扭曲，这很像...
^4d4dff次元裂缝^000000！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we make a gate of dimension here?
That would be fun too.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们可以在这里制造一个次元之门吗？
那听起来也挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Right.
Since the gate has become useless...
Let's walk out of here.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
没错。
既然这扇门已经没用了...
我们步行出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the crusader there?
He manages the entrance.
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到那边的十字军了吗？
他在管理入口。
他会指引你的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Although there are direct gates installed in the palace for convenience,
There are passages you can walk directly in.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
虽然为了方便，宫殿里安装了直达的门，
但也有可以直接步行的通道。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is one of the rare chances to use the secret passage.
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这可是难得能使用秘密通道的机会。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, shall I get ready?
Come here! ^4d4dffDimension Warper MkII^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，准备好了吗？
过来！^4d4dff次元传送器 MkII^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, let's go, dear customer.
I wonder what we are going to see this time!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，亲爱的顾客，我们出发吧。
不知道这次我们会看到什么呢！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We haven't solved all the secrets yet!
Well, we have to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们还没有解开所有的秘密呢！
好了，我们得回去了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's finish it off this time!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这次我们要彻底解决它！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing?
Go grill the librarian to dig out the truth!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你在干什么？
去逼问图书管理员，挖出真相！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What did we go through all the trouble for?
Look, there is Archduke Grantz.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们费了这么大劲是为了什么？
看，那是格兰茨公爵。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffThe Heine family will get the approval to enter the 'Past Memories of the Royal Family'^000000, right?
We will see each other more often from now on then.
Haha, this must be what others call the destiny-¡?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff海尔内家族将获得进入“王室往事”的许可^000000，对吧？
以后我们会更常见面了。
哈哈，这大概就是别人所说的命运吧？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing?
Let's go see ^4d4dffDuke Friedrich to check if the approval has been issued!^000000
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你在干什么？
我们去找^4d4dff弗里德里希公爵，确认许可是否已经签发！^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Today, we are going on a secret journey together again!
Hahaha. You'd better get excited!
I'll let you travel in the first class!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
今天，我们要再次一起进行秘密旅行！
哈哈哈。你最好兴奋起来！
我会让你享受头等舱的待遇！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, let's go, dear customer.
What would be waiting for us today?
I guess this would end up a failure again, though.
Hahaha-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，亲爱的顾客，我们出发吧。
今天会有什么呢在等着我们？
我想这次大概又会失败吧。
哈哈哈-

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有队伍首领才能进入MD [祝福仪式]。^000000

scripts.text: You can move to where the ritual of blessing is held.
scripts.translation: 您可以移动到举行祝福仪式的地方。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... This gate is only activated temporarily so that it doesn't last long.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯... 这个门只是临时激活的，所以不会持续太久。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有队伍首领才能进入MD [祝福仪式]。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, well, the movement of magic seems uneasy.
Hum, shall we try again later?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，好吧，魔法的移动似乎不太稳定。
嗯，我们要不要稍后再试一次？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
The gate to the place where the ritual is held is not activated officially.
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
通往仪式举行地点的门还没有正式激活。
请稍等。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThis is an event proceeding through memorial.
Only the party leader can enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff这是一个通过纪念进行的活动。
只有队伍首领才能进入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Would you go out through the passage?
There is another overwatcher where I am about to send you.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
你要通过通道出去吗？
在我即将送你去的地方，还有另一位看守者。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Don't be surprised and you may go out with his help.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
别惊讶，你可以借助他的帮助出去。

scripts.text: Go out now.
scripts.translation: 现在出去

scripts.text: Go out later.
scripts.translation: 稍后出去

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
I will send you anytime when you need it.
Just don't waste too much time here.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
当你需要时，我会随时送你出去。
只是别在这里浪费太多时间。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Let's me guide you right away,
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
让我立刻为你指引方向，

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Did you find out anything?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
你发现什么了吗？

scripts.text: Tell him what you have seen.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你看到了什么

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
...........Did such thing happen?
There has been a record of the disaster in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
...........竟然发生了这种事？
普隆德拉曾记录过这场灾难。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I didn't know that the Imir Heart in the Room of Consciousness was stolen by the Valkyrie!
Why wasn't such a thing recorded?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我竟然不知道意识之室里的伊米尔之心被瓦尔基里偷走了！
为什么没有记录这样的事？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Can you read the document now then?
If what you have seen is true, the seal would be broken.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那你现在能读懂这份文件了吗？
如果你看到的是真的，封印就会被打破。

scripts.text:
When you touch the blank page of the book Kronecker has given you,
The text shows up with a glow.
scripts.translation:
当你触摸克罗内克给你的书的空白页时，
文字伴随着光芒浮现出来。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff......
Due to the battle of the Valkyrie, the Imir Heart sealed in the Room of Consciousness disappeared.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff......
由于瓦尔基里的战斗，封印在意识之室的伊米尔之心消失了。

scripts.text:
I was terrified that the symbol of legitimacy held by the royal family had been gone.
I am afraid that we wouldn't be able to see the light of Terra Gloria in the coronation.
scripts.translation:
我惊恐于王室持有的正统象征之物已经消失。
我担心在加冕典礼上，我们将无法看到泰拉·格洛丽亚的光辉。

scripts.text:
The problem would occur from the next coronation.
The people of the kingdom will be disheartened and worried about their future if the blessing of the earth is not given to the crowning of the king.
scripts.translation:
问题将从下一次加冕典礼开始。
如果大地之赐福不能降临在国王的加冕上，王国的人民将会灰心丧气，并对未来感到担忧。

scripts.text:
I consulted Varmunt the Great Sage about this.
He told me he could help and installed something in the Room of Consciousness.
scripts.translation:
我就此事咨询了大贤者瓦尔蒙特。
他说他能帮忙，并在意识之室安装了某种东西。

scripts.text:
I was surprised to see what was installed there reacting with Terra Gloria.
It delivered enough magical power to Terra Gloria's Star of Blessing,
scripts.translation:
我惊讶地发现那里安装的东西与泰拉·格洛丽亚产生了共鸣。
它向泰拉·格洛丽亚的赐福之星输送了足够的魔力，

scripts.text: And Terra Gloria could give the blessing of the earth as usual.
scripts.translation: 泰拉·格洛丽亚便能如常赐予大地之福。

scripts.text:
Everything was all right.
Even if it was by the fake Imir Heart.
scripts.translation:
一切都很顺利。
即使那是假的伊米尔之心。

scripts.text:
Terra Gloria, our beautiful crown.
In the blessed crown, there remained a piece of Imir Heart which has been guarding Prontera for generations.
scripts.translation:
泰拉·格洛丽亚，我们美丽的王冠。
在这顶受祝福的王冠中，保留着一片伊米尔之心，它世代守护着普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
It is enough.
It would be enough for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
这就足够了。
这对我们的后代来说已经足够了。

scripts.text:
Therefore, I wish no one else ever read this record,
And seal it with a condition which cannot be met.
scripts.translation:
因此，我希望除了我们之外没有人能读到这份记录，
并用一个无法达成的条件将其封印。

scripts.text:
If one of our descendants happen to read this record,
Make sure to guard Terra Gloria.
It is the last piece of Imir Heart left to us.^000000
scripts.translation:
如果我们的后代中有人读到了这份记录，
请务必守护泰拉·格洛丽亚。
这是留给我们最后的伊米尔之心碎片。^000000

scripts.text: That's it...
scripts.translation: 就是这样...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Am I going to be killed now?
I think I have just found out all the secrets of the royal family.
Aren't you going to execute me?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我现在就要被杀了吗？
我想我已经知道了王室所有的秘密。
你们不打算处决我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
..............Hum...
If you want, I will fulfill your wish.
But not now.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
......嗯...
如果你愿意，我会满足你的愿望。
但不是现在。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Then... How about me?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员]
那么...我呢？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
If you say another word, I'll hang you with my own hands.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
如果你再多说一个字，我就亲手把你吊死。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am surprised.
It means that we can bring a ^4d4dfffake Imir Heart^000000 or
The real piece of Imir Heart to replace what has been destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我很惊讶。
这意味着我们可以用^4d4dff伪造的伊米尔之心^000000，
或者真正的伊米尔之心碎片来替换被毁掉的那部分。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The real problem is Terra Gloria...
It has been one of a kind to begin with.
Since it was made by crafting a small piece fallen from the heart...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
真正的问题在于泰拉·格洛丽亚...
它从一开始就是独一无二的。
因为它是由从心脏上掉落的一小块碎片制作而成的...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Should we negotiate with the cooperation in Schwarzwald?
Wait a minute.
.....
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们要不要和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的合作方谈判？
等等。
.....

scripts.text: What should I do now?
scripts.translation: 我现在该怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am sorry to keep you waiting while I collect my thoughts.
Thank you for your work.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
抱歉让你久等了，我需要整理一下思绪。
感谢你的工作。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
May I ask you a favor?
Would you keep on visiting that place with Nillem?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
可以请你帮个忙吗？
请继续和尼勒姆一起前往那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Although we are going to discuss about it in the official meeting, I don't think the result would be different.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
虽然我们要在正式会议上讨论此事，但我认为结果不会改变。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Please guard Imir Heart there or bring it to us!
We don't keep our hope too high, but it would worth the try, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
请守护那里的伊米尔之心，或者把它带回来给我们！
我们不敢抱太大希望，但这值得一试，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Please.
I'll get the approval for you to visit the Past Memories of the Royal Family everyday.
Please get the task from Frietz... I mean Friedrich.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
拜托了。
我会批准你每天访问王室过去记忆。
请从弗里德里希那里领取任务...我是说弗里德里希。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is a shame, but you are the only hope left for us.
We are counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
很遗憾，但你是我们仅存的一线希望。
我们指望你了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffFrom now on, you can get daily quests related to the past Room of Consciousness from Friedrich Stoltze.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff从现在开始，你可以从弗里德里希·施托尔策那里领取与过去意识房间相关的每日任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kronecker G. Heine]
Then, I'll entrust the matter regarding this place to you and Nillem.
For the sake of the royal family's legitimacy...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克·G·海涅]
那么，关于这个地方的事务，我就委托给你和尼勒姆了。
为了王室的正统性...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker G. Heine]
Please carry out this mission in secret.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克·G·海涅]
请秘密执行这项任务。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
We have been waiting for you because...
We wonder ^4d4dffif you have ever told anyone about the ritual^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
我们一直在等你，因为...
我们想知道^4d4dff你是否曾向任何人透露过关于仪式的事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Only few people know about the Past Memories of the Royal Family and the Ritual of Blessing...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
只有少数人知道王室过去记忆和天使之赐福仪式...

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You need to make it more clear.
Just say it.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你需要说得更清楚一点。
直接说吧。

scripts.text: Am I a suspect here?
scripts.translation: 我是这里的嫌疑人吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Ah, it is....
That you are the only outsider who know about it, and there has been no precedent...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
啊，原来如此...
你是唯一知道此事的外人，而且此前从未有过先例...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I don't believe so.
The hero doesn't even know the existence of the Past Memories of the Royal Family and where it is.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我不这么认为。
那位英雄甚至不知道王室过去记忆的存在，也不知道它在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
We only have told to observe the ritual after the Royal Assembly is completed.
Never mentioned about where it would be held or how.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我们只被告知，要在王室集会结束后观察仪式。
从未提及仪式会在哪里举行，或如何进行。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I understand how upset you all are due to this sudden incident.
But, please don't suspect an innocent person.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我理解大家因这起突发事件而感到不安。
但请不要怀疑无辜的人。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
That must be...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
那一定是...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
How troublesome.
Have you seen this document before?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
真是麻烦。
你以前见过这份文件吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
What is it?
We are in the middle of something important.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
那是什么？
我们正忙着处理重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
No matter is more important than this!
It has already happened. We need to prepare for the future.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
没有什么比这更重要了！
事情已经发生了。我们需要为未来做准备。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
However, ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is gone...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
然而，^4d4dff泰拉·格洛丽亚^000000不见了...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It disappeared when we were taking care of fallen Peter.
I guess those intruders must have taken it during the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
它在我们照顾受伤的彼得时消失了。
我想那些入侵者一定是在爆炸时把它拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And about the Star of Blessing... They said...
It was ^4d4dfffake^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
至于天使之赐福...他们说...
那是^4d4dff假的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It must refer to the piece of Imir Heart.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那应该是指伊米尔之心的一块碎片。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am sorry to interrupt but I have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
抱歉打断一下，我有件事要告诉你们。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...It is important. I was about to tell you about the cause of all these.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...这很重要。我正要告诉你们这一切的起因。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
The cause of the incident?
You mean you know who have told the secret?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
事件的起因？
你是说你知道是谁泄露了秘密？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
The one who told about the ritual...
Was me.
...So...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
泄露仪式消息的人...
是我。
...所以...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Please punish me for my fault.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
请惩罚我的过错。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What are you talking about? Nyhill!
Why did you...!
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
你在说什么？尼希尔！
你为什么要...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe it was me.
I have this piece of memory talking to someone while I was drunk.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我相信是我。
我有一段记忆，显示我在醉酒时与某人交谈。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe it is how the story got out.
I am deeply ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我相信故事就是这样传出去的。
我深感羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Oh my... Was it the lord of the Heine family...
Although us, the Walther family did not attend the Royal Assembly, we won't sit back and watch this matter!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
天哪...难道是海尔内家的领主...
虽然沃尔特家没有参加皇家集会，但我们绝不会坐视不管！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ha, I have heard what people say about you. You really don't seem to be able to do anything right.
Why did you do such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
哈，我听说过关于你的传闻。看来你确实总是做不好事情。
你为什么要做这种事？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Did you want to be a king so badly?
Peter is a member of your own family!
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你是太想当国王了吗？
彼得可是你自己的家人啊！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
........Phew...
It is not that...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
......呼...
事情不是那样的...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Speak for yourself.
I need to know how useless you are.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
你只代表你自己。
我需要知道你到底有多没用。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have nothing to say about it.
However...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
对此我无话可说。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am a Heine, one of the seven royal families of Rune-Midgarts.
I didn't do such a thing on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我是海尔内，卢恩·米德加兹七大皇族之一。
我并非故意做出这种事。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Are you sure that you didn't do it to avenge for losing your position as a candidate for the throne?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你确定你不是为了报复失去王位候选人的资格才这么做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have told you that it isn't true!
..........
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我已经告诉过你，那不是真的！
..........

scripts.text: Wait, may I interrupt?
scripts.translation: 请允许我插句话。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Please, do so. I am sorry about my bad manners earlier.
...Do you know anything about this, dear guest?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
请说。抱歉我刚才失礼了。
...亲爱的客人，您知道这件事的内情吗？

scripts.text: Tell them about the thing happened in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 告诉他们宴会厅里发生的事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
...Did such thing happen?
A person who looks like a scientist and drug...
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
...发生了这样的事吗？
一个看起来像科学家的人，还有药物...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If it is true, Lord Heine must have not done such a thing on purpose.
Someone must have taken advantage on him according to a plot...
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果这是真的，海尔内领主一定不是故意的。
肯定是有人按照阴谋利用了他...

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Do you have a proof?
You didn't just come up with the story to help him out, right?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你有证据吗？
你不会是为了帮他脱罪才编造故事吧？

scripts.text: Lady Nerius will testify...
scripts.translation: 内里乌斯女士会作证...

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
...Hum... The ladies of the Nerius family have seen it too?
We need to call for a meeting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
...嗯...内里乌斯家的人也看到了吗？
我们需要召开一次会议。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Hey, Grantz. What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
嘿，格兰茨。你打算怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Even if it was true, he still has acted so carelessly.
I cannot let it slide.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
即使这是真的，他的行为也太鲁莽了。
我不能就此放过。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is difficult for me to say, but it could have been deemed as a treason.
What a shame. I have nothing to say about it.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
虽然很难说出口，但这可能被视为叛国。
真可惜。对此我无话可说。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
This has brought disgrace to the name of Heine.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
这让海尔内的名声蒙受了耻辱。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Nyhill, you sentence you to disciplinary confinement for a while.
You shouldn't contact with anyone other than the ones you must see.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
尼希尔，判处你禁闭一段时间。
除了必须见的人，你不许与任何人接触。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And about disappeared ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000
And destroyed Star of Blessing, we need to come up with a solution.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
还有失踪的^4d4dff格洛丽亚^000000
以及被毁的天使之赐福，我们需要想出对策。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
It will be a long discussion.
Let me convene a meeting right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
这将是一场漫长的讨论。
让我立刻召集一次会议。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
那我先走了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Let me fill you in with the details after proceeding with a discussion with my family.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃尔特]
等我和家人讨论完细节后，再向你汇报。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Wait, it is not ready yet.
Do not touch that.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等等，还没准备好。
别碰那个。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let me connect the gap in the dimension by force.
The gap might be invisible, but it still is a crack.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
让我强行连接维度的缺口。
缺口可能看不见，但它仍然是一道裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It will be connected to the time when a big event has taken place.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这将连接到发生重大事件的时间点。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: I am ready!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了！

scripts.text: I am not ready!
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, don't be such a drag.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，别这么磨蹭。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, sweet dreams!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，做个好梦！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, we did it.
I don't know when, but it is the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，我们成功了。
我不知道是什么时候，但这是^4d4dff皇室的过去记忆^000000！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, I have to give it a twist to get to the place we want to go.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
不过，我必须扭转一下才能到达我们想去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can I?
Hahaha, of course I can!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我可以吗？
哈哈，当然可以！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It is the first time for me to do this.
But let me twist the dimension like this.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这是我第一次做这种事。
但让我像这样扭转维度。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Connect the spaces by force!
Well, let's see what has happened here.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
强行连接空间！
好了，让我们看看这里发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Are you ready?
Talk to me when you are ready-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你准备好了吗？
准备好了就告诉我-

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff这是一个作为纪念进行的活动。
只有队伍首领才能进行纪念活动。请组建队伍后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then let's go and take a look what has happened in the Room of Consciousness.
Since I am connecting the twisted time and space once more by force,
I may have to use my full power to maintain this!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么让我们去看看意识室发生了什么。
既然我要再次强行连接扭曲的时空，
我可能需要全力维持这个状态！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Please, come back alive and well-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
请务必平安归来-

scripts.text: Connect now.
scripts.translation: 立即连接

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，太迟了也不好...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh... It doesn't work well.
Wait, phew... Let me collect my strength again...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
噢...不太顺利。
等等，呼...让我重新聚集一下力量...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
... I'll make it work, wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...我会成功的，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下一个区域的门已经开启了！
好了，我们进去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
You are here now!
This place has been chaotic since you were gone.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你终于回来了！
你不在的时候，这里一直都很混乱。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the exit over there?
Haha, that gate leads to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到那边的出口了吗？
哈哈，那扇门通往普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
And...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
而且...

scripts.text: Then?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Prontera is being destroyed by the undead army-!
Right now! It is just a hot mess out there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
普隆德拉正在被亡灵大军摧毁-！
就在现在！外面简直是一片混乱！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I mean, why don't we go to watch the unknown past of Prontera,
Since we are already here?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我是说，既然我们已经在这里了，
为什么不顺便去看看普隆德拉未知的过去呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have been digging around a little, and I guess we can come here anytime when we want...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我稍微调查了一下，我想我们随时都可以来这里...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, this could be one of the parallel worlds, but we have nothing to lose anyway.
Why don't we go take a look?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，这可能是其中一个平行世界，反正我们也没什么损失。
我们要不进去看看？

scripts.text: If you insist.
scripts.translation: 如果你坚持的话。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I knew you would! I have been right about you!
What are you waiting for! Let's go out there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我就知道你会答应的！我对你很有信心！
还等什么！我们出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't we heading out?
Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们要出发了吗？
走吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，我们现在整理一下思路吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意识室^000000里原本的东西一定是...
嗯，这肯定和现在^4d4dff亡灵大军袭击普隆德拉^000000有关。
嗯，一定是^4d4dff被他们拿走了^000000，对吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 没错。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们能阻止这件事吗？
或者，我们能把它带走吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我相信上级会命令我们这样做的。
尽一切办法让它成功吧。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也许，这只是我的想象。
意识室里的东西被拿走了，对吧？
然而，王室家族一直在进行仪式，却对此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他们一定做了什么，或者它已经回来了...
这或许能让我们看到被封印的^4d4dff王室家族的记忆^000000...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说，那些知道真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
是的，我是那个意思。如果这就是打开封印的关键真相，
那么我们就带着重要的情报回来了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们并没有保护或带走那个东西...
但我们现在知道了真相。这会打破文件的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
随着王室秘密的揭露，我们将拼凑出缺失的拼图。
哈哈哈哈哈，而你将成为这一切的中心，我的亲爱的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 别那样叫我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那又怎样？
从现在开始，我们每天都会见面，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，我们回去吧？
我们在这里的任务暂时完成了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们回去吧！
在一个不属于我们时代的地方待太久，不会有什么好事的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，准备好！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hahaha, I like this place now.
My darling, what do you want me to do now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈哈哈哈，我现在喜欢这个地方了。
我的亲爱的，现在你想让我做什么？

scripts.text: Connect to the Room of Consciousness
scripts.translation: 连接意识室

scripts.text: Return
scripts.translation: 返回

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As you wish!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
如您所愿！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Did you get the mission from the Heine family?
It doesn't seem like it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你从海尔内家族那里接到任务了吗？
看起来不像。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hey, this really is hard work!
Let's go there when we are on a mission, OK?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嘿，这真的很难！
等我们有任务的时候再去那里，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the dark circles under my eyes?
I'll do whatever you like to do, but!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到我眼下的黑眼圈了吗？
你想做什么我都依你，但是！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is too much.
We cannot change the past event too much.
Those people must have learned it by now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
这太过分了。
我们不能过多地改变过去的事件。
那些人现在应该已经察觉到了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, I guess it would be no use explaining it...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好吧，我想解释也没用...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It would have been better if they didn't know about it at all.
This may end up another torture for them, tut tut...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
如果他们一开始就不知道这件事就好了。
这可能会成为他们的另一种折磨，啧...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Therefore, since I am a dedicated public official!
I open the gate when there is a mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
因此，既然我是一名尽职的公务员！
有任务的时候，我就打开大门。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Why?
Because I am tired-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
为什么？
因为我累了——

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff这是一个作为纪念进行的活动。
只有队伍首领才能进行纪念活动。请组建队伍后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then let's go and take a look what has happened in the Room of Consciousness.
Since I am connecting the twisted time and space once more by force,
I may have to use my full power to maintain this!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么让我们去看看意识室发生了什么。
既然我要再次强行连接扭曲的时空，
我可能需要全力维持这个状态！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Please, come back alive and well-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
请务必平安归来-

scripts.text: Connect now.
scripts.translation: 立即连接

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，太迟了也不好...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh... It doesn't work well.
Wait, phew... Let me collect my strength again...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
噢...不太顺利。
等等，呼...让我重新聚集一下力量...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
... I'll make it work, wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...我会成功的，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下一个区域的门已经开启了！
好了，我们进去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Ha, since our work here is done, you shall go and report to Archduke Stoltze, right?
Ha, ha, this it for today-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈，既然我们在这里的工作结束了，你应该去汇报给大公爵斯托尔茨，对吧？
哈，哈，今天就到这里——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, it was difficult to maintain it. It was very difficult.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，维持这个状态很困难。真的非常困难。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... I am afraid it would be difficult.
Even for a genius magician like yours truly, there is a certain limit. I am a human after all.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯...恐怕这很困难。
即使是像我这样天才的魔法师，也有极限。毕竟我只是个人类。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Connecting multiple dimensions is not as easy as it sounds.
Please cut me some slack!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
连接多个维度并不像听起来那么容易。
请多体谅一下！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let me do this when the raging magical flow is stabilized-????
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等狂暴的魔力流动稳定下来，我再做这件事——？？？？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... Shall I clear the surroundings a little?
Wait, I'll get ready.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯...我要清理一下周围的环境吗？
等等，我准备一下。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It won't take long. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
不会花太久的。请等一下。

scripts.text:
The uneasy flow of magical power can be sensed near the twisted space.
The gap connected by force disappeared after serving its duty.
scripts.translation:
在扭曲的空间附近，可以感觉到不安定的魔力流动。
被强行连接的缝隙在履行完职责后消失了。

scripts.text: You can move to the place where the piece of Ymir Heart was in the past.

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum, I have just torn and connected these spaces by force.
Such thing is possible since I am a genius!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，我刚刚强行撕裂并连接了这些空间。
因为我可是天才，所以这是可能的！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Room of Consciousness].^000000

Oh, well, the movement of magic seems uneasy.
Hum, shall we try again later?
scripts.translation:

哦，好吧，魔法的移动似乎不太稳定。
嗯，我们要不要稍后再试一次？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum, is it too difficult to connect it by force?
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:

嗯，强行连接它太难了吗？
等一下。
