scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
主厨一直在等你。他现在很生气！
快去厨房！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
我忙得晕头转向！
最近见的人太多了，连熟脸都分不清了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am sorry about the misunderstanding.
I have been badgered by the Head Chef too much... Haha...
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
抱歉让你误会了。
我被主厨逼得太紧了...哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
我忙得晕头转向！
最近见的人太多了，连熟脸都分不清了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
Hey, you! I have been looking for you!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
嘿，就是你！我一直在找你！
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师]
主厨一直在等你。他现在很生气！
快去厨房！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
啊！
那个特别助厨什么时候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special's assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
啊！
那个特别助厨什么时候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Of course!
The food for the banquet is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
当然！
宴会的食物完美无缺！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
More!
More!
More!
Much more!
I want to satisfy the guests!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
更多！
更多！
更多！
还要更多！
我要让客人们满意！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I can't just let go of the banquet of my life this fabulously!
It should be more fabulous!
No, much more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
我不能就这样放过我人生中最棒的宴会！
它应该更棒！
不，要棒得多！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Hum...
I won't be satisfied if it was not miraculously luxurious and superlatively fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
嗯...
如果不是奇迹般地奢华、极致地华丽，我是不会满意的！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef Apprentice[Royal Chef]
Head Chef!
We have a guest for you, Head Chef...
scripts.translation:
[御用厨师学徒]
主厨！
主厨，有位客人来找您...

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You are late!
How can you be so late when we don't even have a second to spare!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
你迟到了！
我们分秒必争，你怎么能这么晚！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I would have placed you in the Poring Range for a week!
But today is a special day. So I'll punish you later!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
我本该把你关进波利牧场一周！
但今天是特殊日子。所以我稍后再惩罚你！

scripts.text: Ask about the situation.
scripts.translation: 询问情况

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
It is not the most important thing now!
Let's stop talking and make the banquet more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在这不是最重要的事！
别废话了，让宴会更华丽吧！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Go to the empty spot and get prepared to cook!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
去空位那里，准备好开始烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Once you prepare a piece of Griffon meat... You need to pour the sauce... What?
The sauce... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
当你准备好一块狮鹫肉后...你需要浇上酱汁...什么？
酱汁...咦？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Wait a minute!
The sauce is gone! Unbelievable!
We cannot do anything without the sauce!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
等一下！
酱汁不见了！难以置信！
没有酱汁我们什么都做不了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You! The new assistant!
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
你！新来的助手！
去东方牡蛎那里拿酱汁，他是酱汁大师！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在！快！
快点！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Isn't the sauce ready?
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
酱汁还没好吗？
去东方牡蛎那里拿酱汁，他是酱汁大师！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在！快！
快点！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Oh!
This exquisite taste made by the master!
It is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哦！
大师调制的这精致味道！
完美！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
让我们开始烹饪吧！
去空位那里，做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
让我们开始烹饪吧！
去空位那里，做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now, you can bring this to the kitchen. That is the only thing left to do!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在，你可以把这个带到厨房了。这是最后要做的了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
What are you waiting for!
Run to the dining room with this dish!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
你在等什么！
带着这道菜跑到餐厅去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
A Royal Chef must be able to fill the empty plates as fast as possible!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
御用厨师必须能尽快填满空盘子！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhh!
The mind for cooking!
The mind of the queen!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
啊哈哈哈！
烹饪的心！
女王的心！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
With the blazing spirit of mine!
I'll make the best dish!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
带着我熊熊燃烧的斗志！
我要做出最好的菜！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
请整理你的背包并再试一次。-

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhhh!
I am sorry!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
啊哈哈哈！
对不起！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I thought you were the new assistant chef who was supposed to come. I am sorry about all the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
我以为你是那个本该来的新助手厨师。对于所有的麻烦，我很抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I have scolded the one who has brought you, hero. Please forgive us!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
我已经责骂了那个带你来的人，英雄。请原谅我们！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
However, you really seem to have a true talent in cooking!
Grilled Griffon!
It was delicious!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
不过，你似乎真的很有烹饪天赋！
烤狮鹫！
真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I hope to be able to cook with you again!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
希望能再次和你一起烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
This is not the time!
Rush to the dining room before the food goes cold!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在不是时候！
在食物变凉之前冲到餐厅去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Haha, I've been waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哈哈，我一直在等你呢！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's not waste time and start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
别浪费时间了，现在开始烹饪吧！
去空位那里做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
Take a rest now!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哎呀！
现在休息一下！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
If I push you too hard, I would be in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
如果我逼你太紧，我就有麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
As each dish has the best moment to tastes it, each person has the best time to engage in cooking!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
每道菜都有最佳的品尝时刻，每个人也有最适合烹饪的时间！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You there!
You are getting in the way!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
喂！
你挡路了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now... then!
Today's main dish is the Grilled Griffon with the special sauce. The crust should be crunchy while the inside is juicy!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
那么...开始吧！
今天的主菜是特制酱汁烤狮鹫。外皮要酥脆，里面要多汁！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Since it is a dish for the banquet!
Each dish should look and taste exactly the same! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
这可是宴会用的菜！
每道菜的外观和味道都必须完全一致！别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Take a good look at what I do now, and do exactly the same!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
好好看我现在的动作，然后照做！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Yap!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
啪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Humph!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哼！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Whoa!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哇！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Bam!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
砰！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Hahahaha!
An excellent Grilled Griffon DX is made!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
哈哈哈！
做出一道完美的特制酱汁烤狮鹫！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now, you can bring this to the kitchen. That is the only thing left to do!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
现在，你可以把这个带到厨房了。这是最后要做的了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
What are you waiting for!
Run to the dining room with this dish!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
你在等什么！
带着这道菜跑到餐厅去！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
A Royal Chef must be able to fill the empty plates as fast as possible!
scripts.translation:
[主厨]
御用厨师必须能尽快填满空盘子！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum... How savory!
The perfect combinations is just divine...
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
嗯...好鲜美！
完美的搭配简直是神赐的...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
What?
The sauce ran out?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
什么？
酱汁用完了？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I am in trouble!
You don't know what the Head Chef would do if I am late...
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
我完蛋了！
你知道如果我迟到了，主厨会怎么对我吗...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum... I need to make the sauce fast.
I am sorry to ask but would you help me with this?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
嗯...我得快点做酱汁。
不好意思，能帮个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
My apprentice was sent to the medical office because he slipped on the sauce...
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
我的学徒因为滑倒在酱汁上，被送去医务室了...

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I cannot stop stirring the sauce. You can bring me the ingredient as I say the name.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
我不能停下搅拌酱汁。我说出食材名字时，你帮我拿来。

scripts.text: [Oriental Oyster]
scripts.translation: [东方牡蛎]

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh my...
The ingredient is like the life for a sauce.
There shouldn't be a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
天哪...
食材对于酱汁来说就像生命一样重要。
绝对不能出错。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Then, let's start over from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
那么，让我们从头开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient!
The Head Chef is looking at me with the set of murderous eyes!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
把食材拿来！
主厨正用杀人的眼神盯着我呢！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Hum, very good!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
嗯，非常好！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
请整理你的背包并再试一次。-

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh!
Very good!
Thanks to you, I could make the perfect sauce!
Bring it to the Head Chef now!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
哦！
非常好！
多亏了你，我做出了完美的酱汁！
现在立刻把它端给主厨！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem to be talented in sauce making.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
你似乎在制作酱汁方面很有天赋。
为什么不成为一位酱汁大师呢？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh!
Very good!
Thanks to you, I could make the perfect sauce!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
哦！
非常好！
多亏了你，我做出了完美的酱汁！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem to be talented in sauce making.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
你似乎在制作酱汁方面很有天赋。
为什么不成为一位酱汁大师呢？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I knew you would come again!
That is the magic of the sauce!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
我就知道你会再来的！
这就是酱汁的魔力！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
How about making a fabulous sauce today?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
今天要不要做一款绝妙的酱汁？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh my!
The palate is very important for a chef.
When you are tired the palate doesn't work properly.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
天哪！
对于厨师来说，味觉非常重要。
当你疲惫时，味觉就无法正常工作了。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
You seem very tired now.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
你现在看起来很累。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
If you want to make a perfect sauce, take some rest.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
如果你想做出完美的酱汁，先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Oh! You are here!

scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
哦！你来了！
休息好了吗？要不要再试试做酱汁？

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
I hope you don't waste your talent.
Why don't you become a master sauce maker?
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
我希望你不要浪费你的天赋。
为什么不成为一位酱汁大师呢？

scripts.text: [Oriental Oyster]
scripts.translation: [东方牡蛎]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
首先，给我拿来清爽口味的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient for the chewy texture.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
给我拿来有嚼劲口感的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Bring me the ingredient that shines brightly.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
给我拿来闪闪发光的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
First, bring me the ingredient for the soft taste.
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
首先，给我拿来口感柔软的食材。

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Yes! That's it!
Bring it to me!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
没错！就是这个！
把它拿给我！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
Argh!
The sauce is ruined!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
啊！
酱汁毁了！

scripts.text:
[Oriental Oyster]
We cannot use this sauce now!
We should start again from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[东方牡蛎]
这个酱汁现在没法用了！
我们得从头再来！

scripts.text:
The juice made of fresh Muka
It is refreshing.
scripts.translation:
用新鲜摩卡制成的果汁
清爽可口。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
Giantaurus Milk Butter
It tastes surprisingly soft.
scripts.translation:
巨牛乳酪
口感意外地柔软。

嗯，我觉得有这种感觉很正常！

[洗碗工]

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Hahaha... It is a new plate.
I'll make it squeaky clean like this!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
哈哈... 这是一个新盘子。
我要把它洗得闪闪发亮！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Don't push yourself too hard.
Why don't you go take a rest and come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
别太勉强自己了。
为什么不去休息一下，明天再来呢？

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Thank you for helping me last time!
It is very important to take enough rest after work.
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
谢谢你上次帮我！
工作后充分休息是非常重要的。

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
啊！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
The housewife's eczema is back in action in my right hand!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
主妇的湿疹又在我右手发作了！

scripts.text:
[Dishwasher]
Hode Cream!
Please give me the Hode Cream!
Arghhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[洗碗工]
蚯蚓霜！
快给我蚯蚓霜！
啊——！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My cooking was perfect!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我的烹饪完美无缺！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I cannot believe that I am able to cook with the Head Chef!
It feels like I am dreaming!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
我简直不敢相信，我能和主厨一起烹饪！
感觉像是在做梦一样！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Delicious!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I prefer to have it with salt than sugar!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
比起加糖，我更喜欢加盐！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
The best way to taste it is to taste it as it is! The best flavor is the flavor of the ingredient itself!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
品尝它最好的方式就是原味品尝！
最好的味道就是食材本身的味道！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Dear Head Chef! Please marry me!
scripts.translation:
[厨师]
亲爱的主厨！请嫁给我吧！

scripts.text:

Hello.{0}.

May I help you?

你好，{0}。

{0}, did that happen to you too?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
不会吧！
{0}，你也遇到那种情况了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
When I was looking around to find more food for Dyu, someone took me to the Head Chef and made me work there!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
当我四处找食物给迪尤时，有人把我带到主厨那里，让我在那里工作！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
They were so busy preparing for the banquet that I had no time to explain... And I ended up...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
他们忙着准备宴会，我根本没时间解释...结果我就...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haha... They were just so busy that I couldn't just quit working...
Haha... Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
哈哈...他们实在太忙了，我没法直接辞职不干了...
哈哈...哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I think it is too late for me...
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我想...对我来说已经太迟了...
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If you find Dyu in the Banquet Hall, please tell him that I won't be able to go back with food since I am too busy.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
如果你在宴会厅找到迪尤，请告诉他，因为我太忙了，没法带食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I think it is too late for me...
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我想...对我来说已经太迟了...
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If you find Dyu in the Banquet Hall, please tell him that I won't be able to go back with food since I am too busy.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
如果你在宴会厅找到迪尤，请告诉他，因为我太忙了，没法带食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...Phew, that is my sister.
Well then.{0}, why don't you come with me to enjoy the banquet...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
...呼，那是我妹妹。
那么，{0}，要不要跟我一起去享受宴会...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
...看来我们应该把手头的事情做完！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should bring the used dishes to the kitchen.
It would take less time if we do it together. Let's finish it and go eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我得把用过的餐具送到厨房去。
我们一起做会快一些。做完我们就去吃好吃的吧！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
...看来我们应该把手头的事情做完！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should bring the used dishes to the kitchen.
It would take less time if we do it together. Let's finish it and go eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我得把用过的餐具送到厨房去。
我们一起做会快一些。做完我们就去吃好吃的吧！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hum... What am I supposed to do next...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
嗯...我接下来该做什么来着...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Whoa...{0}, thank you.
Now I have some room to breathe...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
哇...{0}，谢谢你。
现在我终于能喘口气了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh... It was just impossible for me to quit...
When I was about to leave after reporting to the Head Chef, I was caught by Mark' brother.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
唉...我根本没法辞职...
我向主厨汇报完准备离开时，被马克的哥哥抓住了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess it would make my life much easier if I just give up.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我想，要是我干脆放弃的话，生活可能会轻松很多。

scripts.text: A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation: 看起来美味的烤狮鹫。

scripts.text: Place the dish carefully on the surface.
scripts.translation: 小心地将盘子放在桌面上。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
哈啊——！
发生什么事了...

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
请整理你的背包并再试一次。-

scripts.text:
Place the dish carefully on the surface.
A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation:
小心地将盘子放在桌面上。
看起来美味的烤狮鹫。

scripts.text: A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation: 看起来美味的烤狮鹫。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hello.
You must be the hero whom everyone talks about.
I am honored to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
你好。
想必你就是大家口中那位英雄吧。
很荣幸见到你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Are you invited to the banquet?
This place is not the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你是受邀参加宴会的吗？
这里不是宴会厅。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You must be {0} whom everyone talks about.
Thank you for visiting us.
I am Spica of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
想必你就是大家口中那位{0}吧。
感谢你的到来。
我是内里乌斯家族的斯皮卡。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I am Skia.
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我是斯基亚。
很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And he is my bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
他是我的保镖。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
My name is Crux Findel.
I am learning swordsmanship in the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
我叫克鲁克斯·芬德尔。
我正在内里乌斯家族学习剑术。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother, the current head of the family, is supposed to be here.
However, since many heroes like you,{0}, are said to attend this banquet,
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们的母亲，也就是现任家主，本该在这里的。
不过，据说像您这样的英雄，{0}，也会参加这场宴会，

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother let us come here to meet and learn from them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们的母亲让我们来到这里，与他们会面并学习。

scripts.text: Where is the candidate for the throne?
scripts.translation: 王位候选人在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, you must be invited as the observer to the ritual...
I see.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哦，您一定是被邀请来观看仪式的...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Erich is in the royal library.
I guess he could be looking for blueprints of some sort which interest him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
埃里希在皇家图书馆。
我想他可能在寻找一些他感兴趣的图纸。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Nerius is not interested in the throne.
Erich didn't have to participate in the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
内里乌斯对王位不感兴趣。
埃里希也不必参加皇家议会。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since he is just a candidate merely for effect, he must be doing what he wants to do now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
既然他只是为了场面而成为候选人，那他肯定正在做他想做的事。

scripts.text: Why aren't you interested in the throne?
scripts.translation: 为什么你们对王位不感兴趣？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
It is one of the characteristics of the Nerius.
The family is led by women for generations. Therefore, we turn out more queens than kings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
这是内里乌斯家族的一个特点。
家族由女性领导了好几代。因此，我们家族出的女王比国王多。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If Erich hasn't come forth, one of us, Skia and I would have been elected as a candidate for the queen.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果埃里希没有出面，我和斯基亚中的一位就会被选为王位候选人。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother didn't like it.
That's why Erich became a candidate for the throne. Poor cousin...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们的母亲不喜欢那样。
所以埃里希成为了王位候选人。可怜的表亲...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I guess that's enough information about our family.
Have you exchanged greetings with all other families?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好了，关于我们家族的信息大概就这些了。
您和其他家族都打过招呼了吗？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since freedom doesn't come often for us, I tend to enjoy it as much as possible.
So...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
因为自由对我们来说并不常见，所以我倾向于尽可能享受它。
所以...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Why don't you enjoy it with us?
I believe the lord of the Heine family would make a good friend too.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
为什么不和我们一起享受呢？
我相信海尔内家族的领主也会是个不错的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia, my beloved twin.
You need to learn to speak more elegantly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亚，我亲爱的双胞胎。
你需要学会说话更优雅一些。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Anyways, what I want to say is that
the Nerius family is always open to you,{0}, so please visit us
anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
总之，我想说的是，
内里乌斯家族的大门永远向您敞开，{0}，所以请随时来访。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我想其他家族现在应该都准备好了，马上就要出发了。
我们可能还有些时间。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，您为什么不回房间等待消息呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果您还没有拜访所有家族，为什么不先去拜访一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我想其他家族现在应该都准备好了，马上就要出发了。
我们可能还有些时间。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，您为什么不回房间等待消息呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We must get prepared for the Banquet now. We need some time to dress up.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我们现在必须为宴会做准备了。我们需要时间换装。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果您还没有拜访所有家族，为什么不先去拜访一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I'll send you a formal invitation to make up for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我会给您发一封正式邀请函来弥补这次失礼。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have heard the story briefly from Skia.
Lord Nyhill must have a constitutional weakness for alcohol.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我从斯基亚那里简单听说了这件事。
尼希尔大人肯定有酒精过敏的体质弱点。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are not hiding anything, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你没有什么在隐瞒吧？

scripts.text: I saw someone suspicious.
scripts.translation: 我看见了可疑的人。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are lying.
I have to let the elders know about this anyway.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你在撒谎。
不管怎样，我都必须告知长老们这件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I wonder if the old folks would hear me out though.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不过，不知道那些老人家会不会听我解释。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia told me something similar to that.
Crux didn't find out much.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亚也告诉过我类似的事情。
克鲁克斯并没有查出什么。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess some shady characters must have mixed in with the bunch of temporary employees hired for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
看来肯定是有几个不三不四的家伙混进了为宴会临时雇佣的员工队伍里。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Anyways, I guess we have to warn the elders about this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...总之，我想我们必须警告长老们这件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Sorry about all the trouble.
How unlucky of you to be involved in this mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。
真倒霉，让你卷进了这堆烂摊子里。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I am not doing well either.
The royal family is focusing on finding out who is pulling the strings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯，我这边情况也不太好。
王室正集中精力调查幕后黑手是谁。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...All they can do is to sort out the puppets infiltrated into the palace.
But it is better than doing nothing.
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...他们目前能做的，就是清理混入宫殿的间谍。
但这总比什么都不做强。
那么...接下来呢。

scripts.text: Where is Skia?
scripts.translation: 斯基亚在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
She went to hang out with Lord Nyhill!
I don't know what she sees in the pretty boy with no substance.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
她去找尼希尔大人玩了！
我真不知道她看上了那个华而不实的帅哥哪一点。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Could it be...
Could it be that?
Is she enchanted by his looks?
Crux, you answer me!
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
难道说...
难道就是那样吗？
她是被他的外表迷住了吗？
克鲁克斯，你回答我！

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Wha... What? Well...
It sounds plausible...
By the way, Lord Nyhill is under probation so he is not supposed to leave his room.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
什...什么？嗯...
听起来挺有道理的...
顺便说一下，尼希尔大人正处于观察期，按规定是不允许离开房间的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I stand corrected. She went to visit Nyhill in his room.
...Isn't it the same thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好吧，我收回刚才的话。她是去尼希尔的房间探望他了。
...这难道不是一回事吗？

scripts.text: Crux, cheer up...
scripts.translation: 克鲁克斯，振作点...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh, are you leaving now?
It sure is wise of you to leave before the lady's head explodes.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
哦，你现在就要走了吗？
在女士爆发之前离开，真是明智之举啊。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't mind me.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁克斯]
别在意我。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
We'd better move now since the situation doesn't look good.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
情况不妙，我们最好现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are rather slow-footed.
It has been a while since I got the message that you came back.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你的动作真慢。
我收到你回来的消息已经有一会儿了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I invited you for no special reason.
Since they keep calling for meetings to discuss what has happened during the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我邀请你并没有特别的原因。
只是他们一直在召集会议，讨论仪式期间发生的事情。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
There comes lord of the Heine family.
You seem to move around rather freely considering that you are under confinement.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
海尔内家的领主来了。
考虑到你正处于软禁之中，你的行动似乎相当自由。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...?
{0}, I have something to tell you.
And about the confinement, it is OK as long as I stay in the western wing of the royal villa...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...？
{0}，我有件事要告诉你。
至于软禁，只要我待在皇家别墅的西翼，就没问题...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
By the way, Skia? What are you doing?
.......
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
顺便问一下，斯基亚？你在做什么？
.......

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia?
She is not here now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亚？
她现在不在这里。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Oh, this must be it.
The shadow duty.
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
哦，原来如此。
影子职责。
这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
...How could you tell at a glance?
I am busted.
Am I a bad actress?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
...你怎么一眼就看出来了？
我被拆穿了。
我的演技很差吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Even if you are twins, you don't look exactly the same.
I just noticed certain differences.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
即使是双胞胎，你们看起来也不完全一样。
我只是注意到了一些细微的差别。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Really? I am flattered though.
I am glad that you have been looking at me, not Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
真的吗？虽然有点受宠若惊。
很高兴你一直在看我，而不是斯皮卡。

scripts.text: Why are you in that outfit?
scripts.translation: 你为什么穿这身衣服？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... It is to protect Spica who will be the head of the Nerius family.
Sometimes, I stand forward instead of Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯...这是为了保护将成为内里乌斯家族首领的斯皮卡。
有时候，我会代替斯皮卡站出来。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
While my sister learned what the head of the family must know from our mother,
I learned to hide and fight.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
当我的姐姐从母亲那里学习家族首领必须知道的知识时，
我学习的是躲藏和战斗。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That is why people call me the shadow princess.
It is my first time attending an official event in the light.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
这就是为什么人们称我为影子公主。
这是我第一次以公开身份参加正式活动。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Anyways, I am filling in for Spica who has left to run some errands now.
I need to show how she is attending the royal banquet with grace.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
总之，斯皮卡现在出去办事了，我在替她出席。
我需要表现出她优雅地参加皇家宴会的样子。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Thanks to Lady Spica, I get to move around as much as I can now...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
多亏了斯皮卡女士，我现在能自由行动了...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
When will she come back?
The meeting of the representatives has been over...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
她什么时候回来？
代表们的会议已经结束了...

scripts.text: What brought you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么会来这里？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have come to deliver you the message that there is a mission for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我来是给你送个消息，你有任务要执行。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
To be exact, I volunteered since I heard that you were visiting the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
准确地说，是因为听说您要拜访内里乌斯家族，所以我主动请缨的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
It must be about the incident during the ritual, right?
What does the hero have to do with the royal family's business?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
这一定是关于仪式期间发生的那件事吧？
英雄为什么要干涉皇室的私事？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Well, you can ask Spica later.
She was there in the meeting, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
嗯，您可以稍后问问斯皮卡。
她当时就在会议上，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
This conversation is getting too long.
Please go meet my grandfather and father first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这段对话太长了。
请先去见我的祖父和父亲吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
They must be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
他们一定在等您。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... I see. I shall ask Spica to fill me in with the details when she comes back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯...我明白了。等斯皮卡回来，我会让她给我讲讲细节。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Then, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
那么，我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
{0}, please come to see me again later!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
{0}，请稍后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I have to wait for Spica's return and change clothes.
I cannot leave now.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我得等斯皮卡回来换衣服。
我现在不能走。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What would happen when I get out like this and encounter Spica on the way?
We will be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
如果我这样出去，在路上遇到斯皮卡怎么办？
那就糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
What are you doing here, you punk?
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你这朽魔在这里干什么？
在我叫人把你拖出去之前，赶紧滚！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
How did you get in here.
Only the people with permission are allowed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你是怎么进来的？
只有获准的人才能在这里。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
在我叫人把你拖出去之前，赶紧滚！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you the hero invited to the banquet? The Royal Assembly to be exact.
Nice to meet you. I am ^0000cdIan Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你是受邀参加宴会的英雄吗？确切地说是皇家集会。
幸会。我是^0000cd伊恩·沃尔特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Although ^0000cdthe Walther family doesn't participate in the Royal Assembly^000000, we are attending the banquet as one of the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
虽然^0000cd沃尔特家族不参与皇家集会^000000，但我们作为七大皇室家族之一出席了宴会。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
This is the ^0000cdheir of the Walther family, Isenhonor^000000. He is my nephew.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
这位是^0000cd沃尔特家族的继承人，伊森霍纳^000000。他是我的侄子。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He will be the head of the family as he attains adulthood this year. As of now, I am in charge of the family business.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他今年成年，将成为家族首领。目前，由我负责家族事务。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
How do you do? I am ^0000cdIsenhonor Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
您好。我是^0000cd伊森霍纳·沃尔特^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why aren't you participating in the Royal Assembly when there is the heir?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然有继承人，为什么你们不参与皇家集会？

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I wonder of you know this, ^0000cdthe candidate from our family was involved in an unfortunate incident^000000 in the ^0000cdprevious Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
不知道你是否知道，^0000cd我们家族的候选人^000000在^0000cd上一届皇家议会^000000中遭遇了一场不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
^0000cdIsenarm^000000 who was the candidate for the throne acted violently all of a sudden. ^0000cdHe ended up being killed by the heir of the Geoborg family^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
^0000cd伊森阿姆^000000，这位王位候选人突然变得暴力起来。^0000cd最终被格博格家族的继承人杀害了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
After discussion, our family decided not to take part in the ^0000cdRoyal Assembly^000000 this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
经过商议，我们家族决定这次不参与^0000cd皇家集会^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
......

[Ian]
Well then. I hope you enjoy the banquet. The banquet is held for you after all.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
那么。希望您能尽兴。毕竟这场宴会是为您举办的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Thank you for sparing me some time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。感谢您抽出时间。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you enjoying the banquet?
I hope you enjoy the banquet since it is held for you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
您觉得宴会如何？
希望您能尽兴，毕竟这场宴会是为您举办的。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Long time no see, Ian.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好久不见，伊恩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Why are you here? I thought we agreed ^0000cdnot to see each other ever again after the previous Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你怎么在这里？我记得我们约定过，^0000cd在上次皇家集会之后再也不见面^000000。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I remember that, but the heir of your family has been busy these days.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
我记得，但你们家族的继承人最近很忙。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He has been digging around so much that the story has reached me.
No one seems to pay much attention, but you never know.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他一直在四处打听，消息传到了我这里。
虽然似乎没人太在意，但谁也不知道会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I told Isenhonor to ^0000cdstop investigating about his brother's death^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我已经告诉伊森霍纳，^0000cd不要再调查他哥哥的死因^000000。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He should. It would get us both in trouble if the fact that ^0000cdwe were going to kill the imperial candidate of the Geoborg family^000000 leaks out.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他应该这么做。如果^0000cd我们要杀害格博格家族皇室候选人^000000的事情泄露出去，我们两家都会有麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
No one knows about it, you know.
The ^0000cdplan was ruined ^000000as Isenarm was killed while acting violently.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
没人知道这件事，你知道的。
^0000cd计划被破坏了^000000，因为伊森阿姆在暴动时被杀了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I am sorry about your heir.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
对于你们继承人的事，我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I don't care who becomes the heir as long as he leads the family well.
I don't understand why Isenarm who has behaved so well acted that way though...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我不在乎谁成为继承人，只要他能好好领导家族就行。
我不明白伊森阿姆一直表现这么好，为什么会有那样的举动...

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He must have sensed something to act like than when he was about to be elected as the king... There is no way to find out now...
Geoborg has been silent as well ever since, I hear.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他一定察觉到了什么，才会在即将当选国王时那样做...现在已经无法查明了...
听说格博格家族从那以后也一直沉默。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Yes, the word has it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
是的，消息就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Since Isenarm was killed by Geoborg, ^0000cdthe Walther family has been excluded from the Royal Assembly^000000 this time.
He was a great boy. It is a shame since he was the perfect candidate for the throne.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
既然伊森阿姆是被格博格家族杀害的，^0000cd沃尔特家族这次就被排除在皇家集会之外^000000。
他是个优秀的男孩。很遗憾，他本是王位的完美候选人。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
The important thing is that as long as we both keep silent, the truth will remain unknown forever.
Then, I guess we will never see each other again.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
重要的是，只要我们俩都保持沉默，真相就永远无人知晓。
那么，我想我们以后也不会再见面了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Make sure to warn your heir not to dig around the incident, no more.
If it gets out, my family can deny it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
务必警告你的继承人，不要再调查这起事件了。
如果事情败露，我的家族可以否认一切。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
However, you Ian will be in trouble as the same member of the family since there is no witness or proof left now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
不过，伊恩，既然现在没有任何证人或证据，作为同族的你也会陷入麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you threatening me?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你在威胁我吗？

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Shh... You'd better keep your voice down. Your heir may hear you.
I mean, we should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
嘘...你最好小声点。你的继承人可能会听到。
我是说，我们得小心点。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Well, I cannot be absent for so long anyway. Let me head back now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好了，我也不能缺席太久。我先回去了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Argh... How dare...!
I shouldn't have worked with him in the first place. I lost my poor nephew for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
可恶...竟敢...！
我一开始就不该和他合作。我白白失去了我那可怜的外甥。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳·沃尔特]
你看起来行李很多。没事吧？
看起来又多又重。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳·沃尔特]
要不要减少一些？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You must be an adventurer. Thank you for visiting this gloomy place.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
你一定是位冒险者。谢谢你来到这个阴郁的地方。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The representative of our family is over there. I hope you have a good time then.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我们家族的代表在那边。希望你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Isenhonor]
What are you doing here? The Banquet Hall is over there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
你在这里做什么？宴会厅在那边。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was sorry that I didn't get the time to talk to you then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，当时没来得及和你说话。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What story? You mean the story of my brother being killed for his violent behavior? You seemed to hear it so eagerly. I hope you don't believe that bullshit.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
什么故事？你是指我哥哥因暴力行为被杀的故事吗？你听得很认真的样子。我希望你别相信那些鬼话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, well...

[Isenhonor]
I cannot believe that my brother has acted violently. Even if he did, there must have been a ^0000cdreason.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我无法相信我的哥哥会做出暴力的行为。即使他做了，也一定有^0000cd原因^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother, he must have done it for something. No one knows the truth, but people seem to believe the gossip.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我哥哥，他一定是为了某件事才那样做的。没人知道真相，但人们似乎都相信那些谣言。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you want to clear the name of your brother, you can investigate on your own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你想为你哥哥正名，你可以自己去调查。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am trying. But ^0000cdthe elders of my family don't want me to dig out the dishonorable incident^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我正在尝试。但^0000cd我家族的长老们不想让我挖掘那件不光彩的事件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Also, it is impossible to meet ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
而且，要见^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wouldn't he meet you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他不会见你吗？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
No. any access to him is blocked.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
不。所有接触他的途径都被切断了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The ^0000cdGuardian Knight^000000 and ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000 are the only people who know what has happened that day. However it is impossible to meet them. I don't know where to begin...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
只有^0000cd守护骑士^000000和^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000知道那天发生了什么。然而，要见他们是不可能的。我不知道该从哪里开始...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A Guardian Knight? Did your brother have a Guardian Knight?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守护骑士？你哥哥有守护骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Yes. Each member of the Walther family has a Guardian Knight. Our family is in overseas trade so that we often travel by ship.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
是的。沃尔瑟家族的每个成员都有守护骑士。我们家从事海外贸易，经常乘船出行。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you know, the sailors are not a gentle bunch and we tend to carry money with us so that we are often threatened. We all have to bring Guardian Knights with us.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
你也知道，水手们可不是什么温和的人，而且我们身上常带着钱，所以经常受到威胁。因此，我们都必须带上守护骑士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is your Guardian Knight then, Isenhonor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，伊森霍纳，你的守护骑士在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am sick of Guardian Knights since my brother's Guardian Knight abandoned my brother and ran away. I don't want to call them Guardian Knights.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
自从哥哥的守护骑士抛弃了他并逃跑后，我就对守护骑士感到厌烦了。我不想再称他们为守护骑士。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What should I call a Guardian Knight who betrays the master and runs away?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
背叛主人并逃跑的守护骑士，还能叫什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it would be a good idea to start from your Guardian Knight. Since they worked together as Guardian Knight, he must know something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得从你的守护骑士开始调查是个好主意。既然他们曾作为守护骑士一起工作，他一定知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Well, when I asked, he told me he knew nothing. If he did, he must have told me before I even asked.
They were pretty close and often exercised together.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
嗯，当我问他的时候，他说他什么都不知道。如果他知道，肯定在我问之前就会告诉我了。
他们关系很亲密，经常一起训练。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Oh, well, since they were so close, he could have tried to defend his friend.
Why didn't I think of that...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
哦，对了，既然他们关系那么亲密，他可能曾试图为他的朋友辩护。
我怎么没想到这一点...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me talk to him now. If I hear anything, it would be a good thing. Even if I don't get to hear anything it would still count as a try.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我现在去和他谈谈。如果我听到什么，那是好事。即使听不到什么，也算尝试过了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Why would you go through such trouble?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
你为什么要费这么大的劲？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I have a hunch. As an adventurer, my instinct says that there must be something going on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我有一种预感。作为冒险者，我的直觉告诉我一定有什么不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Do all the adventurers count on their hunch like that? This could be dangerous. It is no matter to approach with a hunch.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
所有冒险者都靠预感行事吗？这很危险。仅凭预感去接近情况是不行的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is why it is called an adventure. Adventurers where the adventures are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这就是为什么它被称为冒险。冒险者就是去冒险的。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我不明白。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You may call it a needless meddling out of curiosity. However, I cannot neglect anyone in distress.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以说这是出于好奇心的多管闲事。但是，我不能对处于困境中的人置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I appreciate your help though. I am desperate enough to accept your favor. However, I don't think you wouldn't hear much from the Guardian Knight though.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
不过，我很感激你的帮助。我已经绝望到愿意接受你的好意了。但是，我不认为你能从守护骑士那里听到多少东西。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
If you want to meet him anyway, go to ^0000cdour manor in the south of Alberta^000000. He must be there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
如果你还是想见他，去^0000cd艾尔贝塔南部的我们庄园^000000。他一定在那里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, how did your meeting with the Guardian Knight in Alberta go? Not that I expect too much...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
冒险者，你在艾尔贝塔与守护骑士的会面如何？
虽然我不抱太大希望...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
However, still, I have hoped to hear good news from you...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
不过，我还是希望能从你那里听到好消息...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, you are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
冒险者，你回来了。情况如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I have something for you...
Oh? Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我有东西要给你...
哦？它去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I must have left it back. Let me go bring it for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一定是把它忘在那边了。让我去取来给你。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
你回来了。情况如何？

scripts.text: I told him the story of meeting the Guardian Knight of Isenarm and the conversation with him.
scripts.translation: 我告诉他了与伊森霍纳的守护骑士会面以及谈话的内容。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ^0000cdletter^000000.

[Isenhonor]
Well, this indeed is the seal of our family, and it is my brother's handwriting.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
嗯，这确实是我们家族的印章，而且是我哥哥的笔迹。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you said, my brother's Guardian Knight must have not betrayed my brother.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
正如你所说，我哥哥的守护骑士一定没有背叛他。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother indeed must have done such a thing for a reason.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我哥哥做这种事，一定是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess this is all I can do you now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想，我现在能做的也就这些了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I understand. I should take on from here. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我明白了。接下来该由我接手了。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Please come back anytime when you need the help of the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
如果你需要沃尔瑟家族的帮助，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are a valuable guest for us, the Walther family, from now on, dear adventurer. I'll help you anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
亲爱的冒险者，从今以后，你都是我们沃尔瑟家族尊贵的客人。只要你愿意，我会随时帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Based on the piece of information you have brought me, I am collecting other information too. It is not enough year, but I believe that I can unveil the truth someday.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
根据你带来的线索，我也在收集其他信息。虽然还不够，但我相信总有一天能揭开真相。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I called Simon from Alberta. I need to gather all the help I can get now.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
我联系了艾尔贝塔的西蒙。现在我需要召集所有能得到的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I will see you again when the truth is revealed.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
等真相大白时，我们再见面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I am looking for the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor. Where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我在找伊森霍纳的守护骑士。我能在哪里找到他？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am his Guardian Knight. What's the matter? Has anything happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我就是他的守护骑士。怎么了？他出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I shouldn't have stayed behind. Is he all right?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我不该留在这里。他没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Kidnapping? Injury? Robbery? Fall? What is it? Oh, I should go there now...!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
绑架？受伤？抢劫？摔倒了？到底怎么了？噢，我现在就赶过去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. Isenhonor is all right. Nothing happened. I am here to ask you something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。伊森霍纳没事。什么都没发生。我来是想问你点事。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Phew, I guess it wasn't my lord who called me. I am still glad that I is OK.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
呼，看来不是我家主人叫我来。还好他没事。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
What are you going to ask me? Well, who are you by the way?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你想问什么？对了，顺便问一下，你是谁？

scripts.text: [I told him the conversation with Isenhonor in the palace briefly.]
scripts.translation: [我把在宫中与伊森霍纳的对话简要告诉了他。]

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Oh, sorry about that. I am ^0000cdSimon Walther Marshall^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
噢，抱歉。我是^0000cd西蒙·瓦尔特·马歇尔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I don't know the whereabouts of ^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000 who used to be the Guardian Knight of Isenarm, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
不幸的是，我不知道^0000cd凯恩·瓦尔特·沃克^000000的下落，他曾是伊森霍纳的守护骑士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You both have Walther in your names. Is there a special reason for it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们的名字里都有“瓦尔特”。这是有什么特殊原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Every knight belongs to the Walther who is assigned to a member of the Walther family is given the name, Walther.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
每一位骑士都隶属于瓦尔特家族。被指派给瓦尔特家族成员的骑士，都会被赐予“瓦尔特”这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
The name gives a sense of belonging. Also it gives us the pride to have been recognized as excellent knights.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
这个名字赋予了我们归属感。同时也让我们引以为傲，因为这意味着我们被认可为优秀的骑士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right. By the way, did you say that you know nothing about Kain Walther Walker?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。对了，你刚才说不知道凯恩·瓦尔特·沃克的下落？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
No, I don't.
However...
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
不，我不知道。
不过...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However...?

[Simon]
I heard a ^0000cdstrange gossip^000000 from some of the knights there when I escorted Isenhonor to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
当我护送伊森霍纳去宫殿时，我听到那里的一些骑士在传^0000cd奇怪的流言^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
They heard ^0000cda pickpocket locked in the basement of the palace^000000 babbling about how he had seen a person from the Walther family in a foreign country.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
他们听说^0000cd一个被锁在宫殿地下室的小偷^000000在胡言乱语，说他曾在外国见过一位瓦尔特家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
However, no family member left the country due to the royal banquet. It was strange to hear that. I think that person could be ^0000cdKain^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
然而，由于皇家宴会，没有家族成员离开过国家。听到这话很奇怪。我想那个人可能是^0000cd凯恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I wanted to investigate myself considering the importance of the matter. But Isenhonor ordered me to go back to Alberta so I had to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
考虑到事情的重要性，我想亲自调查。但伊森霍纳命令我回艾尔贝塔，所以我不得不回来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The pickpocket in the underground prison?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
地下监狱里的小偷？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Yes. I don't know his real name, but he is called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 in the underworld.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
是的。我不知道他的真名，但他在地底下被称为^0000cd大脚怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Minor offenders like pickpockets are usually locked in this other place. But that guy was caught pickpocketing in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
像扒手这种小罪犯通常会被关在别的地方。但那个人是在阿鲁纳菲兹被抓的。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Due to diplomatic issues, we have taken his custody and locked him in the underground prison.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
由于外交问题，我们接管了他的羁押权，并将他关进了地下监狱。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
That guy seems to have a lot of information from all over the continent. Even when his words about seen the person of the Walther family wasn't true, I felt that I could get useful information from him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那个人似乎掌握着来自大陆各地的许多情报。即使他声称见过瓦尔特家族的人这句话不属实，我也觉得从他那里能获取有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whether the information he has is true or not, I would rather go visit him. Thank you for the information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管他掌握的情报是否属实，我还是想去拜访一下他。谢谢你的情报。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Please say hello to my master when you get back to the palace. Tell him that I will be guarding this place well.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
回到宫殿后，请代我向师父问好。告诉他我会好好守护这里的。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
And, let him know that he can call me anytime. I would gladly go there to guard him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
还有，告诉他随时都可以叫我。我很乐意过去守护他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll let him know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我一定转告他。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Have a safe trip then!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那么，祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Simon]
How did your visit to the prison go?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你去监狱的拜访怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
You can go see the convict called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 locked in the ^0000cdUnderground prison of the palace^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你可以去见见被关在^0000cd宫殿地下监狱^000000的犯人^0000cd大脚怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Didn't you hear anything else from Isenhonor? Please extend my greetings to him when you go to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你没有从伊森霍纳那里听到其他消息吗？去普隆德拉时请代我向他问好。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Dear adventurer! At last, Master Isenhonor called me! I am happy that I can guard my lord nearby.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
亲爱的冒险者！终于，师父伊森霍纳叫我了！我很高兴能在他身边守护他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Glad to hear that. Then what are you doing here now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听到这个消息真好。那你现在在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am waiting for the ship to Izlude. I will rush to the ship when it comes here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我在等去依斯鲁得岛的船。船一到我就赶过去。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I have a lot of questions for you, but I guess I'd better hear the story from my master. Then dear adventurer, have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我有许多问题想问你，但我想还是听师父讲述比较好。那么，亲爱的冒险者，祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
What if anything happens to my master while I am gone...
Shall I leave for Prontera now?
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
如果我不在的时候师父出了什么事...
我现在就出发去普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
No, he will be mad at me.
He will call me someday. Let's wait here.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
不，他会生我的气。
总有一天他会叫我的。就在这里等着吧。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Just a little more.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
再等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
What a fine day. However, the house feels to empty and lonely.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
今天天气真好。不过，这宅邸感觉有些空旷和寂寞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? Is this the manor of the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？这里是瓦尔特家族的宅邸吗？

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Yes, it is. What brought you here. Since everyone has left for Prontera, you cannot meet the master now.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
是的，没错。您找谁？
既然大家都去普隆德拉了，您现在见不到主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isenhonor has sent me here to meet the Guardian Knight.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是伊森霍纳派我来的，我要见守护骑士。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Oh, really? He has been waiting for Isenhonor's call so much! I am happy for him.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
哦，真的吗？
他一直很期待伊森霍纳的召唤！真为他高兴。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Simon, the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor is near the ^0000cddock^000000 where the ship leaving for ^0000cdIzlude^000000 is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
伊森霍纳的守护骑士西蒙，就在停泊着前往^0000cd依斯鲁得岛^000000船只的^0000cd码头^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
He is waiting there to go to Prontera as soon as possible when Isenhonor calls him.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
他在那里等着，一旦伊森霍纳召唤他，他就立刻动身去普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Go to where the ship to Izlude is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
去停泊着前往依斯鲁得岛船只的码头吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Mahatra Mornen, the butler of the Alkish family, I cannot take his arrogance anymore.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
阿尔基什家的管家玛哈特拉·莫伦，
我实在受不了他那副傲慢的样子了。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They only own a manor. And they call themselves as the best family in Alberta? What do they think of the Walther family!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
他们不过是有座宅邸罢了，
竟然自称是艾尔贝塔最尊贵的家族？他们怎么看待沃尔特家族啊！

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They cannot even make eye contact when they meet us.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
见到我们时，他们连眼神都不敢接触。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Our master is just too gentle to leave them alone. How classless.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特家的管家]
我们的主人太温和了，才会任由他们这样。
真是毫无教养。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
炸鸡、烤土豆、啤酒、新鲜奶酪...哈...
被关在这种地方，我现在特别渴望这些家常菜。
谁要是把这些带给我，我就娶谁。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified!
But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
啊！又来了！好可怕！
不过只要我被关在这里，就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
炸鸡、烤土豆、啤酒、新鲜奶酪...哈...
被关在这种地方，我现在特别渴望这些家常菜。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
谁要是把这些带给我，我就娶谁。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified! But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
啊！又来了！好可怕！不过只要我被关在这里，就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bigfoot?

[Bigfoot]
Oh no! I won't eat that! I don't want to have another bite of that pigs feed! I may not be a gourmet, but my tongue hasn't been decomposed or anything!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
不行！我不吃那个！
我才不想再吃一口那种猪食！
我虽然算不上美食家，但我的舌头还没烂掉呢！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me something I can eat! I know that I am locked in the prison, but I deserve to eat something edible!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
给我带点能吃的东西来！
我知道我被关在监狱里，但我有权吃点像样的食物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There must have been a misunderstanding. I am not the warden here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里肯定有什么误会。我不是这里的狱卒，我是来找你的。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You are now? I am relieved to hear that. The food here just sucks.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
是吗？那我就放心了。
这里的食物真难吃。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Who are you by the way? You look like an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
话说回来，你是谁？
你看起来像个冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, it is not important. You are here to ask me something, right? You know nothing in this world is free.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
算了，这不重要。
你来这里肯定是想问点什么吧？
要知道，这世上没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What do you want?

[Bigfoot]
Get me out of here.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
把我弄出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It would be beyond my ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这超出了我的能力范围。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't be such a perfectionist. You must be of a high rank to come down here, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
别那么死板。
你能来这种地方，地位肯定不低吧？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, I understand. I knew it was a difficult favor to ask anyway.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
嗯，我理解。
本来就知道这是个很难开的口。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I didn't think you would let me out. I just got it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我没指望你真能放我出去。
只是随口说说而已。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, you turned it down so firmly. You could at least pretend to consider or think about it.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
不过你拒绝得也太干脆了。
至少可以假装考虑一下嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you really want then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你到底想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Money of course. The price depends on the information you want.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
当然是钱。
价格取决于你想要什么资讯。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't offer a monthly installment plan. I only take cash. I only accept currencies older than 2 years. I'll spend it meaningfully when I get out here in the future.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我不接受分期付款。
只收现金，而且只要流通超过两年的旧币。
等我以后出去了，会好好花掉它们的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have much money, but I know where to spend it. I guess I should turn down the deal. Goodbye then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没多少钱，但我知道该花在哪。
看来这笔交易做不成了。再见。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey! Don't take the joke too seriously. Don't your friends call you stubborn?
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
嘿！别太当真了。
你朋友是不是都叫你“固执”？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I knew it. You give up too easily. You are still young, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我就知道。
你放弃得太容易了。
你还年轻，知道吗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请说重点。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, you remind me of something...
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
嗯，你让我想起一件事...

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Yes! Bring me fried spicy dumplings and green salad! That's right! Bring me that.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
对了！给我带点炸辣饺和绿色沙拉来！
没错！就带这些来。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I cannot eat the horrible food here much so I keep thinking about the food out there.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
这里的食物太难吃了，我根本吃不下，
所以总是想着外面的美食。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What I crave the most is that. Would you do this for me at least? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我最渴望的就是那个。
至少这一点你能帮我吧？
^0000cd三份炸辣饺和一份绿色沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that. Wait for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以做到。等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to tell me to wait. I cannot go anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你不用让我等。我哪里也去不了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Wait, you stop there for a moment.
I don't smell the greasy dumplings and fresh salad at all.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
等等，你在那儿停一下。
我完全闻不到炸辣饺和新鲜植物的味道。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you bring the food? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你带食物来了吗？^0000cd三份炸辣饺和一份绿色沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I won't talk before you bring them to me! Check again and bring them!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
在你把它们带给我之前，我不会说话！再检查一下，把它们带过来！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I smell it! This smell! Take out what you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我闻到了！这个味道！把你带来的东西拿出来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are.

[Bigfoot]
Oh, my love. I'll enjoy every bite of it. Well, ask me the question now.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
哦，我的爱。我会享受每一口。好了，现在问你的问题吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you saw a person of the Walther family in a foreign country. Where did you see him? How did you know that he was from the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说你在外国看到了沃尔瑟家族的人。你在哪里看到他的？你怎么知道他是沃尔瑟家族的人？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, you wanted to know that. As you know, it is rare to see seafarer Walthers in other places of Rune-Midgarts, except Alberta and Prontera.
They are good at hiding their identities other than those who are well known.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
哦，你想知道这个。如你所知，在卢恩·米德加兹的其他地方，除了艾尔贝塔和普隆德拉，很少见到海员沃尔瑟。
除了那些出名的人，他们很擅长隐藏身份。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, I saw the distinctive symbol of the family in ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
然而，我在^0000cd伯仁斯^000000看到了该家族独特的标志。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Veins? Who did you see there? And how?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
伯仁斯？你在那里看到了谁？怎么看到的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't know who he is. I was working as always. You know you have to work to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我不知道他是谁。我像往常一样工作。你知道，为了生计必须工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是说偷窃？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to be so specific about it. Don't you want to hear the story? Well, don't worry. I do have a sense of honor. I'll keep my promise to you who has brought me the dumplings.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你不必说得那么具体。你不想听故事吗？好吧，别担心。我有荣誉感。我会遵守向给我带炸辣饺的你许下的承诺。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, I found a shabby man who seemed so defenseless in the market there. His wallet was fat. So I took it and went off.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
总之，我在市场里发现了一个衣衫褴褛的男人，看起来毫无防备。他的钱包很鼓。所以我拿了它就走。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I opened the wallet in a secluded corner of the market. He turned out to be quite loaded. And I found an ^0000cdold letter^000000 in there. The one stamped with the ^0000cdseal^000000, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
我在市场的一个偏僻角落打开了钱包。他原来很有钱。我在里面发现了一封^0000cd旧信^000000。就是盖有^0000cd海豹宝宝^000000印章的那封，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The fact that he had the letter doesn't prove that he was a person from the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他拥有那封信并不能证明他是沃尔瑟家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, I am getting there. After checking what was in the wallet, I was going to call it a day. I had earned enough.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
嘿，我快说到重点了。检查完钱包里的东西后，我打算收工。我已经赚够了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Then, that shabby man appeared.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
然后，那个衣衫褴褛的男人出现了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't have to tell you the rest of the story, right? Whoa... I thought I was fighting three men at the same time. His fist was like...! Phew... When he was punching me, I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
剩下的故事不用我多说了吧？天哪...我以为我在同时和三个人打架。他的拳头简直像...！呼...他打我的时候，我看到了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
There was a hidden ^0000cdsword^000000 under his cloak. The ^0000cdhandle was engraved with the symbol^000000. You see, well. Do you believe my story now?
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
他的斗篷下藏着一把^0000cd剑^000000。^0000cd剑柄上刻着那个符号^000000。你看，嗯。现在你相信我的故事了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you manage to see that when you were beaten up so bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你被打得那么惨，是怎么看清的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, have some faith. Don't you know what I do for living?
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
噢，要有信心。你不知道我是靠什么谋生的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是说偷窃？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, don't be so specific, please!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
嘿，请不要说得那么具体！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, my profession required a sharp eye to catch whatever is significant at a glance. That's how I thrive in this field.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
总之，我的职业需要敏锐的眼睛，一眼就能抓住重点。这就是我在这个领域生存的方式。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
When I see a person, I need to identify the position of the wallet, any weapon in possession, the target's wits and how fast the target can run in a moment. This job required such a special quality.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
看到一个人时，我需要在瞬间判断钱包的位置、是否持有武器、对方的智商以及逃跑速度。这份工作需要这种特殊的能力。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to believe me, but you can trust my professional skill.
Well, you must have hidden your money inside the belt and your shoes. Nice work. Those are tough spots to steal from.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你不必相信我，但你可以信任我的专业技能。
嗯，你肯定把钱藏在腰带和长靴里了。干得漂亮。那些地方很难偷窃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I guess I can trust your skill.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我可以相信你的技术。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways, it sure seems suspicious. Thank you for your information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，这确实很可疑。谢谢你的资讯。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't you need anything else? I want to have some dessert now.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你不需要别的了吗？我现在想吃点甜点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. This is enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。这就够了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, no! Dessert! My dessert!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
哦，不！甜点！我的甜点！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What is it? Did you change your mind?
Do you want more information? I'd really like to have some Mastela Fruit Wine.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
怎么了？你改变主意了？
你想了解更多资讯吗？我真的很想要一些玛丝黛拉果酒。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you forget where to go?
You should go to ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
你忘了要去哪了吗？
你应该去^0000cd伯仁斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me some dessert when you come back!
scripts.translation:
[大脚怪]
回来时给我带点甜点！

scripts.text:
[K]
You seem to carry a heavy burden.
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你看起来背负着沉重的负担。
要不要减轻一些？

scripts.text:
[K]
I want to go back...
There again...
scripts.translation:
[K]
我想回去...
但是...

scripts.text:
[K]
Who are you? Why are you staring at me? Are you after my wallet too?
It hasn't been long since I sent a person who stole my wallet to the prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你是谁？为什么盯着我看？你也是来抢我钱包的吗？
我刚把一个偷我钱包的人送进了监狱。

scripts.text:
[K]
I guess no such information is shared among the pickpockets. Get lost if you don't want to be sent to prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我想，这种资讯在小偷之间是不共享的。如果你不想被送进监狱，就滚开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are quite quick-tempered, aren't you.
^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你脾气真暴躁啊。
^0000cd凯因·瓦尔特·沃克^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
I don't know such name.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我不认识这个名字。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The one who betrayed his master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
背叛师父的人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Who... Who are you? Reveal yourself!
Why are you telling me such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你...你是谁？报上名来！
你为什么要告诉我这些？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
People say that. I don't buy it though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人们都这么说。但我并不相信。

scripts.text:
[K]
Why don't you believe it? Why? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你为什么不相信？为什么？你知道些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are the one who knows the truth, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道真相的人是你，凯因·瓦尔特·沃克。

scripts.text:
[K]
Tell me. Who are you? Do you know anything about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
告诉我。你是谁？你知道伊森亚姆死因的真相吗？

scripts.text:
[K]
Your life depends on your answer. I have enough reason to kill you since you know who I am.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你的性命取决于你的回答。既然你知道我是谁，我杀你理由充分。

scripts.text:
[K]
Well, tell me.
Who are you? How did you find me? And what do you know about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
好吧，告诉我。
你是谁？你怎么找到我的？还有，你知道伊森亚姆死因的什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am asked to investigate the death of Isenarm by Isenhonor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受伊森霍纳之托，调查伊森亚姆的死因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While carrying out the investigation, I got the information that you would be here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在调查过程中，我得知你会在这里。所以我来这里见你。

scripts.text:
[K]
Isenhonor? At last, he is in action!
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍纳？终于，他行动起来了！

scripts.text:
[K]
Oh, please excuse my bad manners. I am sorry. Please forgive my earlier behavior.
scripts.translation:
[K]
啊，请原谅我的无礼。我很抱歉。请原谅我刚才的态度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's OK. It wouldn't hurt to be careful, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。小心一点也好，凯因·瓦尔特·沃克。

scripts.text:
[K]
I cannot use the name, Walther, anymore.
When a star disappears, its satellite shall lost its name too. Even worse, I am a sinner who haven't been able to my star.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我不能再用“瓦尔特”这个名字了。
当星星消失时，它的卫星也会失去名字。更糟糕的是，我是一个连星星都无法触及的罪人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is Isenhonor investigating the death of Isenarm? I will do my best to help him by his side.
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍纳在调查伊森亚姆的死因？我会尽我所能在他身边协助他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet. Isenhonor wants to know the truth behind his brother's death, but he is not in the position to carry out the investigation due to the circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还没有。伊森霍纳想知道他弟弟死因的真相，但由于情况特殊，他无法亲自进行调查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's why I, who is relatively free to move around, am is doing the research for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以我，这个行动相对自由的人，正在替他进行调查。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is that so... Then what can I do to help you? I'll do whatever I can do to reveal the truth.
scripts.translation:
[K]
原来如此...那我能为你们做什么？我会尽我所能揭露真相。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can tell me what happened when you were with Isenarm. Why you disappeared before Isenarm's death, why you are here and all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以告诉我当时和伊森亚姆在一起时发生了什么。为什么你在伊森亚姆死前失踪了，为什么你会在这里，等等。

scripts.text:
[K]
In fact I know nothing about his death myself. However, he ^0000cdsent me here with a mission^000000 before incident broke out.
scripts.translation:
[K]
事实上，关于他的死，我自己也一无所知。不过，在事件爆发之前，他^0000cd曾派我执行一项任务^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
When I was going to go back after completing the mission, he sent me a lot of money and a ^0000cdletter^000000. It said ^0000cdnot to return to Rune-Midgarts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[K]
当我完成任务准备返回时，他寄来了很多钱和一封^0000cd信件^000000。信中写道^0000cd不要返回卢恩·米德加兹^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then?

[K]
I heard the news of his death after few days. I wanted to go back, but I couldn't because of his last order. I couldn't even be there by his side...
scripts.translation:
[K]
几天后，我听到了他去世的消息。我想回去，但因为他的最后命令，我无法回去。我甚至没能陪在他身边...

scripts.text:
[K]
After a long time, I heard the rumor about the violent behavior which caused Isenarm to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[K]
过了很久，我听到了关于伊森亚姆因暴力行为而被杀的传闻。

scripts.text:
[K]
And also the story of the Guardian Knight who betrayed his master...
scripts.translation:
[K]
还有那个背叛了师父的守护骑士的故事...

scripts.text:
[K]
When I became a wanted man, I wanted to back and tell the truth. However, the letter said ^0000cdnot to return no matter what^000000. I couldn't let down the last order given by my master.
scripts.translation:
[K]
当我成为通缉犯时，我曾想回去说出真相。但那封信上写着^0000cd无论如何都不要回来^000000。我不能违背师父下达的最后命令。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess Isenarm didn't want you to be involved. If anything happened to him, you would have been the one in the biggest trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想伊森亚姆是不想让你卷入其中。如果出了什么事，你会陷入最大的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[K]
Ha... Perhaps... I didn't think of that... Here are the ^0000cdletter and sword Isenarm^000000 has give me.
scripts.translation:
[K]
哈...也许...我没想过这一点...这是^0000cd伊森亚姆^000000给我的信件和剑。

scripts.text:
[K]
Please give them to Isenhonor. I hope they help him recover his brother's honor.
scripts.translation:
[K]
请把它们交给伊森霍纳。我希望这能帮他恢复他兄弟的名誉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Keep the sword. The sword is like the life of the knight. I believe Isenarm would want you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
留着剑吧。剑就像骑士的生命。我相信伊森亚姆会希望你拥有它。

scripts.text:
[K]
Then, have a safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[K]
那么，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[K]
Did you deliver the letter and the words to Isenhonor well?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你顺利地把信件和话转达给伊森霍纳了吗？

scripts.text:
[K]
Please let him know that I am ready to devote my life if he needs my help.
scripts.translation:
[K]
请告诉他，如果他的需要，我随时准备献出生命。

scripts.text:
He is lying in bed, deeply wounded.
It doesn't seem that he is in the state to talk.
scripts.translation:
他躺在床上，伤势严重。
看起来他现在的状态不适合交谈。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
How disrespectful of you to enter without permission.
Get out of here now.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
未经允许就闯入，真是无礼。
现在立刻离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please, calm down.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
请冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Why don't you enjoy the banquet?
Nyhill went to the Banquet Hall too.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你不去享受宴会吗？
尼希尔也去了宴会厅。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He didn't make a good first impression, but he is not a bad kid...
He is just...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他给人的第一印象不太好，但他并不是个坏孩子...
他只是...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Well, I guess I shouldn't talk more.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我想，我不该再多说了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here at last.
The archduke has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你终于来了。
大公一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem said he would visit your room after making all preparations. You may wait in your room.
We are counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆说，等一切准备就绪后，他会去你的房间。你可以在房间里稍作休息。
我们对你寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I have heard the story from my father.
I have received the approval for you to access the Past Memories of the Royal Family freely.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我从父亲那里听说了这件事。
我已批准你自由查阅王室的过去记忆。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Let's talk about the Past Memories of the Royal Family tomorrow
Since you must be tired going through all the trouble today.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
关于王室的过去记忆，我们明天再谈吧。
毕竟你今天已经费了不少心力，一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Are you going back to that place?
Nillem has told me.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你又要去那个地方了吗？
尼勒姆跟我提过了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That it is difficult for him to connect multiple times since he is just a human after all.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
毕竟他只是个普通人，很难多次进行连接。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I appreciate your efforts for the royal family.
But don't push yourself too hard.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我很感激你为王室所做的努力。
但请不要太勉强自己。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here, just in time.
Are you going there again today?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你来得正好。
今天又要去那里吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I see.
...Oh, do you know what Nyhill is doing?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我明白了。
...哦，你知道尼希尔在做什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
.....Never mind.
He must be staying quietly since he has been sentenced to disciplinary confinement.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
......算了。
既然他被判处禁闭，应该正在安静地待着吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Sorry about all the trouble.
I hope it works this time.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。
希望这次能顺利。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please save the piece of Ymir Heart from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
请从瓦尔基里手中夺回尤弥尔之心碎片。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
...I know it is almost impossible to change the past.
But there is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...我知道改变过去几乎是不可能的。
但除此之外别无他法。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We need to try everything we can do.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我们必须尝试一切可能的方法。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
While you are on a mission down there, we are proceeding with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
当你在下面执行任务时，我们将继续进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We are searching for the lead to the intruders.
Let's play our parts well.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我们正在寻找入侵者的线索。
让我们各司其职吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem must be waiting for you.
Please do your best as always.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆一定在等你。
请像往常一样尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are back.
Is it the same this time?
I suppose so.
But, I really don't think all the efforts will go wasted.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你回来了。
这次也是一样的结果吗？
我想是的。
但我真的不认为所有的努力都会白费。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Thank you very much.
Someday, when you need the power of our family,
We will be on your side no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
非常感谢。
总有一天，当你需要海尔内家族的力量时，
无论发生什么，我们都会站在你这边。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That is all we can give you for now as the reward.
I am sorry that we cannot offer you more.
I'll make sure there is no inconvenience to you while living in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
目前我们只能给你这些作为奖励。
很抱歉我们无法提供更多。
我会确保你在宫殿里生活时不会受到任何不便。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
See you tomorrow then.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
那么明天见。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
You must be the returned hero invited to the banquet.
This banquet is for you. Please enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
您一定是受邀参加宴会的归来之英雄。
这场宴会就是为您准备的。请尽情享用。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Haha... The archduke must be very angry.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
哈哈...大公大人一定很生气吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I have participated in the Royal Assembly, but I wonder if it has been the right decision.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我参加了皇家议会，但我不确定这是否是正确的决定。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I tried to do this for everyone, but it seems to cause trouble.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我本想为大家做点什么，但看来反而惹了麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
People tells me that I am a strong candidate in this, but I cannot be so sure.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
人们说我是这个职位的有力候选人，但我自己也不敢确定。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I keep thinking about what a great responsibility it is, how harder I should try and all...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我一直在想，这是一份多么重大的责任，我应该更加努力地尝试...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Not that I can step back now. I guess all I can do is to do my best.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
不过现在我也无法退缩了。我想我能做的，就是尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have never allowed your visit.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我从未允许你来访。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am busy.
Please come back later
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我很忙。
请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
...It was a shame to cause such a scene
In front of a guest.
I apologize on the behalf of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
...在客人面前造成这样的场面，真是遗憾。
我代表海尔内家族向您道歉。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Let me introduce myself.
I am the current head of the Heine family, Friedrich Stoltze Heine.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
请允许我自我介绍。
我是海尔内家族的现任家主，弗里德里希·施托尔策·海尔内。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
This is the former head of the family, Archduke Grantz, my father.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
这位是家族的前任家主，格兰茨大公，我的父亲。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
My name is Kronecker Grantz Heine.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我叫克罗内克·格兰茨·海尔内。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich Stoltze]
This is Peter Heine the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希·施托尔策]
这位是王位候选人，彼得·海尔内。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Nice to meet you.
It has turned out this way.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高兴见到您。
事情竟然变成了这样。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
The one who has left the room, making a fool of himself, is my son, Nyhill.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
刚才离席出丑的那位，是我的儿子，尼希尔。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He is a lineal family member of the Heine family.
But he still acts like a child like that.
Please excuse his bad manners.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他是海尔内家族的直系成员。
但他还是像孩子一样行事。
请原谅他的无礼。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Let him do whatever he pleases.
We cannot take care of him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
随他去吧。
我们已经无法再管他了。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
...Archduke, please don't be too harsh on Nyhill.
In fact, Nyhill was supposed to be the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
...大公，请不要对尼希尔太苛刻。
事实上，尼希尔原本才是王位的候选人。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am just a collateral member of the family after all...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
毕竟，我只是家族的一个旁系成员...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Stop it there. There is no need for more words.
Nyhill doesn't have what it takes to be the king.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
到此为止吧。不必再多说了。
尼希尔没有成为国王的资质。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
He doesn't have any elements to meet the legitimacy of the family. He cannot be chosen as the candidate.
He doesn't even know where he stands but still seems so hungry for power.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
他缺乏符合家族正统性的要素，无法被选为候选人。
他连自己的立场都不清楚，却似乎对权力充满渴望。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
It doesn't seem that way...
He must have been disheartened since his right has been neglected.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
事情似乎并非如此...
他的权利被忽视，一定让他感到沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The right of the Heine family is everything which comes with the name of Heine.
Nyhill has everything.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
海尔内家族的权利，就是伴随海尔内之名而来的一切。
尼希尔拥有一切。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Why doesn't that child realize it?
It is not appropriate to talk about the family matter in front of the guest.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
为什么那个孩子意识不到这一点？
在客人面前谈论家族事务是不合适的。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Sorry about that.
Phew... I wonder what we have done to deserve a punk like that in the family.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
抱歉。
唉...我们到底做了什么，才会让家族里出现这样一个朽魔。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have heard that you are the one who would attend the ritual.
Gratefully enough, the next king might be from the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我听说，将会是你出席仪式。
谢天谢地，下一任国王可能会出自海尔内家族。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
In the Royal Assembly earlier in which the candidates for the throne were tested...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
在之前举行的皇家集会上，王位候选人接受了测试...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Isenarm of the Walther family who happened to be the strongest candidate of all threatened other candidates all of a sudden.
Ernst of the Geoborg family had to execute him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
瓦尔特家族的伊森纳姆，作为最强的候选人，突然威胁了其他候选人。
格博格家族的恩斯特不得不处决了他。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
