It seemed that Ernst was going to be named the next king, but he abruptly resigned.
...I guess he obeyed the will of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
看起来恩斯特将被立为下一任国王，但他突然退位了。
...我想他是遵从了女王的意愿。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Due to the course of events, the Royal Assembly would be held again.
This time, Peter will participate as the representative of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
由于事态发展，皇家集会将再次举行。
这一次，彼得将作为海尔内家族的代表参加。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And that Nyhill is so jealous of him now.
How low can he be?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
而尼希尔现在对他如此嫉妒。
他怎么能这么卑鄙？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Hum... He actually is not a bad kid unlike his earlier words.
He has never acted to bring disgrace to the name of Heine.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
嗯...他其实并不是个坏孩子，尽管他之前说了那样的话。
他从未做过任何损害海尔内家族名誉的事。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I am not trying to defend him because he is my son.
Nyhill, he is just...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我并不是因为他是我的儿子才为他辩护。
尼希尔，他只是...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Don't try to speak for him. His incompetence is a sin.
Great magical power runs in the Heine for generations.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
不要替他说话。他的无能是一种罪过。
强大的魔力在海尔内家族中代代相传。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
There is a reason that he is called Mijeria.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
他被称为米杰莉亚是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Don't be overly curious of our family matter.
Phew... I guess I will see you again later.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
请不要对我们家族的事务过于好奇。
唉...我想我们稍后再见。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The Royal Assembly will be over soon, and the ritual will be carried out when the final decision is made.
Enjoy the banquet until then and participate in the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
皇家议会即将结束，最终决定做出后，仪式就会开始。
在此之前，请尽情享用宴会，并参与仪式。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
It wouldn't long before Royal Assembly is over.
We have to prepare for it. Sorry that we cannot spend more time with you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
皇家议会马上就要结束了。
我们必须为此做准备。抱歉，我们不能陪您更久。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Go visit other families if you have not visited them all.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
如果您还没有拜访过所有家族，请去拜访一下。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The Royal Assembly will be over soon.
As we expected, Peter seems to be a strong candidate.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
皇家议会即将结束。
正如我们所料，彼得似乎是一位强有力的候选人。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
How are you enjoying the banquet?
As soon as the Royal Assembly is completed, we will move to proceed with the final ritual...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
您觉得宴会如何？
一旦皇家议会结束，我们将立即着手进行最后的仪式...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I'll send you a Court Mage.
Enjoy the banquet and go back to your room in time.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我会派一名宫廷魔法师给您。
请尽情享用宴会，并按时回到您的房间。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have been waiting for you.
Although I feel reluctant to reveal somewhat embarrassing part of the royal family to you,
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我一直在等您。
虽然我不太愿意向您透露皇室某些令人尴尬的往事，

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It was the royal family of Rune-Midgarts who let you observe the ritual anyway.
And you were the one who fought the intruders during the incident...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
是卢恩·米德加兹的皇室让您有机会见证这场仪式的。
而且，在事件发生时，是您击退了入侵者...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Without preamble,
Those intruders must have been after the^4d4dff piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
开门见山地说，
那些入侵者一定是冲着^4d4dff伊米尔之心碎片^000000来的。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We didn't know what was in the Room of Consciousness was ^4d4dffa fake piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们不知道意识之室里的是^4d4dff伊米尔之心的赝品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We searched through the records of ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 for the record of that part.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们查阅了^4d4dff皇室过往记忆^000000的记录，寻找关于那部分的信息。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We couldn't find any.
The only lead we got was a riddle.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们什么也没找到。
唯一的线索是一个谜题。

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说，那些知道真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
You must have seen it in the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
You are more cunning than I have thought of you.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
您一定是在皇室的过往记忆中看到了它。
您比我想象中更聪明。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What should we do to find out the truth?
We would have to go back in the time to the past.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们要怎样才能查明真相？
我们必须回到过去的时光。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Frietz, how did it go?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
弗里茨，情况如何？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I found a Court Mage who specialized in that field.
He said that ^4d4dffhe sensed a huge twist of magical force in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, and we could depend on him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我找到了一位精通该领域的宫廷魔法师。
他说^4d4dff他在皇室的过往记忆中感受到了巨大的魔力扭曲，我们可以依靠他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He will bring the result soon.
He said he would connect the crack of the dimension by force.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他很快就会带来结果。
他说他会强行连接维度的裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He acts rather imprudently, but he is said to be quite skilled...
And you know him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他行事有些鲁莽，但据说技艺高超...
而且您认识他。

scripts.text: Is he Nillem?
scripts.translation: 是尼勒姆吗？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You seem to know him too.
You're right.
I want you to pair up with Nillem for this mission.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
看来您也认识他。
没错。
我希望您能与尼勒姆搭档执行这项任务。

scripts.text: Me? Why?
scripts.translation: 我？为什么？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I'd like know that myself.
That Nillem pestered me to let him work with you.
...I tried my best not to slay him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我也想知道为什么。
是尼勒姆缠着我，非要和你搭档。
...我尽力没把他给杀了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
The Past Memories of the Royal Family is a special place which can be accessed by the royal families and few other people.
We cannot risk getting more people involved in this to keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
皇室的过往记忆是一个特殊的地方，只有皇室成员和极少数人才能进入。
为了保守秘密，我们不能冒风险让太多人卷入其中。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Sine you have already experienced the crack of dimension...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
既然你已经经历过维度的裂缝...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We didn't have any other choices.
We will reward you handsomely. Please help us out.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我们别无选择。
我们会给予你丰厚的报酬。请帮帮我们。

scripts.text: If you say so...
scripts.translation: 既然你这么说...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Them, it's settled.
We will send Nillem to your room as soon as he is ready.
You may pair up with him for the mission.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那么，就这么定了。
尼勒姆准备好后，我们会让他去你的房间。
你可以和他搭档执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And this is what has been given to the ones contributed to the royal family.
You have received it once when you went down there right after you came to the palace. Do you remember?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
这是给予为皇室做出贡献的人的礼物。
你刚来宫殿时下去过一次，当时也收到过。你还记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It must be useful to people like you.
I hope it helps.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
这东西对你这样的人应该很有用。
希望能帮到你。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The magician called Nillem will find you.
You may wait in your room.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那位名叫尼勒姆的魔法师会来找你。
你可以在房间里等待。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is too early to lose our hope.
I believe you will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
现在放弃希望还太早了。
我相信你会做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你看起来行李很多。没事吧？
看起来又多又大。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
要不要减少一些？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The Roegenburg welcomes adventurers with various experiences, but it is somewhat early for us to work with you.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
罗根堡欢迎拥有各种经验的冒险者，但对我们来说，现在与您合作还为时过早。
希望以后能再见到您。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
How could you come in here?
Nobody can come into this place if you are not a staff. Please go outside.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你怎么进来的？
如果不是职员，谁都不能进入这个地方。请出去。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Hello, adventurers. I am honored you have visited the ^0000cdRoegenburg^000000. I am ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你好，冒险者。很荣幸您能造访^0000cd罗根堡^000000。我是^0000cd马克西米利安·罗根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
We are one of seven royal families that found the kingdom and have work hard for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我们是建立王国的七大皇室家族之一，一直为卢恩·米德加兹辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, the heir of our family, is supposed to participate in the royal assembly. How about seeing him?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
^0000cd赫尔穆特·罗根堡^000000，我们家族的继承人，将参加皇室会议。要不要见见他？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hello, I am ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你好，我是^0000cd赫尔穆特·罗根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I'm invited to this banquet. {1} It is nice to see you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我受邀参加这场宴会。{1}很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am honored to see the hero who defeated Morocc. Please enjoy your time while you are in the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
见到击败莫罗克的英雄，我深感荣幸。在您逗留罗根堡期间，请尽情享用。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you have time, how about seeing the rest people of the Roegenburg?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果您有时间，要不要见见罗根堡的其他人？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Brother, it will be helpful to listen to the story of the family from ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
兄长，听^0000cd沃尔夫·罗根堡^000000讲讲家族的故事会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is a good opportunity, of course.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，这当然是一个好机会。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Did you see the children of the Roegenburg? They look like babies, but now when I see them in the palace, I am pleased that they are almost grown up.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
您见过罗根堡的孩子们了吗？他们看起来像婴儿，但现在当我在宫殿里看到他们时，我很高兴他们几乎已经长大了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You met Helmut already. It will be helpful to you if you meet the second son, Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
您已经见过赫尔穆特了。如果您能见见二儿子沃尔夫，对您会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
He is in charge of all matters of the Roegenburg instead of the first son who is busy for participation in the royal assembly and protection of the border. You will hear lots of interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
由于大儿子忙于参加皇室会议和保卫边境，他负责处理罗根堡的所有事务。您会听到许多有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The Roegenburg is proud that we are descents of Wilhelm, the national hero, and contributed to the foundation and development of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
罗根堡家族以自己是国民英雄威廉的后代为荣，并为卢恩·米德加兹王国的建立和发展做出了贡献。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Therefore, we hoped that the children could grow into decent adults, but they were raised without their parents' care and now they tend to behave rudely and act as they want.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
因此，我们希望孩子们能成长为得体的成年人，但他们是在没有父母照顾的情况下长大的，现在他们往往行为粗鲁，随心所欲。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you feel uncomfortable when you talk with them, please understand kindly.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
如果您在与他们交谈时感到不舒服，请多多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
They are the children who will lead the family, but they are going different from what the Roegenburg aims for.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
他们是未来将领导家族的孩子们，但他们的成长方向与罗根堡的目标背道而驰。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The first son stays on the front, risking his life everyday and the second is doing business, which is against the family tradition.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
大儿子留在前线，每天冒着生命危险，而二儿子在做生意，这违背了家族传统。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The third son would leave the house and hang out on the back street, but we cannot continue to employ some to monitor him all the times.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
三儿子会离家出走，在后街闲逛，但我们不能一直雇人监视他。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But the youngest, Agnes, has grown as good girl and I am happy when I think of her.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
但最小的阿格妮丝，已经成长为一个好女孩，想到她我就很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ah, I am sorry to talk too much on our family. I have become talkative as I get old.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
啊，抱歉说了太多关于我们家族的事。我年纪大了，变得话多了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please forgive me grumbling and forget this old man's complaints.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
请原谅我的唠叨，忘掉这个老人的抱怨吧。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Myer, Myer...
I cannot believe that Myer did that.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
迈尔，迈尔...
我无法相信迈尔会那样做。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
He spread the bad rumor about the family but I think he did it because he is desperate.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
他散布了关于家族的坏名声，但我认为他这样做是因为他走投无路。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have let the children do as they want but I wanted to avoid a war.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我让孩子们随心所欲，但我希望避免战争。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But I know it is unlikely that Helmut becomes a king and so leave them to do as they like.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
但我知道赫尔穆特成为国王的可能性不大，所以让他们随心所欲吧。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
However, I would like to leverage this opportunity to collect the capabilities of the family members to protect the family.
Opportunities are found in times of crisis.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
不过，我想利用这个机会，召集家族成员的能力来保护家族。
危机之中往往蕴藏着机遇。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please bring Helmut. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
请带赫尔穆特来。他应该在^0000cd靠近修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德边境的检查点^000000。他负责巡逻队伍。
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Welcome adventurer. Did you have a safe travel?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
欢迎，冒险者。旅途平安吗？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I cannot see Helmut. Did he refuse to come?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我没看到赫尔穆特。他拒绝来了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he left a message for two of you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他给你们两人留了话。

scripts.text: [Told Maximilian and Wolf about Helmut's will and the successorship]
scripts.translation: [把赫尔穆特的遗愿和继承权的事告诉了马克西米利安和沃尔夫]

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I knew something when Helmut left, but I didn't expect that he would give up the successorship.
But if that is what Helmut wants, I don't object to it.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
赫尔穆特离开时我就有所察觉，但我没想到他会放弃继承权。
但如果这是赫尔穆特的意愿，我无异议。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
This fact will be announced as soon as the royal assembly and banquet are finished. Wolf, now you should lead our family. I hope this will not be a burden to you.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
等皇家议会和宴会结束后，这一事实将会被公布。沃尔夫，现在你应该领导我们的家族了。我希望这不会成为你的负担。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have taken a firm attitude that you never showed before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你展现出了前所未有的坚定态度。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Once I tried to move the children as I want and failed. Since then I left them to do as they like. But now I know.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我曾试图按我的意愿安排孩子们，但失败了。从那以后，我就让他们随心所欲。但现在我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I realized that a new age needs children. I will work for the family and country in the way the children wants to do.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我意识到新时代需要孩子们。我将按照孩子们的意愿，为家族和国家效力。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I seem to have forced my way to Helmut and people in the family.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我似乎强行介入了赫尔穆特和家族成员的事务。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
There is something rather than a war to have influence up to every corner in the continent.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
除了战争，还有其他方式可以将影响力扩展到大陆的每一个角落。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
As Myer said, I am looking for other approaches and I will.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
正如迈尔所说，我正在寻找其他途径，并且会继续寻找。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, if you don't mind, won't you deliver my will to ^0000cdMyer^000000?
scripts.translation:
[狼]
亲爱的冒险者，如果不介意，能否将我的心意转达给^0000cd迈尔^000000？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
That I have given up wars and am looking for better solution and that if he can, visit the family and see the people.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
告诉他我已放弃战争，正在寻找更好的解决方案，并请他如果有空，来家族看看大家。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am willing to do so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我愿意这么做。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please deliver the story of Helmut to Myer.
He must be somewhere in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
请将赫尔穆特的故事转达给迈尔。
他一定在普隆德拉的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, did you deliver the message to Myer? what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[狼]
亲爱的冒险者，你把信交给迈尔了吗？他怎么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He said it is good to give up wars. Myer has a lot of trust in you. He said he would help you as much as he can, if you need his help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他说放弃战争是件好事。迈尔非常信任您。他说如果需要帮助，他会尽力相助。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I want him to visit us more than to help me.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
比起帮我，我更希望他能常来家里看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, he also said he would come after the banquet is finished.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，他还说宴会结束后就会过来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Well I am happy that our relationship will improve.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
太好了，我很高兴我们的关系能有所改善。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Once, we were the closest friends, but the relationship became awkward after he left the family.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
曾经，我们是最好的朋友，但在他离开家族后，关系就变得尴尬了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Anyway, I think we have to make preparation to welcome him seriously.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
总之，我觉得我们必须认真准备一下，好好欢迎他回来。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I am glad that now everything has found its place. I have been worried a lot.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
很高兴看到一切终于各归其位。我之前一直很担心。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
All theses things are thanks to you. I feel safe now that everyone has their right places and will work hard for the family and country.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
这一切都要感谢您。现在大家都回到了正确的位置，并愿意为家族和国家努力，我感到很安心。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer. Thank you very much for helping my family. I have been thinking how I can reward you for your contribution, but cannot find anything that is comparable to the magnitude of thank.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
亲爱的冒险者，非常感谢你帮助我的家族。我一直在想该如何报答你的贡献，但找不到能与这份恩情相称的东西。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
However at least to express my mind, I have prepare a small present. Please take it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
不过，为了表达我的心意，我准备了一份小礼物。请收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you need a help from the Roegenburg, come to use anytime. The gate of the Roegenburg is always opened to you.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
如果你需要罗根伯格家族的帮助，随时都可以来找我们。罗根伯格的大门永远为你敞开。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I wanted to thank you always. Thanks to your contribution, my family is returning to safety.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎。
我一直想谢谢你。多亏了你的贡献，我的家族正重归安宁。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
It seems that my family had no problem, but inside the wall, we didn't have trust in one another and were not mixed.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
表面上看，我的家族似乎没什么问题，但在围墙之内，我们彼此缺乏信任，也没有很好地融合。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But now we are getting along. Thank you very much again.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
但现在我们相处得很好。再次非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes Roegenburg]
Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝·罗根伯格]
嗯，你好像带了很多行李。要不要清理一些？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Hello, nice to meet you.
Did you visit to see my grandfather?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你好，很高兴见到你。
你是来探望我祖父的吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If so, he is over there. You can find him there.
Then, have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
如果是的话，他在那边。你可以去那里找到他。
那么，祝你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Did you see my brothers?
If you don't, make sure to see Wolf and have talk with him.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你见到我哥哥们了吗？
如果没有，一定要去见见狼，和他聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Nowadays, he shares many works with my grandfather and he has a lot to talk with you.
So the time for me to talk with him is quite reduced though.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
最近，他和祖父一起分担了很多工作，有很多话想对你说。
所以，我和他相处的时间反而变少了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
The banquet has started but I haven't yet found any body who I go with.
Originally Wolf is supposed to go with me, but it is canceled as he became busy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
宴会已经开始了，但我还没找到可以一起参加的人。
原本狼说要陪我去的，但他临时有事取消了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If he had told me earlier he cannot go, I wouldn't have refused all those proposals.
Myer said he would go with me, but I am afraid he may leave as wind anytime.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
如果他早点告诉我他不能去，我也不会拒绝那些邀请。
迈尔说他愿意陪我去，但我怕他随时会像风一样消失。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I don't want anything big...
When we were young, we played together. They read me books.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我不想要什么盛大的东西...
小时候，我们一起玩耍，他们给我读书。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I still like the best the books that my brothers read me.
Those princes and princesses in those books were all my friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我最喜欢哥哥们读给我的那些书。
书里的王子和公主，都是我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Recently I read a story on a knight who sacrifices himself for a lady.
In the story, the lady handed a pretty handkerchief to the knight.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
最近我读了一个故事，讲一位骑士为了女士而牺牲自己。
故事里，女士递给骑士一条漂亮的手帕。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Then, I realized that what I had lacked.
It was a pretty handkerchief.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
然后，我意识到自己缺少了什么。
是一条漂亮的手帕。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So I carry lots of pretty handkerchiefs so that I can hand them to my knight anytime.
But there is no one for me to hand my handkerchiefs to...
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
所以我随身带着很多漂亮的手帕，以便随时递给我的骑士。
但没有人可以让我递手帕...

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Did you see him too?
He came with Myer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你也见到他了吗？
他是和迈尔一起来的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
He is so handsome. I wonder what family he is from.
I am sorry that I left so early that I couldn't talk with him at all. I asked Myer who he is, but he didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
他长得真帅。不知道他是哪个家族的。
真遗憾我走得太早，没能和他说话。我问迈尔他是谁，但他没告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer?
Wolf is looking for you. Do you have an appointment with him?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者？
狼在找你。你和他有约吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Why don't you visit Wolf?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你不去看看狼吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
He is my brother, but he and other brothers are so childish.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
他是我哥哥，但他和其他哥哥们都很孩子气。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Go out to the street in Prontera and ask 5-year old children, even they know the answer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
去普隆德拉的街上问问五岁的小孩，他们都知道答案。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
They are overlooking something bigger due to their personal desires. Of course, I also hate them and want to take revenge, but it does not solve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
他们因为私欲而忽视了更重要的事情。当然，我也讨厌他们，想复仇，但这解决不了问题。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If they had thought about how the citizens of the kingdom can live more happily, they would not have acted like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
如果他们能想想如何让王国的市民生活得更幸福，就不会那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Anyway, let's wait and see, as they are trying to think like adults.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
总之，先等等看吧，毕竟他们也在试着像大人一样思考。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I feel safe that my grandfather stays with me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
但祖父陪在我身边，让我感到安心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You seem to have come to see my brothers? but there is no one in the house.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你好像是来看我哥哥们的？但家里没人。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
In a long time, we were together, but they left and I am lonely again. It is nice that they don't fight one another any more.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
很久以前，我们在一起，但现在他们离开了，我又感到孤独。好在他们不再互相争斗了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, welcome back.
Pearls? soft hairs? Have you brought them?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎回来。
珍珠？柔软的毛发？你带回来了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are.
Am I too late?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给您。
我来得太晚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Not yet? OK. We have still time.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
还没？没关系，我们还来得及。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You forget what I asked didn't you? ^0000cdThey are three {0} and 50 strands of {1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你忘了我让你带什么了吗？^0000cd是3个{0}和50根{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Please don't be late!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
请不要迟到！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
No! you have brought all of them. I'm so happy!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
不！你全都带来了。我好开心！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'll take pearls to the jeweler, the best jeweler. They are so pretty!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我要把珍珠带去给最好的珠宝商。它们真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'll send soft hairs too. I wonder what they will turn into.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
柔软的毛发也要送去。不知道会变成什么样子。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, I need a handkerchief. There are so many things to do and I'm so busy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
啊，我还需要手帕。要做的事情太多了，我好忙。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh, I would like to thank you for working hard for me. Here you are.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
哦，我想谢谢你为我这么辛苦。给你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
And Can I ask you to get more? I am afraid that cloth is not sufficient.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
还有，能请你再带一些吗？我怕布料不够。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess so. I will help you to the best of my ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想是的。我会尽力帮你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You really understand me. I'm so happy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你真懂我。我好开心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank you very much
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
See you tomorrow. Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
明天见。祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, welcome back. You are a great person. I think you have obtained all, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎回来。你真是个好人。我想你应该都拿到了吧。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If not, I will be really sad. I'm skipping meals to wear the pretty dress. So I'm so sensitive now.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
如果没有的话，我会很难过的。为了穿漂亮的裙子，我都在节食呢。所以现在我很敏感。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry but I forgot what I should get.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我忘了该拿什么了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh, it's disappointing! I thought you would have a good memory as an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
哦，真让人失望！我还以为作为冒险者，你的记忆力会很好呢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, I'm sorry. I got angry suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
啊，对不起。我刚才突然发火了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
As I told you before. I didn't eat meals these days. Please forgive my misbehavior. Did yo get what I asked?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
就像我之前说的，这几天我都没怎么吃东西。请原谅我的失态。你拿到我需要的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
^0000cd15 pieces of {0}, 30 {1}, and 10 {2}^000000. I'll make a pink dress that is softer than flower petal.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
^0000cd15个{0}，30个{1}，还有10个{2}^000000。我要用它们做一条比花瓣还要柔软的粉色裙子。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Then, please get them for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I talked with Wolf too but He said the same thing as grandfather. I should ask somebody to do me a favor unless he doesn't listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我也和狼谈过，但他和祖父说的一样。除非他不听我的，否则我得找个人帮我这个忙。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So I talked with Myer. He told me to talk with you. He also said that if you cannot get a dress, buy the materials and make one. He said that is how they on the street.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
于是我和迈尔谈了。他让我来找你。他还说，如果你买不到裙子，就买材料自己做。他说街上的人都是这么做的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So I hired very skillful person who can make a dress and accessories, but the key is materials. I guess that you are very experienced and can get what I need.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
所以我雇了一位非常擅长制作裙子和配饰的人，但关键在于材料。我想你经验丰富，一定能弄到我需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If I go out to get a dress, I may be the first princess in Rune-Midgarts who dies for a dress. So would you please save me from this situation?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
如果我亲自出去买裙子，我可能会成为卢恩·米德加兹第一位为了裙子而丧命的女王。所以，请帮我把我从这个困境中解救出来好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I'll do my best to help you.
You need cloth, accessories and dyes don't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然，我会尽力帮你。
你需要布料、配饰和染料，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我该怎么帮你呢？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Yes, you are right!
You understand me very well! I like you very much.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
是的，你说得对！
你非常懂我！我很喜欢和你相处。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Can you be my friend. I have wanted a woman who understands me very much.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你能做我的朋友吗？我一直渴望有一位非常懂我的女性朋友。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Of course, you will get cloth, accessories and dyes!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
当然，你会弄到布料、配饰和染料的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then which kind do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，你想要哪种？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
There is an accessory I really want to have, but it is so rare that I couldn't get it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
有一件配饰我真的很想要，但它太罕见了，我根本买不到。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Can you get it for me?...
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你能帮我弄到吗？...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why is it so rare?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么这么罕见？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
it is a ^0000cdpearl^000000! elegant and gentle gloss! Valuable jewel coming from pains!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
那是^0000cd珍珠^000000！优雅而柔和的光泽！来自贝类的珍贵宝石！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I would like to use pearls to make a necklace and bracelet. You can get pearls from monsters. Can you get them for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我想用珍珠制作项链和手链。魔物身上可以掉落珍珠。你能帮我弄到吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 这会很困难。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it will be difficult to get pearls. It is really difficult. It is beyond my ability. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得弄到珍珠会很困难。真的很难。这超出了我的能力范围。很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Yes... I know it will be very difficult. If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
是的...我知道这非常困难。如果你改变主意了，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank god. I was afraid that you would refuse it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
谢天谢地。我还以为你会拒绝我呢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I carry this to the banquet whatever I wear. And can ask you do me a favor one more?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
无论我穿什么，我都会带上这个去参加宴会。还有，你能再帮我一个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
To produce good cloth, good threads are necessary. To extract good threads, ^0000cdsoft hair^000000 is the best. Would you get soft fur for me too?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
要制作好的布料，就需要好的线。而要提取好的线，^0000cd柔软的毛发^000000是最好的。你能也帮我弄点柔软的毛皮吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is not difficult.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这并不难。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I think ^0000cd3 {0} ^000000are enough and 50 strands of {1}^0000cdare required^000000.

[Agnes]
The success of my banquet is in your hands. I will do my best to make it one of the best ever.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我宴会的成败就掌握在你手中了。我会尽我所能，让它成为有史以来最棒的宴会之一。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, what are you doing here?
Did you come for my dress?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，你在这里做什么？
你是来找我做衣服的吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I'm still making the dress using what you got for me.
I'll decide what to make next after completing this.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
但我还在用你帮我弄到的材料做衣服。
做完这件之后，我再决定接下来做什么。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank you for visiting but I am sorry that I cannot help you.
Would you come back later in the afternoon?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
谢谢你的光临，但很抱歉我现在帮不了你。
你下午晚些时候再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer. Thanks for coming. I thought all day of what dress to make. I cannot decide still.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者。谢谢你来找我。我整天都在想该做什么样的衣服。我还是决定不下来。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
A golden dress shining brighter than the sun? Or a sliver dress shining more gentile than the moon? Or a dress greener than tree leaves?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
是比太阳更闪耀的金色礼服？还是比月亮更温柔的银色礼服？亦或是比树叶更翠绿的礼服？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, how can I fit the pearl necklace and look nice with my partner?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
啊，我该怎么搭配那条珍珠项链，才能和舞伴相得益彰呢？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I have made a decision!!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我决定了！！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I prefer the soft pink dress other than young flower petal blooming on a large field. To be like that, I think I need a very soft silk cloth.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
比起在广阔田野上盛开的花朵，我更喜欢柔和的粉色。为了达到那种效果，我觉得我需要非常柔软的绸缎布。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Flower! It a flower! Large and shining jewels are too common here in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
花儿！是花儿！巨大而闪耀的宝石在宫殿里太常见了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I was thinking of how I can emphasize my pearl necklace.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我一直在想怎么突出我的珍珠项链。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I would like to make a fairy dress! A dress so shining in golden light that anyone should admire it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我想做一件妖精的礼服！一件在金色光芒中闪闪发光的礼服，让所有人都为之赞叹。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Have you ever watch the burning sun directly. I am sure you haven't. The sun stabs the eyes of the people who watch it so that they cannot watch it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你曾经直视过燃烧的太阳吗？我相信你没有。太阳的光芒会刺痛直视它的人的眼睛，让人无法再看。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I like a black dress that reminds of dark night. A dress so elegant and beautiful that makes people to admire in silence.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我喜欢让人联想到深夜的黑色礼服。一件如此优雅美丽的礼服，让人只能静静地欣赏。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
In the banquet, if my soft dress widens like young flower petal, the place will be full with fragrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
在宴会上，如果我的柔软礼服像年轻的花瓣一样展开，整个地方都会充满芬芳。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
The width of the skirt should be as wider as possible. The dress will look like a flower petal shaking every time I move.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
裙摆应该尽可能宽大。这样每次我移动时，礼服都会像花瓣一样摇曳。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, Would get me ^0000cd{0}^000000? ^0000cd15 pieces^000000 will do.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，能帮我弄到^0000cd{0}^000000吗？^0000cd15个^000000就够了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I also need herbs used to dye the cloth. ^0000cd30 {0} and 10 {1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我还需要用来染布的草药。^0000cd30个{0}和10个{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I see a dress in you hands that look like a flower petal.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我看到你手中那件像花瓣一样的礼服了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I want to be a flower in the banquet hall. I want to make people to admire me like a flower that fascinates with delicate fragrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我想成为宴会大厅里的一朵花。我想让人们像欣赏一朵散发淡淡香气的迷人花朵一样欣赏我。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'm going to use flowers to make a corsage. Please get me some flowers. No common flowers. I heard that rare flowers can be obtained in a far foreign country.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我要用花做一个胸花。请帮我弄些花来。不要普通的花。我听说在遥远的异国可以采到稀有的花。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I saw those flowers once. They were so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我曾经见过那些花。它们非常美丽。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, please get me ^0000cd5 {0}, 5 {1} and 5 {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，请帮我弄到^0000cd5个{0}，5个{1}和5个{2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
My beautiful corsage is up to you!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我那美丽的胸花就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Yesterday, when I was thinking watching the night sky, I found that stars were twinkling.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
昨天，当我仰望夜空时，我发现星星在闪烁。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It was so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off them.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
它们太美了，让我移不开目光。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
What I ask you today is....
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我今天想请你做的是....

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Start dust.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
星星的粉末。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Imagine that star dusts are gently scattered on a beautiful dress. You won't be able to take your eyes from them.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
想象一下，星星的粉末轻轻撒在一件美丽的礼服上。你会无法移开目光的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I will be the brightest star in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我将成为宴会上最亮的星。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So please get me ^0000cd5 {0}^000000. I think that amount of star dusts can decorate the entire dress.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
所以请帮我弄到^0000cd5个{0}^000000。我想那个数量的星星的粉末足以装饰整件礼服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Don't forget. My shining dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
别忘了。我那闪耀的礼服就托付给你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Cloth is sufficient, but the problem is decoration. I heard that there is something called fairy's wing.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
布料已经足够了，但问题在于装饰。我听说有一种东西叫“妖精之翼”。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It will make a dress as elegant as fairy and on which I can work lightly. The thought alone makes you fascinated?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
用它装饰的礼服会像妖精一样优雅，而且我穿起来会很轻盈。光是想想就让人着迷呢？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Every time I step, the luxury lace will flutter, making people to imagine a fairy waling in the wood. The dress will make me better.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
每走一步，奢华的蕾丝就会飘动，让人仿佛看到妖精在森林中漫步。这件礼服会让我更加完美。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Of course, I will not attach them as they are. I know a person who will modify them properly.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
当然，我不会直接把它们缝上去。我认识一位能妥善改造它们的人。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, Please get me ^0000cd5 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，请帮我弄到^0000cd5个{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
My fairly-like dress is up to you hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我那如妖精般的礼服就托付给你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I wonder how many people lost their eyes after watching the sun directly. Why do people watch that burning fire? What is it?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
不过我很好奇，有多少人直视太阳后失去了视力。人们为什么要看那团燃烧的火呢？那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer. I want to have that burning fire.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者。我想要那团燃烧的火。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I heard that there is the ^0000cdhot hair^000000 that looks burning but not hot at all, though the name sounds contradictory.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我听说有一种^0000cd热发^000000，虽然名字听起来自相矛盾，但它看起来像在燃烧，实际上却一点也不烫。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I will use it to make a beautiful shawl. As soon as I enter the banquet hall, I will be able to give a strong impression.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我要用它做一条美丽的披肩。当我走进宴会厅时，一定能给人留下强烈的印象。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Please get me ^0000cd20 strands of {0}^000000.

[Agnes]
My beautiful shawl burning like the sun is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我那如太阳般燃烧的华丽披肩就托付给你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I should make a dress that is as far and mysterious as a dark night.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我应该做一件像黑夜一样遥远而神秘的礼服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I will go around the banquet hall like a sleek cat, concealing everything underneath the black dress.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我要像敏捷的猫一样在宴会厅里穿梭，用黑色的礼服掩盖一切。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
To do so, I think I need ^0000cd20 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
为此，我想我需要^0000cd20个{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
This will be beautiful dress without a decoration.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
这将是一件无需装饰的美丽礼服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, my black night-like dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，我那如黑夜般的礼服就托付给你了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hello.
I am Helmut Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你好。
我是赫尔穆特·罗根堡。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you want to listen to the story of my family, see my ^0000cdgrandfather^000000 who is over there.
He will explain better than me.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果你想听我家人的故事，去看看那边的^0000cd祖父^000000吧。
他比我解释得更好。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Did you see my brother, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000?
He is in charge of all household matters helping our grandfather while I am away here on the front.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
你见到我的兄弟，^0000cd沃尔夫·罗根堡^000000了吗？
在我前线驻守期间，他负责协助祖父处理家中所有事务。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you want to know about the Roegenburg, it will be a quality time.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果你想知道关于罗根堡家族的事，和他聊聊会是一段美好的时光。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am glad that I come back home and can see the family members.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我很高兴能回到家，见到家人们。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But when I think of the front threatened by the monster, I feel heavy-hearted. Of course, I believe that my men are doing well to protect the territory.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
但一想到前线正受到魔物的威胁，我就感到心情沉重。当然，我相信我的部下们正努力保护着这片领土。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I want to run back to them as soon as the banquet is finished.
This place is somewhat stuffy to me.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
宴会一结束，我就想立刻回去找他们。
这里对我来说有点沉闷。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Dear adventurer, hello.
I am ^0000cdKalbern^000000 and a chamberlain of Helmut.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
亲爱的冒险者，你好。
我是^0000cd卡尔贝恩^000000，赫尔穆特的侍从长。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I served Helmut in a harsh front in the border area. Now I am in Prontera, the capital city of Rune-Midgarts and I cannot adapt to this situation
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
我曾随赫尔穆特在边境地区艰苦的前线服役。现在身处卢恩·米德加兹的首都普隆德拉，我很难适应这种状况。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I also lose my nerve when I see noble people and royal family in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
看到宫殿里的贵族和皇室成员时，我也会感到紧张。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I didn't recognize when I served Helmut on the front but here, he seems a little away as I feel that he is the heir of a royal family.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
在前线跟随赫尔穆特时我没注意到，但在这里，他显得有些疏远，因为我能感觉到他是皇室继承人的身份。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
He treated solders and working children equally. So everybody liked him and followed him.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
他平等地对待士兵和打工的孩子。所以大家都喜欢他，并追随他。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I also thank him for accepting me after my parents were killed by the monster.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
我也感谢他在我的父母被魔物杀害后收留了我。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
To repay his kindness, I begged him to serve him and I am staying with him...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
为了报答他的恩情，我恳求他让我继续侍奉，并一直留在他身边...

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I have nothing to do for Helmut except bring him some beer.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
在这里，除了给赫尔穆特送点啤酒，我没什么事可做。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I wish that the banquet is finished and go back early.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
我希望宴会快点结束，好早点回去。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
But, I don't mean that I don't want him to become a king.
I am just uncomfortable to be here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
但这并不意味着我不希望他成为国王。
我只是在这里感到不自在。

scripts.text:
[Wolf Roegenburg]
Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫·罗根堡]
嗯，你看起来行李很多。要不要卸下一些？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Thank you for visiting the Roegenburg.
Won't you see my grandfather and patriarch of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
感谢光临罗根堡。
你要不要见见罗根堡家族的祖父兼族长，^0000cd马克西米利安·罗根堡^000000？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
He enjoys talking with adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
他喜欢和冒险者交谈。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, it is a honor to have you in the Roegenburg.
I am the second son of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎您来到罗根堡，这是我们的荣幸。
我是罗根堡家的二儿子，^0000cd沃尔夫·罗根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
To carry on the will of Wilhelm Roegenburg, a national hero, we, at the Roegenburg, are making lots of efforts to protect honor, justice and traditions.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
为了继承国民英雄威廉·罗根堡的遗志，我们罗根堡家族正努力维护荣誉、正义与传统。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Since the foundation of Rune-Midgarts, lots of people from the Roegenburg have made contribution to the country and this is our pride.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
自卢恩·米德加兹建国以来，罗根堡家族为国家的贡献不计其数，这也是我们的骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Currently ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, who is an excellent candidate for the throne, is participating in the royal assembly. Did you see him?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
目前，作为王位继承人的有力竞争者，^0000cd赫尔穆特·罗根堡^000000正在参加皇家议会。你见到他了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I saw him just before. Who is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我刚才见过他。他是谁？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, it is nice to see you. I am ^0000cdAgnes Roegenburg^000000 and the youngest of the four of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
亲爱的冒险者，见到你很高兴。我是^0000cd阿格妮丝·罗根堡^000000，罗根堡家四兄妹中最小的一个。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Do you have a partner to go with to the banquet? I have no one to go with. No one takes my fancy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你有伴一起去宴会吗？我没有。没有谁让我看得上眼。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Agnes, don't say that. it is not appropriate. We are telling the adventurer of the story of the Roegenburg...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
阿格妮丝，别这么说。这样很不合适。我们正在向冒险者讲述罗根堡家族的故事...

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Now, will my prince come with me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
好了，我的王子殿下，你要跟我走吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, Myer, brother! brother!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
啊，迈尔，哥哥！哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Thanks for coming at the right time. Dear adventurer,
This is ^0000cdMyer Roegenburg^000000 and he is the third son of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
谢谢你及时赶到。亲爱的冒险者，
这位是^0000cd迈尔·罗根堡^000000，他是罗根堡家的三儿子。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I was away for a long time and have just came back. It is right, isn't?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我离家很久了，刚回来。是这样吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, about half. I heard that ^0000cda war manic and a peddler would join hands and participate in the royal assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，大概有一半吧。我听说^0000cd一个战争狂人和一个货郎会联手参加皇家议会^000000。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
So I came back for a short stay. I heard that the relationship between brothers was not close but has suddenly deeper. I cannot be out.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
所以我回来小住几天。我听说兄弟间的关系原本不亲密，但突然变得亲密了。我不能一直待在外面。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What your language. ^0000cdEven though you go outside and hang out with low fellows,^000000 you don't have make the place where you live a dirty back street.
You didn't think that I am ignorant of the fellows that you hang out with, did you?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你的话真难听。^0000cd虽然你出去跟那些下等人混，^000000但也不要把家里搞得像脏兮兮的后街。
你以为我不知道你平时跟谁混吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Of course I know that grandfather and you sent people to monitor me. They were so awkward and all other fellow knew it.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
我当然知道祖父和你派人监视我。他们做得太拙劣了，其他人都看得出来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
My noble brother doesn't like my way of speaking?
If we join hands and ^0000cdHelmut becomes a king^000000,^0000cdthe whole country will ^000000turn into a back street except the palace. Isn't it better to hear it now to reduce the shock you will have later?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
我高贵的哥哥不喜欢我的说话方式？
如果我们联手，^0000cd赫尔穆特成为国王^000000，^0000cd整个国家除了皇宫^000000都会变成后街。现在告诉你，总比以后让你受到冲击要好，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, you may not hear as you will stay at home and calculate the money you will make from wars.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，你可能听不进去，因为你只会待在家里计算战争能赚多少钱。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are unbelievably rude. I told you should call me politely.
Until when are you going to act like that?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你简直粗鲁得令人难以置信。我告诉过你要礼貌地称呼我。
你还要这样多久？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Stop all of you! We have gathered here for fight. This is a banquet for the adventurer. We shouldn't do this in front of the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你们全都停下！我们聚在一起是为了争吵吗？这是为冒险者准备的宴会。我们不应该在冒险者面前这样。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Especially you lack dignity. What would the adventurer think of us?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
尤其是你，太失礼了。冒险者会怎么看我们？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes, you are right. I think I am the unwelcome guest. I'd better leave. Agnes, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
是的，你说得对。我觉得自己是个不受欢迎的客人。我最好离开。阿格妮丝，我稍后回来。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh my god, I forgot. I have to make preparations!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
天哪，我忘了。我得去准备一下！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Sorry for this unpleasant situation. I never meant to do so. Apologies if you feel uncomfortable. Myer made rude remarks as he came back in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
抱歉让您遇到这种不愉快的情况。我本无意如此，如果您感到不适，请见谅。迈尔是因为很久没回来，才说了些失礼的话。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I will tell him to make a polite apology to you later. Actually he is different from what you saw. Please understand kindly.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
稍后我会让他向您正式道歉。其实他和您看到的并不一样，请多多包涵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is ok with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系，我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
By the way, dear adventurer, can you do me a favor if you have time?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
顺便问一下，亲爱的冒险者，如果您有空的话，能帮我一个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, pleas go ahead.

[Wolf]
I hope you will visit the Wigner and bring a thing from ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
希望您能去一趟维格纳，从^0000cd艾萨克·维格纳^000000那里取一样东西。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Originally, I should do that, but I think I need to talk with Myer seriously. So I would like to do that for me...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
原本我应该亲自去，但我需要和迈尔认真谈谈。所以想请您代劳...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
So, please do it for me. Of course, you may refuse it. But I wonder I can find a reliable person like you.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
所以，请帮我做这件事。当然，您可以拒绝。但我没想到能遇到像您这样可靠的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a test to find that I am reliable.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是在测试我是否可靠吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Ah, no it is not. If you feel unpleasant, I am sorry. I just don't have reliable person.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
啊，不，不是的。如果您觉得不舒服，我很抱歉。我只是没有可以信赖的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok. Go to the Wigner and ask Isaac Wigner for the thing that you requested. Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。去维格纳找艾萨克·维格纳，拿你要的东西。是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes. right.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
是的，没错。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Walk along the ^0000cdcorridor. The Wigner is in the last room^000000.
Find Isaac and bring the thing I requested.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
沿着^0000cd走廊^000000走，维格纳就在最后的房间。
找到艾萨克，把我需要的东西带回来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I am very sorry to cause inconvenience to you.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
非常抱歉给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, how is it going? I see you have nothing. It seem that you haven't brought it yet.
You just go to the ^0000cdWigner and bring a thing from Isaac^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
亲爱的冒险者，进展如何？我看您手里没东西，看来还没取回来。
您只需要去^0000cd维格纳^000000，从艾萨克那里取东西即可。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, did you bring the thing? Oh, you have brought it. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
亲爱的冒险者，您拿到东西了吗？哦，您带回来了。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Oh, the box's lock is protected by ^0000cdpassword^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
哦，这个盒子的锁设有^0000cd密码^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The first cell has a number ^0000cd1^000000 and the next four cells are empty and you should enter numbers into them.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
第一个格子里有数字^0000cd1^000000，后面四个格子是空的，您需要填入数字。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Hmm.. This is simple. This perfectly ^0000cdbeautiful box is a hint^000000... The answer is always included in the question.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
嗯...这很简单。这个^0000cd美丽的盒子就是提示^000000...答案总是包含在问题之中。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Looking at the answer, it really seems that the Wigner people love ^0000cdnumers and gold^000000. Will you try to solve it too?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
从答案来看，维格纳的人似乎很^0000cd喜欢数字和黄金^000000。您也来试试解开它吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How come you ask me to decipher the password. And isn't it a secret thing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么让我来破解密码？这难道不是机密吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Because you are reliable person. Just do it for fun.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
因为您是值得信赖的人。就当是玩玩吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, I think the answer is this:
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，我认为答案是这个：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... It is not the answer.
I think I need some time for contemplation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...这不是答案。
我需要时间思考一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
1618. It stands for 1.618 which is the golden ratio.
Well it sounds too easy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
1618。它代表1.618，也就是黄金比例。
嗯，听起来太简单了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But what is inside is not easy.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
但里面的东西可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The thing put in the small bottle in the box will change the dynamics of combats and wars, though it is in a testing stage.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
盒子里小水瓶里的东西将改变战斗和战争的格局，尽管它目前仍处于测试阶段。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are a reliable person as I expected.
I was sorry when I asked you to do me a favor. We will reward you generously.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
您果然如我所料，是个值得信赖的人。
之前请您帮忙，我很抱歉。我们会给您丰厚的奖励。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is OK. there is message from Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。艾萨克有消息。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is that?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
什么消息？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Recently, there is a ^0000cdrumor^000000 circulating in Prontera about the Roegenburg and Helmut Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近，普隆德拉流传着关于罗根堡和赫尔穆特·罗根堡的^0000cd谣言^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was not a good rumor. He asked me to inspect it and check if it is true.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那不是好谣言。他让我去调查一下，看看是否属实。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
A rumor about you? I didn't know about it... Rumor.....
I need to check it, but there is no person we count on...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
关于您的谣言？我并不知道...谣言.....
我需要去查一下，但我们没有可以依靠的人...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Excuse me, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
打扰了，亲爱的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Can you do me a favor again? I cannot do it myself, as there could be a problem when I do it myself.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
能再帮我个忙吗？我自己去可能会有麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
All staff I can have trust in are doing other jobs and I have no person except you.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我信任的职员都在忙其他工作，除了您，我没有人可以依靠。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You can get information easily traveling around and what is more important is that I can trust you.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
您四处走动可以很容易地获取信息，更重要的是，我信任您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it is not easy but....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这并不容易，但是....

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
If you are busy, you may refuse it. I am sorry that I ask you to do me a favor. My brother came back suddenly and it drives me out of my mind and busy.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
如果您忙，可以拒绝。抱歉又请您帮忙。我哥哥突然回来，让我心烦意乱，忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that is a thing I can do. Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，这是我力所能及的事。那我们很快再见。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I don't know how to thank you. It is the most accurate to hear the rumor from children. I heard that children gather in a ^0000cdlarge open space^000000 in Prontera..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我真不知道该怎么感谢您。从孩子们那里听到传闻是最准确的。我听说普隆德拉的^0000cd开阔空地^000000上聚集了很多孩子。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Then, see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
那么，我们很快再见。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is the rumor about Roegenburg that is circulating in Prontera.
I didn't know there is a rumor about our family circulating
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
普隆德拉正在流传关于罗根堡的什么传闻？
我都不知道我们家族有传闻在流传。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I had to start gather information earlier. I couldn't because I was busy due to others.
I didn't expect at all that a rumor will be circulating.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我本该早点开始收集信息的。但因为忙于其他事务，没能做到。
我完全没想到会有传闻流传开来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I cannot wait to know what rumor is circulating about our family.
Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我迫不及待想知道关于我们家族的传闻是什么。
那么，我们很快再见。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Hi, you look a little tired.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
嗨，你看起来有点累。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, do I? I had to do some errands to find the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，是吗？为了寻找传闻，我跑了不少地方。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Oh, I am sorry about that. I should have done that.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
哦，抱歉。我应该早点去做的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Rumor? what rumor? I like such thing very much.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
传闻？什么传闻？我很喜欢这类事情。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I really want know about it too.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
我也很想知道。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I am sorry to make you tired. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
抱歉让你这么辛苦。你找到什么线索了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I found the rumor and it was pretty specific. Can I tell about it here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我找到了传闻，而且内容相当具体。我可以在这里说吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes, it is ok. If the rumor is about our family, everyone has to listen, so that we can gather and develop a solution.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
可以。如果传闻是关于我们家族的，每个人都必须听，这样我们才能聚在一起想办法解决。

scripts.text: [I changed the rumor I got from children to a relatively softer version and told them.]
scripts.translation: [我把从孩子们那里听来的传言改得委婉些后告诉了他们。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These days everybody talks about the rumor. I think it will spread throughout Rune-Midgarts as well as Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近大家都在谈论这个传闻。我想它不仅会在普隆德拉，还会传遍卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The rumor is....very.... specific and malicious. It must be circulated on purpose by someone who knows the circumstances of my family.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
这个传闻...非常...具体且充满恶意。这一定是某个了解我家境况的人故意散布的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Do yo mean the bad guy is one of us? OMG! this is very serious!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你是说坏人是我们自己人？天哪！这太严重了！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes. ^0000cdMyer^000000? How much are you going to disgrace our family?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
是的。^0000cd迈尔^000000？你还要让我们家族蒙羞到什么程度？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, as much as needed?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，需要多少就多少？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Myer, did you really do that?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
迈尔，你真的做了那种事？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Myer did that?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
是迈尔做的？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Myer, is this true? Did you spread the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
迈尔，这是真的吗？是你散布的谣言？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You collected small kids and played a leader. Did you have lots of fun?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你召集了一群小孩子，还扮演首领。你玩得很开心吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you see what those little kids did for this time? You believe that only the upper class can exert influence on the common people, don't you? You must be so stupid.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你没看到这次那些小孩子做了什么吗？你难道认为只有上层阶级才能影响平民吗？你真是太愚蠢了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
How far are you going to go?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你到底要闹到什么地步？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, I asked for help church friends, merchant friends and back street friends. Everyone said they would be willing to help me, when I told them I need help.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，我向教会的朋友、商人的朋友以及后巷的朋友求助。当我告诉他们我需要帮助时，大家都表示愿意帮我。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I wonder how you can deal with invisible enemy.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
我倒想看看，你打算如何应对看不见的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I don't understand why you spread such a rumor and do all these things.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我不明白你为什么要散布这种谣言，还要做这些事。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
No, in fact, I think I know very well. It is because of your immature sympathy and you want to spoil my plan!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
不，其实我看得很清楚。这是因为你那幼稚的同情心，你想破坏我的计划！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Plan? what plan? war plan? the plan to drive innocent people to the battle field? A means that will realize your ambicous plan?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
计划？什么计划？战争计划？把无辜的人赶向战场的计划？实现你野心的手段？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are too young to understand why your brothers want to realize our plans.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你还太年轻，无法理解为什么你的兄弟们想要实现我们的计划。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
^0000cd14 years ago^000000, we could do nothing though we were the top family. We felt a feeling of helplessness. Have you ever felt that?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
^0000cd14年前^000000，尽管我们是顶级家族，却无能为力。那种无助感，你体会过吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
^0000cdA noble family is not so good as it looks^000000. You are just playing a leader on the back street and spoiling our plan entirely!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
^0000cd贵族家族并没有表面看起来那么好^000000。你不过是在后巷扮演首领，完全破坏了我们的计划！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Your plan is to develop the power of the family and unify the continent. Then what? what will you have. Achievement? Revenge?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你们的计划是发展家族势力并统一大陆。然后呢？你们能得到什么？成就感？复仇？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
As you know, such as thing causes another pain. We were raised without a parent. But we didn't fall because we had a family and we were rich.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你也知道，这种事只会带来新的痛苦。我们是在没有父母的情况下长大的。但我们没有倒下，因为我们有家人，而且我们富有。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And we had brothers ^0000cdto depend on^000000. Think how we did to comfort one another? There are not many people that are so lucky as we were.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
而且我们有^0000cd可以依靠的兄弟^000000。想想我们是如何互相安慰的？像我们这样幸运的人并不多。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
There are so many people who has no one to depend on, no place to lie their bodies, or no money to buy a piece of bread. People are dying everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
有太多人没有可以依靠的人，没有安身之所，甚至买不起一片面包。到处都有人在死去。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
The world you and Helmut are dreaming is only for ^0000cdthe satisfaction of a few persons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你和赫尔穆特梦想的世界，只是为了^0000cd满足少数人的私欲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yo are too ideal. Small sacrifice is a must to achieve a bing goal.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你太理想化了。要实现伟大的目标，必须有所牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Sacrifice for the goal? Do you think I don't know the reason you are helping Helmut.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
为了目标而牺牲？你以为我不知道你帮助赫尔穆特的真正原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
When Helmut participated in the Royal Assembly, I didn't care about it. Anyway he is naive and doesn't know how to acquire likeability and credibility from others.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
当赫尔穆特参加皇家议会时，我毫不在意。反正他天真幼稚，根本不懂得如何赢得他人的好感与信任。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
The wish that Helmut could end up as just a wish, but since you started to support Helmut ambiguously, everything has changed.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
赫尔穆特能当上国王，本应只是他的一厢情愿。但既然你开始模棱两可地支持他，一切都变了。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Helmut and you look like a good brothers, but Wolf, I know that you want to make money from wars and
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
赫尔穆特和你看起来像是一对好兄弟，但沃尔夫，我知道你想从战争中牟利，

scripts.text:
[Myer]
even though Helmut becomes a king, he is just a figurehead and you will exert power ^0000cdover our family and kingdom^000000. won't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
即使赫尔穆特成为了国王，他也只是个傀儡，而你将在^0000cd我们家族和王国^000000之上行使权力，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is our family proud of? Name? Fame? they are useless outside the country. And now they are not so high as before.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我们家族引以为傲的是什么？名字？名声？出了国境它们毫无用处。而且现在，它们也不如从前显赫了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But look at the Wigner. Wherever they go whatever they do, people bow their heads in front of their gold.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
但看看维格纳人。无论他们走到哪里，做什么，人们都会在他们金钱面前低头。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
To whoever has gold. I want that power. I want ^0000cdreal power^000000 rather powerless fame.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
金钱拥有者。我想要那种力量。我想要^0000cd真正的权力^000000，而不是毫无实权的名声。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You want to build a kingdom that you want rule as you want. What if Helmut fails to be a king? What would you do then?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你想建立一个由你随心所欲统治的王国。如果赫尔穆特没能当上国王，你该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You will run into a limit as the second son of the Roegenburg, can you give up your ambition?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
作为罗根堡家的次子，你会遇到极限，你能放弃你的野心吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway life is short. What moves people is heart, not money or power.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，人生苦短。打动人心的是真心，而不是金钱或权力。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Heart? Does it work on ^0000cdthose guys^000000?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
真心？那对^0000cd那些人^000000有用吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You didn't know you can approach them in a different way
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你只是不知道可以用不同的方式接近他们。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are better than I expected. You are grown up and I know you will not cry any more in front of me. So stop talking nonsense and play outside.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你比我预期的要好。你长大了，我知道你不会再在我面前哭了。所以别再说废话了，出去玩吧。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Watch your mouth. I cannot be nice to you forever.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
管好你的嘴。我不可能永远对你好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you do nothing, I do nothing. I hope I will live on the back street as happy ^0000cdJonathan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
如果你什么都不做，我也什么都不做。我希望我能像^0000cd乔纳森^000000一样，在后街快乐地生活。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
But you are developing a murder weapon as new business item with the Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
但你正在和维格纳人一起开发新型武器作为新的商业项目。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
How can people trust you when your family does not trust you? I cannot trust you! And I told you to stop treating me as a child!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
当你的家族都不信任你时，人们怎么能信任你？我无法信任你！而且我告诉过你，别把我当小孩！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Both of you,
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你们两个，

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Stop! What the hell are you fighting? Didn't all of us want to live happier than anybody?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
住手！你们在吵什么？难道我们不是都希望能比任何人都更幸福地生活吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So, everybody pursues happiness in their own ways. Helmut had found it on the front. Wolf on the money. And Myer on the street.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
所以，每个人都在以自己的方式追求幸福。赫尔穆特在战场上找到了它，狼在金钱中找到了它，而迈尔在街头找到了它。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Isn't it enough? Do you need something bigger? Cause? Revenge? War?
Everyone is fighting in this family and losing important thins. Still you want a war?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
这样还不够吗？你们还需要更大的东西？理由？复仇？战争？
这个家族里的每个人都在争斗，并失去了重要的东西。你们还想要战争吗？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
What do we really want? Well, if we can be happy by fighting, it is good!. But it is not. We have fought too long.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
我们真正想要的是什么？好吧，如果通过战斗能让我们幸福，那也不错！但事实并非如此。我们争斗得太久了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
All of you, Helmut, Wolf and Myer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
你们所有人，赫尔穆特、狼和迈尔。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Everybody calm down. It is not nice to raise our voices.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
大家都冷静一下。大声争吵是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Agnes is right. Both of you, please stop fighting.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
阿格妮丝说得对。你们两个，请停止争吵。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
...Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
...失礼了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Myer! where are you going? Are going to leave the family again?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮丝]
迈尔！你要去哪里？又要离开家族了吗？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
What do you think. I totally agree with Agnes. I think we have fought one another too long.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你们觉得呢。我完全同意阿格妮丝的看法。我觉得我们彼此争斗得太久了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But we have to keep in mind that revenge brings revenge in return and violence brings violence in return.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
但我们必须记住，复仇会招致复仇，暴力会招致暴力。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Do you know why I have been quiet though I lost my son and daughter-in-law.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
你们知道为什么我失去了儿子和儿媳，却一直保持沉默吗。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Because revenges does not make a difference. Revenge is another type of violence that only gives a temporary satisfaction.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
因为复仇改变不了什么。复仇是另一种形式的暴力，只能带来暂时的满足感。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The dead never comes back. Your parents would not want you to take revenge.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
死者不会复生。你们的父母不希望你们去复仇。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have let you do as you want to do, but this time I hope that you will follow what Agnes said. I want to avoid wars if possible.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我允许你们做自己想做的事，但这次我希望你们听从阿格妮丝的话。如果可能，我想避免战争。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
......
Excuse me too.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
......
失礼了。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Lord Helmut! where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
赫尔穆特大人！您要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't want to break in, but many people are afraid of wars,
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不想插嘴，但很多人害怕战争，

scripts.text:
[{0}]
including children. It would be better if a war didn't break out, but nothing is good if unrest and feat last long.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
包括孩子们。如果战争没有爆发会更好，但如果动荡和恐惧持续太久，就没有什么是好的了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ah, I am sorry that you saw
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
啊，抱歉让你看到了这一幕。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Apologies for making you uncomfortable. I am sorry again but can you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
抱歉让您感到不自在了。再次向您致歉，但能请您帮个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think we need to inform ^0000cdWigner^000000 of the rumor. Please wait a while.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
我觉得我们需要向^0000cd维格纳^000000通报这个传闻。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: [Wolf prepares documents for a while and seal it in an envelope.]
scripts.translation: [沃尔夫准备了一会儿文件，然后把它封进信封。]

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Please deliver this document. Sorry again. I cannot find time as I have much to do suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
请帮我送交这份文件。再次抱歉，我手头突然有很多事要处理，实在抽不出时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I'll come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不客气。我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Did you deliver the document to Isaac? I should have done it myself, but I got busy suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
你把文件交给艾萨克了吗？本该我自己去送的，但突然忙了起来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I thought about many thins after I heard from Agnes. To do those things, I cannot waste a minute.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
自从听了阿格妮丝的话，我思考了很多事情。为了做成这些事，我连一分钟都不能浪费。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
那么，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, thank you very much. Was Wigner offended?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
亲爱的冒险者，非常感谢。维格纳生气了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He understood everything. He believes that Wigner will find a new item as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他完全理解。他相信维格纳会尽快找到新的物品。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It is very good that he understands what I want. I think I have to start a new business at least not to disappoint Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
他能理解我的想法真是太好了。我想我必须开始一项新业务，至少不能辜负维格纳的期望。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You will not give up the desire to do business huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你并没有放弃经商的想法啊？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It fits me surprisingly. Working is rewarding and enjoyable. Besides, I can show my only ability, not as Roegenburg's ability.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫]
这出乎意料地适合我。工作既充实又令人愉快。而且，我可以展现我个人的能力，而不是作为罗根堡家族成员的能力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, your brothers must be busy. Myer and even Helmut....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
顺便问一下，你的兄弟们一定很忙吧。迈尔，甚至赫尔穆特……

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Helmut has left for the front without saying anything. Myer also has left home. I think they felt something from what Agnes said.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
赫尔穆特什么也没说就去了前线。迈尔也离开了家。我想他们是从阿格妮丝的话中察觉到了什么。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you allow, I would like ^0000cdclear up misunderstanding of my family^000000 in the rumor. Do you have time?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
如果您不介意，我想^0000cd澄清传闻中关于我家族的误解^000000。您有时间吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我有时间。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The rumor is true, except the part that a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
除了战争会爆发这一点外，传闻都是真的。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Let me tell you an old story. The parents of the four children gave a birth to Agnes and left for a neighboring country for resting.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
让我给您讲一个旧事。四个孩子的父母生下了阿格妮丝，然后去邻国休养。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
They were attacked by the monster there.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
他们在那里遭到了魔物的袭击。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In the holiday resort? Now the monster appears even in the holiday resort?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在度假胜地？难道连度假胜地也会出现魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
It was a remote but safe place. But for an unknown reason, the monsters attacked in group.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
那里虽然偏僻，但很安全。不知为何，魔物成群结队地袭击了那里。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The reason remains unknown, but they guess that the monsters came down to the town, chased by subjugation.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
原因至今不明，但人们猜测是魔物被镇压部队驱赶，逃到了城镇附近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
When we arrived at the site, the area was closed and no access was allowed, though my son and daughter-in-law was inside.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
当我们赶到现场时，该区域已被封锁，禁止任何人进入，而我的儿子和儿媳就在里面。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
We met with managers, but they blocked completely heavily armed foreigners like us.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我们去找了管理员，但他们完全封锁了区域，拒绝让我们这些全副武装的外国人进入。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I understand that. An armed force of a foreign country was crossing the border and I was not sure what the armed force would do. They have no choice but stop them.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我理解他们的做法。当时有外国武装力量正在越境，我不确定他们会做什么。他们别无选择，只能阻止我们。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
So, we tried to get into the closed zone and contact many people while time passed.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
于是，我们试图进入封锁区，并联系了许多人，但时间就这样流逝了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
At the end, we had to provide lots of money as bribe before we can dispatch mercenaries into the resort, but my son and daughter-in-law had been already killed.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
最后，我们不得不支付巨额贿赂，才让雇佣兵进入度假胜地，但那时我的儿子和儿媳已经遇害了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Actually, they were alive just before they were found. But, the access was delayed and they had to die in pains.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
实际上，在被发现之前他们还活着。但由于救援延误，他们只能在痛苦中离世。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听到这些我很遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I didn't tell the children about the attack, but I had to confess the death of their parents.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我没有告诉孩子们关于袭击的事，但我不得不向他们坦白父母的死讯。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
So losing beloved ones, my children and I came to live together.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
失去了挚爱的亲人，我的孩子们和我开始住在一起。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I grew the children to live up to the name of Roegenburg.
But actually what they need was education, but warm heart.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我努力将孩子们培养成配得上罗根堡家名号的人。
但实际上，他们需要的不是教育，而是温暖的心。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I didn't know that and I was only strict on them.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我当时并不知道这一点，只是对他们很严厉。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The children couldn't stand any more and one day they left as a token of resistance.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
孩子们再也无法忍受，有一天，他们离家出走了，以此作为反抗。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The children are unwilling to talk about those days. But I am sure that what they heard and saw in those days affected them.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
孩子们不愿谈论那段日子。但我确信，他们在那期间听到和看到的事情影响了他们。

[{0}]
怎么影响的？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Helmut trained himself. When he was grown up, he left to the border. Wolf suddenly declared that he would make money.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
赫尔穆特开始自我训练。长大后，他去了边境。狼则突然宣布他要赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I tried to stop him saying that there should no merchant in my family, but he was so stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我试图阻止他，说我们家不应该有商人，但他非常固执。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
After coming home, Myer was doing well for a while. But he left us with a note. Only Agnes has been growing well without a problem.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
迈尔回家后，过了一段时间还算顺利。但他后来留了张字条就离开了。只有阿格妮丝一直健康成长，没有出问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. I see each of them has their own stories! The rumor is spread with something concealed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。看来每个人都有自己的故事！传闻中似乎隐藏着什么不为人知的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Yes, Myer said he would handle the rumor and so the rumor will disappear. Can I ask you to do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
是的，迈尔说他会处理这个传闻，所以传闻就会消失。能请你帮我一个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please go ahead.

[Maximilian]
I am worried that ^0000cdHelmut left without a word^000000, as there are many eyes watching him. He is the heir of our family.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我很担心^0000cd赫尔穆特不告而别^000000，因为有很多人在盯着他。他是我们家的继承人。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I hoped that he would stay for the time being, but I am sad that he left all of sudden.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我原本希望他能暂时留下来，但很遗憾他突然离开了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, my job is to bring him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，我的任务就是把他带回来。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Yes. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
是的。他应该在^0000cd靠近修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德边境的检查站^000000。他负责那里的巡逻队伍。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
And when you come back, use this. You can return to Prontera instantly.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
等你回来的时候，用这个。你可以瞬间回到普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think I was closer to brothers than now, to Helmut and Myer.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我觉得我和赫尔穆特、迈尔的关系，现在比过去更亲近了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Agnes was our favored child in the family. She was the only little sister.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
阿格妮丝是我们家最受宠的孩子。她是家里唯一的小妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But sometimes I wonder why we have become this estranged.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
但有时候我会想，为什么我们会变得如此疏远。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Well, I think it is because we have came to become different and we also have different ideas on what is right. I understand to some extent.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
嗯，我想是因为我们变得不同了，而且对什么是正确的也有不同的看法。我在某种程度上能理解。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It was quite a shock when Myer left home. He just left without a word, though he was very close to me.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
迈尔离家出走时，让我很震惊。他什么话都没说就走了，尽管他和我很亲近。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Since then, I think, I started to find what I can. I cannot stand the thought that I am the only one who are not developing.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
从那以后，我想，我开始寻找我能找到的东西。我无法忍受自己是唯一没有成长的人。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
When a human feels an empty space, he/she tends to fill it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
当一个人感到空虚时，他/她往往会试图填补它。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think I am going to continue to go around to find it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我想我会继续四处寻找它。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, thanks to you, I feel that my brothers and I have become closer.
My brothers and I didn't know how to be bent and were about to be broken.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
亲爱的冒险者，多亏了你，我觉得我和兄弟们变得更亲近了。
我和兄弟们不知道如何变通，差点就要破裂了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think these experiences make us more friendly and developing.
We were apart a long time and all have forgotten it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我想这些经历让我们变得更友好，也在不断成长。
我们分开很久了，大家都忘了这一点。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
From now, I am going to lead my family, helping my grandfather.
If you visit us from time to time, I will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
从现在开始，我要带领我的家人，帮助我的祖父。
如果你偶尔来拜访我们，我会很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Please come back to us, if you need a help.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
如果你需要帮助，请回来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
It feels good that I come home for a long time.
It is a little suffocating though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
离家这么久，终于回到家了，感觉真好。
不过，这里有点让人喘不过气。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, this house goes well without me. I don't worry about the family, but I am only worried about my grandfather, as he is quite old.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，没有我，这个家也运转得很好。我不担心家人，只是担心祖父，毕竟他年纪大了。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Now I am home and it seems that Helmut, Wolf, and Agnes have been all good.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
现在回到家，看来赫尔穆特、狼和阿格妮丝都过得很好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I think it is great, though a little disappointing.
It is stupid to think like this, as I left home.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
我觉得这很好，虽然有点失望。
我离开了家，这样想有点傻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
停下！你们两个都停下。听你们说话，我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我有个问题。你们有什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我有一个。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受这个请求。你的问题是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室八卦之类的。
我想关于皇家议会或宴会有很多故事。我现在在首都，为了了解这里的气氛，我觉得应该听听那些故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
让我来讲！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事。但我不确定是否应该把它讲给你听。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？如果你想要报酬，我可以给你。糖果？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你给糖果作为报酬？太傻了。我们不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你最好别提报酬。我母亲告诉我不要接受陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们现在正在交谈。那你想要什么？代替糖果。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要。重要的是你是否有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
资格？你在说什么？他有时候说话很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我要报酬。如果你给我足够的报酬，我什么都可以告诉你。所以先拿出你的诚意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。但你们倒是直截了当地说出想要什么。一开始我看你们是小孩子才轻视你们。
好吧，我会给报酬。至于资格？听个八卦还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这取决于你想听什么样的八卦。价值越高，风险就越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
这八卦有这么危险吗？我刚才听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你难道知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
那是艾伦。你只能相信他30%。如果他总是对的，世界早就毁灭几十次了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么办？告诉我。你们到底想要什么？
