scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于到了谈生意的时候！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我喜欢漂亮的东西！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！仅此而已！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你们在说什么。请慢慢说，详细一点？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单。证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd狂暴米诺斯^000000吧。
那是肌肉发达的恶魔。抓住它来证明你很强大。它的力量数值是^0000cd33^000000！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。这样就够了吗？我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下。你不听我们说话吗？你说过要给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你不能只听艾伦的然后就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩耍，难道你不知道吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难道我也得照你们说的做...？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下我的朋友。照他们说的做。如果不做，你就会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我明白了。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！我听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们穿着漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也想要漂亮的衣服！我想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我会让我母亲给我做的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧，你们想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
考虑到我的身高，大概需要^0000cd十二^000000块？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。那么，小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本包含卢恩·米德加兹全部历史的书。它在皇家图书馆里，我从未见过。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进入宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我弄来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想让我偷它吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你以为我是什么人？帮我借来就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。^0000cd狩猎33只大玫瑰，获取12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从皇家图书馆借出卢恩·米德加兹的历史书^000000。我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我会等着你的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们想要的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
让我看看。是的！就是这些。真漂亮。好柔软！我真的可以拥有这些吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然，我既然带来了，就是因为你想要。那么，你之前说的话只是空话吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
不！不！我是真的想要！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有你的书。它真的很重也很大。我只借到了一卷。其他卷已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你。我终于可以读了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。是的，你猎杀了大玫瑰。你是一名强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我猎杀了它们全部。现在，让我听听那个昂贵的故事。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室。赫尔穆特·罗根堡。如果他成为国王，整个大陆将被卷入战争的漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的呻吟将笼罩整个大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是正在流传的谣言吗？但我不知道这意味着什么。有人能给我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。如果赫尔穆特·罗根堡成为国王，战争就会爆发。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...这太简单了。请解释得更详细一些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
哎呀！你们两个到底在说什么？让我来解释一下。那个谣言是这样的：

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根堡成为国王...，啊对了，你们听说过关于罗根堡的谣言吗？特别是关于^0000cd四个孩子死亡^000000的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不知道。以前从未听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
这也只是谣言。但我确信这是真的。总之，我听说他们是被谋杀的，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
当时他们正在访问外国。赫尔穆特·罗根堡深受打击，从那以后他一直在战场上游荡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他确实在战场上游荡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想这是因为王室会议。这就是现在流传的谣言。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
^0000cd据说^000000如果赫尔穆特成为国王，他将入侵杀害他父母的那个国家，并发动战争以统一大陆。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
而罗根堡的二儿子正在做生意，为战争筹集资金。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得这么详细？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
大家都知道。这里到处都是关于这件事的议论。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特成为国王并发动战争。
事实上，每个人都很焦虑。他们不喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他以外。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们的讲述。这正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果你还有问题，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你的书！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男人不会把任何人赶出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要什么吗？不过你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有关于罗根堡传闻的问题。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
关于那个家族没有新的故事。没有故事，就意味着死亡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来这里不是为了听新的传闻。我在找那个给你们讲故事的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁在传播这个谣言。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他的祖父让我给他带个口信。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
他们明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，情况不完全是那样... 嗯... 是的，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
这真的很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，确实如此。但有时候，即使是家人之间，见面也很困难，不得不请人代为传话。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次，你需要更可靠的凭证...

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！我们有客人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
亲爱的冒险者，是什么风把你吹到这里来了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
找到谣言最初传播者的方法，就是找到谣言的源头。但我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来看我的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。你的家人让我给你带个口信。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
谁是迈尔？^0000cd你的名字叫迈尔^000000吗？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你明明让我只叫你乔纳森的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。他们很可爱，但相处起来挺让人头疼的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔？还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我一声！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们。我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们是把耳朵闭上，还是让我们单独待一会儿？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是闭不上的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我想听。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
快过来！他们要谈重要的事了。大家，把耳朵闭上。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
真是乖孩子。谈完之后我会给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我的耳朵已经闭上了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊。那就谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啦啦啦啦啦 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明。我很好奇他们将来会长成什么样。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
是的。所以我在这里，就是为了观察、教导并引导他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯。这只是我能做的而已。对了，口信是什么？

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已移交继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了争斗。]

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
那太好了。他们是我的兄弟，我为他们感到骄傲。最幸运的是^0000cd狼改变了主意^000000。和他争论真的很烦人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
狼必须看到一切尘埃落定才算完。不过从某种角度来说，这也挺好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，他是我最喜欢的家人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你看到了我们家里不愉快的一面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争斗是很常见的事。我也...

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我觉得我得去一趟家里。虽然家里一直让人心烦，但我觉得这次去会很有趣。请告诉我的家人，在我工作期间，我会在这里帮助他们。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
还有，告诉他们宴会结束后我会去拜访他们。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
另外，请告诉阿格妮丝，很抱歉我不能陪她去参加宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
如果你需要帮助，随时来找我。我会竭尽全力帮助你。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you want business with us? But we don't meet with anybody.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你想和我们做生意？但我们不见任何人。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
We are not easy people anybody can speak to.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我们不是谁都可以对话的人。
回去。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Today, the wind is cold and smells rotten. I feel that something has happened.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
今天的风很冷，带着腐朽的味道。我感觉发生了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah, sorry, I couldn't clean myself for a few days.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，抱歉，我好几天没洗澡了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
是吗？我觉得他们在试探我。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
He has come with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
他空手而来。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
没有凭证的人听不到好消息。回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你怎么能这么说！你一定忘了该带什么。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12块软布^000000，^0000cd卢恩·米德加兹的历史书^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有嗯...^0000cd杀死33只大玫瑰^000000给艾伦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的东西，但有什么关系...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你听到了更多？如果是这样，你需要证明你有更强的凭证。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是一个召唤鲜血的仪式！一个毁灭与黑暗的仪式！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又开始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
请离开。我们会处理他的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争的威胁已经消失了。在动荡的时代，英雄是不会诞生的。黑暗在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又开始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
请离开。我们会处理他的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天气真好。
宫殿里的宴会正进行得如火如荼。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are happy as their business prospers when palace purchases lots of goods in large volumes. I will tell them to buy me a book tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[金]
因为宫殿大量采购物资，父母的生意兴隆，他们很高兴。我打算明天让他们给我买本书。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
End of today's diary.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今日日记结束。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天气真好。
宫殿里的宴会正进行得如火如荼。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
They will be all destroyed when a bloody day comes.
Why are we recording those vain things?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
当血腥之日来临，这一切都将被毁灭。
我们为什么要记录这些虚无的东西？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Because records remains forever.
If you record today, someone in the future will read them and remember us.
scripts.translation:
[金]
因为记录会永远留存。
如果你记录下今天，未来的人读到它，就会记得我们。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
人类生于虚无，归于虚无。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？为什么两手空空？我看不到你拿了我们让你拿的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因为我们是孩子就看不起我们吗？我真的很讨厌这种人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
嘿！你不是那种人吧？你看起来不像是那样的人。你是忘了该拿什么了吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12块软布^000000，^0000cd卢恩·米德加兹的历史书^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有嗯...^0000cd杀死33只大玫瑰^000000给艾伦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的东西，但有什么关系...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我正在读你给我的书，虽然它又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的梦想是成为历史学家。我想走遍米德加尔特，发掘那些被遗忘的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation:
[金]
乔纳森还了你借的书，并向我借了另外两卷。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.
scripts.translation:
[金]
乔纳森真棒！将来我要成为像乔纳森那样的人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
公主们的礼服一定很美很闪亮吧！我希望我能穿上尽可能多的漂亮裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
Are you having a beautiful day today too?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你好啊，唱歌的小鸟和漂亮的花朵。
你们今天也过得愉快吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
Why don't I have normal person around me?
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又开始了。
为什么我身边没有正常人呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Are you talking to me?
If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你在跟我说话吗？
如果是的话，你成功了。我听得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我太过伟大，不能被它束缚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？为什么两手空空？我看不到你拿了我们让你拿的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因为我们是孩子就看不起我们吗？我真的很讨厌这种人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
嘿！你不是那种人吧？你看起来不像是那样的人。你是忘了该拿什么了吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先，^0000cd12块软布^000000，^0000cd卢恩·米德加兹的历史书^000000

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有嗯...^0000cd杀死33只大玫瑰^000000给艾伦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
其中有些奇怪的东西，但有什么关系...他想要。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
请拜托我的母亲用这块布做衣服。
我母亲做的衣服很漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Now I guess that she is in the palace to repair the dresses of princesses.
Ah, I wish that she was here!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想她现在应该在宫殿里修补公主们的礼服吧。
啊，真希望她在这里！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
乔纳森说战争的威胁已经解除了。真是让人松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
亲爱的冒险者？你在这里做什么？这里很危险。刚才有魔物下来了。请立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没事。我已经习惯了每天被魔物攻击的生活。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
By the way what has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我忘了你是一位伟大的战士。请原谅我的无礼。
顺便问一下，是什么把你带到这里的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来这里是为了带赫尔穆特大人回去。您的祖父非常担心您。他说在这个关键时刻，您却离家在外。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我不回去。^0000cd我属于这里，前线^000000。请这样告诉我的祖父。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But everybody is worried about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是大家都为您担心。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我无法回去。事实上，自从我成熟以来，我就怨恨那些任由我父母死去的人。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我认为，发展出让人别无选择只能追随的力量，是正确的道路。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
所以，我的目标是统一大陆，让我的力量触及大陆的每一个角落。为此我不断训练自己。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
然而，当我听到迈尔和阿格妮丝的话后，我意识到我追求的道路会给某人带来悲伤和不幸。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
所以我决定^0000cd放弃那场将人们卷入战争漩涡的统一战争^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
这里才是我该待的地方。在这里，我可以^0000cd更安全地保护更多人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
考虑到我们家族的地位，我会配合王室议会所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
但我希望由狼来领导一切。当王室议会结束后，请告诉狼，我将^0000cd把继承人的位置移交给狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
狼需要大量的力量。我会留在这里保护我们的人民。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果你这样做，狼就不会坚持战争，迈尔也不会再那样牺牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我明白了。我会把您的话转告给您的祖父。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Yes. thank you. Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
是的，谢谢。请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
这里才是我该待的地方。
请告诉他，'^0000cd我放弃战争，并将继承人的位置移交给狼^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果你这样做，狼就不会坚持战争，迈尔也不会再那样牺牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我能感觉到大地在震动。
预计很快会有攻击，我必须做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Give shout of concentration!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
大声喊出专注的口号！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Louder!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
再大声点！！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
We!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我们！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I am very happy that I came back here.
Now I've got something to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
我很高兴能回到这里。
现在我有事要做了。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
而且我觉得赫尔穆特大人放弃统一战争是件好事。
我对统一一无所知，但我希望不要爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
在这里，我想帮助赫尔穆特大人保护人们的安全与和平。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
I think I should prepare something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
现在赫尔穆特大人开始感到口渴了。
我想我应该准备点喝的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
谢谢你来这里传达消息。如果没有你，我可能不会听今天听到的这些话。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
打，打，再打...我也不想要那样。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
他们是我的家人，比任何人都更亲近我。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Man]
Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
There are may eyes around.
scripts.translation:
[普通男子]
嘘！你最好不要跟我说话。
周围有很多眼睛盯着。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
在激烈的战斗后好好休息，是变强的快速途径。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族采用各种训练方式。休息是最重要的训练之一。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的前任家主们也在训练后充分休息。嗯，这太常见了，我就不多说了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
每个人可能都知道训练后想继续行动的感觉。然而，那正是该休息的时候。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
接下来的训练同样会很艰苦。您最好现在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我感觉您似乎跃跃欲试。看来是时候进行下一阶段的训练了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您好。侍从长告知我您会来，我一直在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这里是理查德家族的房间。这个家族一直掌控着王国的军事力量。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc
scripts.translation:
[管家]
久仰大名，{0}。您是平定莫洛克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉占用了您太多时间。房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请允许我为您引路。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这里是理查德家族的房间。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族继承人波正在休息。请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Have you met the next head of the family?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您见过家族继承人了？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果家族继承人见到您，{0}，请...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉我的失礼。没什么，请别介意...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
目前，这种训练对您来说可能过于艰难。您最好先打好基础，再进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的训练与其他训练计划有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您一定一直在独自猎杀魔物来训练自己吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
从现在开始，您可以针对特定类型的魔物进行训练，例如人类、动物、昆虫、鱼类、植物、恶魔、天使、虚无和龙类魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
与其说一百句话，不如挥剑一次来得有效。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good. Are you ready now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
很好。您准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯，似乎出现了无法解决的问题。请再尝试一次，如果问题依旧，请截图并发送给管理员团队。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Please select a training program to try.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请选择一个训练计划进行尝试。

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Human
scripts.translation: 战士修行-人类

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Animal
scripts.translation: 战士修行-动物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Insect
scripts.translation: 战士修行-昆虫

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Fish
scripts.translation: 战士修行-鱼类

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Plant
scripts.translation: 战士修行-植物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Devil
scripts.translation: 战士修行-恶魔

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Angel
scripts.translation: 战士修行-天使

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Immortal
scripts.translation: 战士修行-不死族

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Intangible
scripts.translation: 战士修行-虚无

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Dragon
scripts.translation: 战士修行-龙类

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 {0} monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练需要猎杀50只140级或以上的{0}魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Would you try this training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要尝试这项训练吗？

scripts.text: Try.
scripts.translation: 尝试

scripts.text: Do not try.
scripts.translation: 不尝试

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...您不喜欢这项训练的内容吗？没关系，您可以选择其他训练。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
即使您觉得训练对您的等级来说太简单，也不要掉以轻心。祝您好运...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Congratulations on completing the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
恭喜您完成训练。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果您坚持训练，终将达成您想要的目标。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这是我为您准备的完成训练后的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
感谢您参与我们的训练，这对理查德家族大有裨益。请不要有压力。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You are participating in the training. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您正在参与训练。有什么需要吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: About the way of training
scripts.translation: 关于训练方式

scripts.text: About the goal of training
scripts.translation: 关于训练目标

scripts.text: Give up the training.
scripts.translation: 放弃训练

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族一直关注如何培养出更优秀的战士。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族的前任家主之一认为，针对特定魔物的训练方式存在局限性。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
前任...以及前任的家主...啊！为了澄清一下，他虽然已经退休，但并没有去世。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...让我们回到正题...他提出了一种根据学员等级或魔物类型来调整训练的方法。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Well... The training began like that...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...训练就是这样开始的...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
关于训练的目标...这是一个既简单又复杂的问题。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
最显而易见的目标无疑是变强。如果我还年轻，我也会这样回答。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
不过，我想说的是，目标是保护身边的人。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal may be different for each warrior.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
对于每位战士来说，目标可能都不尽相同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我不会阻止您放弃。但您应该知道，迄今为止的训练进度不会体现在下一次的训练中。

scripts.text: Do not give up.
scripts.translation: 不放弃

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智的决定。对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Too bad. If you finished the training, you must have been able to reap the benefit of hard work.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遗憾。如果您完成了训练，本可以收获辛勤努力的成果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒险者？看来你现在需要更加刻苦才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I'd like to take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我现在想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是被邀请到宫殿的冒险者。我现在正在休息。请去门口找管家预约时间。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
That is the way to do it in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在宫殿里就是这样办事的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是那位在讨伐暗黑之王中立下赫赫战功的冒险者。你的事迹在宫殿里也是广为人知。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
尤其是我们，理查德家族，对你的事迹非常感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you want to know why?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你想知道原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，就算你不想听，我也要把我想说的说清楚。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
其实，你并不是自愿来到这里的。我相当确信，一定是那位大人把你叫来的。我理解这一点。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
虽然冒险者可能对宫廷事务不太在意，但理查德家族负责着卢恩·米德加兹的军事力量。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我们也培养了许多优秀的战士。哼！我突然有点好奇。你听说过理查德家族的战士吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，没见过。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哈哈，我想“理查德”这个名字在冒险者中也是很有名的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哎呀，我是不是有点自夸了。理查德家族应该更加努力才对。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
算了，既然这并不重要，那就过去吧。我已经很久没说过这么多话了。我渴了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Shall we take a rest before proceeding?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在继续之前，我们要不要休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，那我们就来说说理查德家族为什么对你感兴趣的原因吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
众所周知，理查德家族培养出了杰出的战士。我们有一套系统化的训练体系来支持这一点。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我虽然不太喜欢这种训练，但我相信这是基于家族经验的有效训练方案。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
请仔细听，因为我马上要说到重点了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想冒险者可能对此不太感兴趣；然而，有许多王室成员参与了讨伐暗黑之王的行动。我从他们那里听到了关于你事迹的报告。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
当我听到你做出的贡献时，我脑海中浮现出一个问题。如果一位自由冒险者参与到严格的训练体系中，会发生什么呢？我对此感到很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
如果你这样一位著名的冒险者愿意帮助我们，我很乐意支付一笔可观的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我觉得这是一个很有吸引力的提议。你愿意挑战理查德家族的战士训练体系吗？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我会尽力。

scripts.text: I decline.
scripts.translation: 我拒绝

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
看来这个提议对你没有吸引力。很抱歉，等你改变主意时再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
太好了！我喜欢你果断的决定。我很看重挑战精神。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
让我告诉管家这件事。你可以通过他来进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
不要小看那位将指导你训练的管家。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
他本身就是理查德家族的一员。他是一位杰出的战士。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想知道你对训练的奖励是否满意。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
目前很难提供比这更高的报酬。请把它当作一份兼职工作来做。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你可能觉得这很明显。然而，你训练得越多，理查德家族获得的益处就越多。我们愿意为此付费。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哦！你一定正在参加训练。那么，你觉得训练怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我年轻时也参加过这种训练。这让我想起了美好的旧时光。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
这里有各种各样的训练项目。请选择你想参加的项目。嗯，冒险者通常都会做他们习惯做的事。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
当你放松警惕时，意外就会发生。请务必时刻保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我相信对战士来说，最重要的是挑战精神。挑战自我，迈向下一个层次...这是最重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
普隆德拉的一家酒馆里曾流行一首战士之歌。我很遗憾，这些天听不到了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you like gambling by any chance? Doesn't the tension make you feel like a warrior in battle?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你碰巧喜欢赌博吗？那种紧张感难道不让你觉得自己像战场上的战士吗？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
喂！站住！
请接受安检检查。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
请将您的证件和个人物品放在这张桌子上，然后面向墙壁站立...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Martin! What are you doing?
Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
马丁！你在干什么？
我告诉过你，不要对客人无礼！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It is for the safety of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
这是为了女王的安全。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
你靠近女王是为了安保，而不是为了不礼貌地赶走客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
宫殿里这么混乱，怎么能用这种随和的态度来保护女王！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
在帝国法令期间，我们也无可奈何！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
现在的帝国法令只不过是...

scripts.text:
[Queen]
It is noisy out here.
scripts.translation:
[女王]
外面好吵。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Huh! Your majesty!
I am sorry.
We have a guest here.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
啊！陛下！
非常抱歉。
这里有一位客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Extend the queen every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
请对女王保持最高的礼遇。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I have something to you. Please talk to Jerad here.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
我有事要交代。请和这里的杰拉德谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I don't know why but Scarlet and Lidion have been on bad terms for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
不知道为什么，斯嘉丽和利迪昂已经很久不和了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
They are similar in age so that it would have been nice if they are friends...
However, they both have such strong personalities.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
他们年纪相仿，要是能成为朋友就好了...
不过，他们俩的性格都很强。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Of course, Scarlet looks several times younger.
It is supposed to be the characteristic of the Jahas.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
当然，斯嘉丽看起来年轻好几倍。
这应该是雅哈家族的特征吧。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Ernst told me that he would go to the Banquet Hall.
I wonder if he is still there.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
恩斯特说他要去宴会厅。
不知道他是不是还在那里。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
您在这里还有别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Extend the queen every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
请对女王保持最高的礼遇。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
给您添麻烦了，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
I am sorry.
There was nothing suspicious found of your belongings.
Let me return your bag.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
非常抱歉。
您的物品中没有发现可疑之处。
请拿回您的包。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Have you been going through it?
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
你们翻查过了吗？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It doesn't hurt to be careful when there are a lot of passengers around here.
I don't want to experience such thing again.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
这里乘客众多，小心一点总没错。
我不想再经历那样的事情了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Ha...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
哈...
非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
If you don't mind, how about talking to the members of the Geoborg family in the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
如果不介意的话，您可以去宴会厅和吉奥伯格家族的成员谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She has been taking care of the state affairs alone. Not to mention the Royal Assembly...
She hasn't been able to sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
她一直独自处理国事。更别提皇家议会了...
她已经好几天没睡好觉了。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您也许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
她虽然不是家族成员，但了解女王的一切。
[保镖 杰拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您也许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
她虽然不是家族成员，但了解女王的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
哦！
女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您也许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
她虽然不是家族成员，但了解女王的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Scarlet is much older than the queen, but she doesn't look that old at all.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
斯嘉丽比女王年长许多，但看起来一点也不显老。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Of course, the queen is well along in years now as well...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
当然，女王如今也已年事已高...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
I hope the queen and Ernst can take some rest now.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
我希望女王和恩斯特现在能好好休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
After the Royal Assembly is over, the queen may turn over the throne to the new king, and go to the castle of Scarlet.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
皇家议会结束后，女王可能会将王位传给新国王，然后前往斯嘉丽的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
I am a little worried for that I have been serving under the queen my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
我有些担心，因为我一生都在侍奉女王。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Do you have any business left here?
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
您在这里还有别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Welcome.
I am Queen Catherine D. Geoborg.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
欢迎。
我是女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am sorry if my knights have caused you trouble.
They are a little sensitive these days. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
如果我的骑士们给您添了麻烦，我很抱歉。
他们最近有些敏感，请多包涵。

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 询问关于乔博格家族的事

scripts.text: Leave the room.
scripts.translation: 离开房间

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I see.
Come back anytime if you have any other questions.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
我明白了。
如果您还有其他问题，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Since the banquet for you heroes is being held in the Banquet Hall, please enjoy your time here.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
既然为英雄们举办的宴会正在宴会厅举行，请尽情享受这里的美好时光。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
我们乔博格家族是创立这个世界的特里斯坦一世的后代。我们的家族世代产生了无数国王和骑士。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
In the first Royal Assembly which was held, the forth prince Ernst was elected as a candidate. However, he has given up his position in the Royal Assembly this time due to several incidents.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
在第一次举行的皇家议会上，第四王子恩斯特被选为候选人。然而，由于发生了几起事件，他这次放弃了在皇家议会中的职位。

scripts.text: What do you mean by several incidents?
scripts.translation: 您说的几起事件是指什么？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh... It slipped my tongue.
It is a little difficult to tell you about those incidents.
I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
哦...是我失言了。
向您讲述那些事件有些困难。
希望您能当作我没说过。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您来到这里，但我能告诉您的并不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
如果您还有更多问题，可以询问这里的杰拉德和土拨鼠。
由于有紧急公务，无法与您多作停留，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您来到这里，但我能告诉您的并不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
如果您还有更多问题，可以询问这里的杰拉德和土拨鼠。
由于有紧急公务，无法与您多作停留，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You mean Prince Ernst?
Well?
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您是指恩斯特王子？
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He comes here to say good morning and either helps me the work or does other things.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
他来这里向我道早安，然后要么帮我处理工作，要么做其他事情。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Ever since the banquet started, he has been carrying his work to somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
自从宴会开始以来，他一直在把公务带到别处处理。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He could be somewhere in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
他可能在宴会厅的某个角落。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Haven't you met Prince Ernst yet?
He just stopped by and went out again...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您还没见过恩斯特王子吗？
他刚才来过，又出去了...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am worried about the representative of our family wandering around like this.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
我很担心我们家族的代表这样四处游荡。

scripts.text: Tell her about what you have heard.
scripts.translation: 告诉她你听到的传闻

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh...
Dear hero, please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
噢...
亲爱的英雄，请不要太在意那些传闻。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
It is a problem that we, the Geoborg family, should get over ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
这是乔博格家族应该自我反省的问题。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
The ink pad of the highest quality to be used in the royal debate room?
It is the clerk who writes down everything. Why are they buying luxury item that no one will ever use...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
要在皇家议事厅使用的最高品质墨台？
那是记录员用来记录一切的。为什么要购买没人会用的奢侈品...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I have enough dresses to last my lifetime. Why do they keep making them...
A cutback!
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
我有足够穿一辈子的裙子。为什么还要一直做...
必须削减开支！

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Hum.. Trade request from Marol Kingdom...
I should dispatch an envoy to take care of it soon...
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
嗯...来自马罗尔王国的贸易请求...
我应该尽快派遣特使去处理...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，有什么可以帮您的吗，亲爱的冒险者？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 询问关于乔博格家族的事

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Heh!
Is there no one around here who is curious about me?
Everyone who ever talks to me talk about that!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
嘿！
这里难道没有对我感到好奇的人吗？
每个跟我说话的人都在说那个！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Don't be startled.
It is a joke.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
别被吓到了。
这是个玩笑。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
As you know, the Geoborg family is the descendant of...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如您所知，乔博格家族是...的后裔

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tristan I who have founded the kingdom!
Is there anyone who doesn't know the story in this kingdom?
Dear Lady Jaha.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
是建立了这个王国的特里斯坦一世！
在这个王国里，还有谁不知道这个故事吗？
亲爱的雅哈女士。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·乔博格！
您怎么会在宴会厅？您身体一定不舒服吧。
您应该在您的宅邸里休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我不能冒让雅哈家族的女士假装了解乔博格家族的风险。我不能就这样休息。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Phew, that old jerk!
He is younger than me and always tries to preach!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
呼，那个老顽固！
他比我年轻，却总是想对我说教！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Well... For that reason, the Geoborg family will retire to a quiet life for a while as soon as the Royal Assembly is over.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
嗯...因此，皇家议会结束后，乔博格家族将暂时退隐，过上安静的生活。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I really hope that Catherine doesn't suffer from sorrow anymore.
That's why I fully support such decision!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我真的希望凯瑟琳不再遭受悲伤。
所以我全力支持这个决定！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
不过，恩斯特王子却不知去向。
他的姨妈可是大老远赶来安慰他那可怜的外甥的，你知道吗！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我姐姐把我赶到了宴会厅，说她在忙。我也找不到我外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如果你在宴会厅遇到恩斯特，请告诉他来这里一趟。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
请整理你的背包并再试一次。-

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Haven't you found him yet?
Should I ask Catherine?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
你还没找到他吗？
我应该问问凯瑟琳吗？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
That expression on your face... You must have heard what people say.
There must have been no good stories in particular...
Please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
看你那个表情...你一定听到了人们的议论。
肯定没有什么好听的话...
请不要太在意那些流言蜚语。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Ernst must have been hiding from such whispers as well.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
恩斯特肯定也在躲避这些闲言碎语。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Well, I guess he needs some rest.
You hero, cheer up and enjoy the banquet!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
好吧，我想他需要休息一下。
英雄，振作起来，好好享受宴会吧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
What a waste to let the banquet end like this!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
让宴会这样结束，真是浪费！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, hero!
Are you having a good time?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，英雄！
你玩得开心吗？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you have some time to spare, please tell me some fun stories from your adventure.
I am sick of listening to Lidion's nitpicking.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如果你有空闲时间，请给我讲讲你冒险中的趣事吧。
我听腻了利迪翁的挑剔了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, is one of the seven royal families, but we are the creme de la creme for producing the highest number of kings in the history.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我们乔博格家族是七大皇家家族之一，但在历史上，我们是产生国王数量最多的家族，堪称其中的佼佼者。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
In fact, we are settled in Prontera, the center of the Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
事实上，我们定居在卢恩·米德加兹的中心，普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Despite the series of unfortunate events regarding the princes after the death of King Tristan III,
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
尽管在特里斯坦三世国王去世后，发生了一系列关于王子的不幸事件，

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Prince Ernst Geoborg was elected as the most regnant candidate in the last Royal Assembly. It shows just influential the Geoborg family is.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
但在上一次的皇家议会上，恩斯特·乔博格王子被选为最有力的继位候选人。这正显示了乔博格家族的影响力。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
He has given up from the position.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
他已经放弃了那个职位。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What?
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I said!
Prince Ernst gave up his position as the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我说！
恩斯特王子放弃了王位候选人的职位。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What a nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
真是胡闹！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
You didn't know!
You must have been separated from the outside world for too long!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
你不知道吗？
你肯定与外界隔绝太久了！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！
我绝不会让那个朽魔...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
朽魔？
即使你是家族长老，他依然是王子。你应该对他保持应有的礼遇。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:

啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tut...
Letting anybody in like this... The dignity of the palace has fallen down to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
真是的...
就这样让任何人进出...宫殿的威严早已荡然无存了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Did you hear the story?
The skeleton of King Tristan III has been found.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
你听到那个传闻了吗？
特里斯坦三世国王的骸骨被发现了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Oh my!
Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
天哪！
真是难以置信！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
It is a secret. Don't tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
这是秘密。不要告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
...So the princes must have been poisoned...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
...所以那些王子一定是被毒杀了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
What on earth!
Well, in the last Royal Assembly...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
真是荒唐！
就在上次的皇家集会上...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Ha!
He has given up the royal authority like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
哈！
他就这样放弃了王权！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Doesn't he even care for the people of his family?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
他难道不关心家族子民吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Your voice is too loud!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
你的声音太大了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
No...
I didn't say anything wrong.
Did I?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
不...
我没有说错话。
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How can he decide such a major issue as he wants?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
像这样重大的问题，怎么能由他一个人决定？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I knew it. He has been hanging out with that punk from the third-rate family too long...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
我就知道。他在那个三流家族的朽魔身边待得太久了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
So is the queen who is handling all the matters of the palace now?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
那么现在处理宫殿事务的是女王吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
She hasn't showed her presence to the public so far...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
她至今还没有在公众面前露面...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How foolish it is to give up the regal power like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
就这样放弃王权，真是太愚蠢了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I won't ever let go of such power!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
我绝不会放弃这样的权力！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Hey, you!
Not anyone can have such power.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
嘿，你！
不是谁都能拥有这种权力的。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Why not?
I am free to dream!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
为什么不行？
我有自由梦想的权利！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Is the Geoborg family cursed?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
吉奥堡家族是被诅咒了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Shh!
You shouldn't say such a thing so easily!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
嘘！
你不该这么轻易地说这种话！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
The women in the line here are so scary.
They curse, push and fight...
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
这里排队的女人们好可怕。
她们会诅咒、推搡和打架...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you just go back then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你为什么不干脆回去呢？

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
Are you telling me to go back when Jurgen is right inside of the door?
I won't!
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
尤尔根就在门里面，你让我回去？
我不回去！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I won't go before seeing the elegant and luminous presence of him!
I have come here from Payon to meet Jurgen!
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
在见到他优雅而光辉的身影之前，我绝不离开！
我从斐扬赶来，就是为了见尤尔根！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Jurgen treats us all the same. We should have a sense of fair play.
Who ever it was, turn yourself in!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
尤尔根对大家都一视同仁。我们应该有公平竞争的意识。
不管是谁，都请自首吧！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Who was it? Who pretended to be close to Katrin and went along with her? Come out here! We have made a pact not to stand out!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
是谁？是谁假装和卡特琳亲近，跟着她混进来的？出来吧！我们约定过不引人注目的！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen belongs to all of us! No one should have him to oneself! I won't let anyone to do that!
scripts.translation:
[妇女们]
尤尔根属于我们所有人！谁也不能独占他！我绝不允许任何人那样做！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
I won't let anyone monopolize Jurgen! The heaven may forgive, but I won't!
scripts.translation:
[妇女们]
我绝不允许任何人独占尤尔根！上天也许会原谅，但我不会！

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
It is no use getting a ticket number... It is just too difficult to wait for my turn.
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
拿到排队号码也没用... 要等到我的轮次实在太难了。

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
When will Jurgen come out?
When will be my turn to see him?
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
尤尔根什么时候出来？
什么时候轮到我见他？

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
There! If you are a newbie, don't be so naive and try to fit in here!
scripts.translation:
[单身女子]
喂！如果你是新手，别这么天真，想在这里混进去可没那么容易！

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
[Bachelorette]
Hey, don't you push me there! Stand in the line. Isn't it your first time here to see Jurgen?
scripts.translation:
[单身女子]
[单身女子]
嘿，别在那儿推我！排好队。难道你是第一次来见尤尔根吗？

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you lady! Don't push!
Stay in the line!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
嘿，那位女士！别推！
排好队！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
There was this lady who was carried out with a broken ankle from pushing!
It is all for your own good!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
刚才有位女士因为推搡被抬了出去，脚踝都骨折了！
这都是为了你们好！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Ha, I am already feeling tired as always.
I didn't know that women were so strong before.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
哈，我照例已经觉得很累了。
我以前不知道女人们这么强壮。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
I started yesterday and realized why the people who had worked here before quit.
Despite being with so many ladies here, I am not happy at all.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
我昨天才开始工作，就明白了为什么之前在这里工作的人都辞职了。
虽然身边有很多女士，但我一点都不开心。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
As you see, there are no guards guarding the doord to other family's residences.
However, there are too many infiltrators to the Wigner residence who get in there to see Jurgen. Now the door is guarded at all times.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
你看，通往其他家族住宅的门是没有卫兵看守的。
但是，试图潜入维格纳住宅见尤尔根的刺客太多了。现在门时刻都有人看守。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, be quiet there!
It is too noisy that Jurgen cannot take his beauty rest!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
哦，那边安静点！
太吵了，尤尔根没法好好休息！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
It is not for my sake, but for Jurgen.
It would make you sad if Jurgen is unable to sleep, right? So be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
这不是为了我自己，而是为了尤尔根。
如果尤尔根睡不好觉，你会难过的，对吧？所以请安静点！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, wait there! Stop there!
Aren't you the one who has infiltrated the room before? You don't have to run hiding your face! Come back here!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
哦，站住！别跑了！
你之前是不是潜入过房间？不用遮着脸跑啊！给我回来！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
She went off again. She sure is fast.
I am glad that my own sister doesn't come to a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
她又跑掉了。跑得真快。
还好我妹妹不会来这种地方。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
When I applied to become a guard, I wanted to keep the palace safe with my own hands...
Never did I know that I would end up here...
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
当初申请当卫兵时，我想亲手守护这座宫殿的安全...
没想到最后会落到这里...

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you! There! Stand in the line! Stop there! You shouldn't block the way!
If you keep doing that, I'll stop you from coming here!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
嘿，你！那边！排好队！站住！别挡路！
再这样，我就禁止你进来了！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, although I respect your hard work going through all the obstacles and hardships, it is still a little too early for you to be here.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，虽然我很敬佩你克服重重困难来到这里，但现在对你来说还太早了。
期待稍后见到你。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Who are you?
Only the people with permission can enter this place. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你是谁？
只有获准的人才能进入这里。请离开。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome to the Wigner family. My name is ^0000cdLevuiere Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎来到维格纳家族。我是^0000cd勒维埃尔·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I am honored by your visit while you are attending the banquet held for you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
在您参加为您举办的宴会期间，能收到您的拜访，我深感荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
This banquet carries more meaning than celebration since the Royal Assembly is conducted at the same time. Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
这场宴会不仅仅是庆祝，因为皇家议会也在同时举行。您听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There is a candidate from our family who participates in the Royal Assembly as well. Would you like to meet him?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们家族也有一位候选人参加皇家议会。您想见见他吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
She is the lady of the Wigner house, ^0000cdCatherine Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
她是维格纳家的女主人，^0000cd凯瑟琳·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
How do you do? Please make yourself at home while you are staying with us, the Wigner family. Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您好？在我们维格纳家族做客时，请像在自己家一样自在。如果您遇到任何不便，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We, Wigners, will support as much as possible for your convenience, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我们维格纳家族会尽最大努力为您方便，亲爱的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor too if you have the time, dear adventurer. You are always welcome.
Where is ^0000cdJurgen^000000 now?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
亲爱的冒险者，如果您有时间，也请参观我们的庄园。您随时欢迎。
^0000cd尤尔根^000000现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你在找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There you are! Dear adventurer, this is the ^0000cdheir of the Wigner family^000000, and the ^0000cdcandidate for the throne^000000 participating in the Royal Assembly this time.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你来了！亲爱的冒险者，这位是^0000cd维格纳家族的继承人^000000，也是这次参加皇家议会的^0000cd王位候选人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hello. My name is ^0000cdJurgen Wigner^000000. It is very nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你好。我是^0000cd尤尔根·维格纳^000000。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home here. If you need anything or find anything inconvenient, please let us know anytime.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，请在这里像在自己家一样自在。如果您需要任何东西或发现任何不便，请随时告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your hospitality.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你的款待。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那么，请原谅我的失礼。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Tut, I am worried that he lacks sociability. He would have to meet a lot of people as the heir of the house, you know. Dear adventurer, please excuse my son's discourtesy.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
唉，我担心他缺乏社交能力。毕竟作为家族的继承人，他需要结识很多人，您知道的。亲爱的冒险者，请原谅我儿子的无礼。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you like to meet our children? They have been excited to meet the hero who defeated Morocc in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果时间允许，您愿意见见我们的孩子吗？他们一直很想见见在宴会上击败摩洛克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then please make yourself at home and take a look around, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
那么，请像在自己家一样自在，四处看看吧，亲爱的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home and take your time looking around here.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，请像在自己家一样自在，慢慢参观这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you please tell our children the stories of your adventures? It would be an invaluable experience for them.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果时间允许，您能给我们讲讲您的冒险故事吗？这对他们来说将是无比珍贵的经历。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then, have a restful time.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
那么，祝您休息愉快。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, did you meet the children? I would love to have some tea with you and listen to your stories if you are available.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，您见到孩子们了吗？如果您有空，我很想和您一起喝杯茶，听听您的故事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
We like to hear the stories of adventurers very much.
Those adventures are valuable experiences that money cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们非常喜欢听冒险者的故事。
那些冒险经历是金钱买不到的宝贵财富。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children have observed their manners though. We must have spoiled them for that they sometimes act so imprudently.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不知道我们的孩子是否守住了礼仪。我们可能太宠他们了，所以他们有时会表现得有些鲁莽。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I am trying to warn them a little these days, Please excuse their behaviors if they have done anything rude to you.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
最近我一直在提醒他们。如果他们对您做了什么无礼的事，请原谅他们的行为。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. Jurgen seemed to have grown since my last visit.
Katrin and Isaac impressed me as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全不会。尤尔根看起来比我上次来访时更成熟了。
卡特琳和艾萨克也给我留下了很深的印象。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have been too easy on them.
We are ashamed that we were not prepared properly for the Royal Assembly last time.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我们对他们太宽松了。
上次皇家议会我们准备得不够充分，我们感到很惭愧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
It is not important whether he becomes the king or not.
If he is a king material, he will be. If not, he doesn't have to be the king. I don't want to stress him out for that.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
他是否成为国王并不重要。
如果他具备国王的潜质，他就会成为国王。如果没有，他也不必非当国王不可。我不想因此给他太大压力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't you have any ambitions? What a glory would it be if we turn out a king from our family of our generation!
Since our ancestors founded this kingdom, we deserve to produce a king.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您难道没有野心吗？如果我们这一代能出一位国王，那将是多么荣耀的事！
既然我们的祖先建立了这个王国，我们就理应产生一位国王。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
The king is a hollow position. It only comes with responsibilities?
Haven't I told you before? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
国王只是一个虚位，随之而来的只有责任。
我以前告诉过您吧？您忘了吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If our family turns out a king, much of our fortune will be spent. Once, our family has really suffered from it.
Near the king, there are always a swarm of pesky flies.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果我们家族出了一位国王，我们的许多财富都会消耗殆尽。曾经，我们的家族真的因此吃过苦头。
在国王身边，总有一群烦人的苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know, it could be the exact opposite.
It may reinforce our family.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您知道吗，情况可能恰恰相反。
这可能会巩固我们家族的势力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Now there are Katrin and Isaac who can back up Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
现在有卡特琳和艾萨克可以支持尤尔根。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Hum... Isaac.
Thinking of him makes me confident.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
嗯...艾萨克。
想到他，我就很有信心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must trust Isaac quite a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来您非常信任艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Oh, we must have left you out of the conversation, dear adventurer.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
哎呀，看来我们把你排除在谈话之外了，亲爱的冒险者。
真是不好意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I have been enjoying the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。我一直很享受这段谈话。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Now that you mention it, how do you find our third child, Isaac?
He is the most Wigner-like one among the children.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
既然您提到了，您觉得我们的第三个孩子艾萨克怎么样？
他是孩子们中最像维格纳家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
While Jurgen is interested in the looks, he doesn't really care for money or the throne...
If Katrin was a son, I would have gladly leave everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
尤尔根虽然注重外表，但他并不真正在乎金钱或王位...
如果卡特琳是个儿子，我会很乐意把一切都留给她。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Fortunately, the third child who used to be a mischievous boy has grown up to be suitable for the name of Wigner.
Not that the other two are inadequate.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
幸运的是，那个曾经调皮的三儿子已经长大，配得上维格纳这个名字了。
这并不是说其他两个孩子不够格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白您的意思。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Nevertheless, don't talk like that in front of the children. It is not good to favor a child.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不管怎样，别在孩子面前这样说。偏袒一个孩子是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
As a member of the Wigner family, one must be able to cope with criticism.
They should be able to determine what's right upon listening to the words of other people. Also, they need to be able to deal with the hard truths.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
作为维格纳家族的一员，必须能够应对批评。
他们应该能够根据他人的话语判断是非。此外，他们还需要能够面对残酷的真相。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please don't talk like that in front of the children.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
请不要在孩子面前这样说。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I never talk to them like this you know.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你知道的，我从不对他们这样说话。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Anyways, Isaac seems busy doing something these days. Do you know what he is doing?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
总之，艾萨克最近似乎很忙。你知道他在做什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I heard that he is doing something with the third son of the Roegenburg family. You don't need to worry about Isaac. He knows how to take care of himself.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我听说他在和罗根堡家族的三儿子一起做事。你不用担心艾萨克。他知道如何照顾自己。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Arghhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000

[Catherine]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000 Has something happened to my baby? I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
^0000cd卡特琳？^000000 我的孩子出什么事了吗？我得赶紧过去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You two stay here. It might be dangerous. Let me go take a look first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们两个留在这里。可能会有危险。让我先去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Has something happened to our child, I mean, Katrin?
Shouldn't I go down there myself?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们的孩子，我是说卡特琳，出什么事了吗？
难道我不应该亲自下去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous. Please wait here for a minute.
I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可能会有危险。请在这里稍等片刻。
我去。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎。
我问孩子们发生了什么事，但他们没有告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
他们是不是在对我隐瞒什么不好的事情...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他们没有。您不必为此担心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
那么请告诉我，那是关于什么的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他们决定不告诉您，那也不是我该说的事。
我还有些杂事要办，现在该走了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, you seem busy.
Is it about what our children have asked you?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，您看起来很忙。
是关于孩子们问您的那件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我们已经决定不再追问了。
虽然他们长大了，但我们还是忍不住把他们当婴儿一样照顾...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
总之，如果您需要帮助，请随时告诉我。
还有，谢谢您帮助我们的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, I have heard the story from the children.
They didn't go into all the details, but I heard that they owed you a huge favor.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，我从孩子们那里听到了故事。
他们没有说所有细节，但我听说他们欠您一个大人情。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The children are getting along so much better these days.
Not that they were on bad terms, but now they seen to care for one another more. I am so glad.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
孩子们最近相处得越来越好了。
虽然他们之前关系也不坏，但现在他们似乎更关心彼此了。我真高兴。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You seem to be the messenger of luck to our family.
It is our family tradition to keep a person like you close and treat well.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
您似乎是我们家的幸运使者。
按照我们家的传统，我们要好好对待像您这样亲近的人。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
We would be honored to have you as a guest to our home.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
宴会结束后，请去我们的庄园拜访。
能邀请您做客，我们深感荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hello, dear adventurer. Welcome!
We are honored by your visit to the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您好，亲爱的冒险者。欢迎！
维格纳家族很荣幸您的到来。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
As the lady of the house I would make your stay as pleasant as possible.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
如果您在这里感到任何不便，请告诉我。
作为女主人，我会让您的停留尽可能愉快。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You may talk to the head of the family standing next to me. His name is Levuiere Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您可以和站在我旁边的家族首领交谈。他的名字是勒维埃尔·维格纳。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Have you met our children? Having a conversation with you would be an invaluable experience for our children, dear adventurer.
They haven't been through any trouble growing up so we feel that they lack in various life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您见过我们的孩子吗？与您交谈对孩子们来说将是宝贵的经历，亲爱的冒险者。
他们成长过程中没经历过什么麻烦，所以我们觉得他们缺乏各种生活经验。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
