Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢！我的口袋什么时候破的？那^0000cd15个大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰...^000000
不见了！让我稍后再来！我忘了带东西了！

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
噢，什么时候才能结束啊。
我是不会放手的，真的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, hello.
Is it a bad time? Should I just go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，你好。
现在不方便吗？我该走了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, no.
By the way, you are back. Is it about the prince of the Wigner family again?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
噢，不。
顺便问一下，您回来了。又是关于维格纳家王子的事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen seems to be really serious about it.
He wants you to have these.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤尔根似乎很认真。
他想让您收下这些。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I turned it down.
Oh, this really is... So pretty. There is water inside this glass-like thing...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我拒绝了。
噢，这真的...好漂亮。这个像玻璃一样的东西里面有水...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen wants me to let you know about his heart as wide and beautiful as the sea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤尔根想让我告诉您，他的心像大海一样宽广美丽。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I really cannot go out with him. Well, there really is a reason that I cannot accept this feelings. I wonder if I should tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
噢，我真的不能和他交往。嗯，确实有原因让我无法接受这份心意。我在想是否应该告诉您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me. If you have a good enough reason which Jurgen can understand, he would not bother you again, Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我。如果您有足够充分的理由，让尤尔根能够理解，他就不会再打扰您了，玛丽。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I don't think it would be a good idea. You shouldn't tell this to anyone. Please keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我觉得这样不太好。
您不应该告诉任何人。
请保守这个秘密。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
In fact, I am ^0000cdthe younger sibling of the maid who used to work here^000000. The maid you have met before.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
其实，我是^0000cd以前在这里工作过的女仆的弟弟^000000。
就是您之前见过的那位女仆。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no wonder you couldn't remember my face. I found it a little strange. By the way, you two sisters must have worked here together.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，难怪我认不出您的脸。
我还觉得有点奇怪。
顺便问一下，你们两姐妹一定是一起在这里工作的吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, what would it matter since it is you whom he has fallen for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，既然他爱上的是您，这又有什么关系呢？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It matters. ^0000cdBecause, I am her brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
有关系。
^0000cd因为，我是她的弟弟^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you are...

[{0}]
Wha... What? A brother?

[Mary]
I am ashamed to work in this outfit since I am a man. However, there is a reason for me to stay here like this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
作为一个男人，穿着这身衣服工作让我感到羞耻。
但我留在这里这样做是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
My sister was very disheartened by what had happened to her and ran off with her lover saying that she couldn't work here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我姐姐因为发生的事感到非常沮丧，带着她的恋人离开了，说不能再在这里工作了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told the person who is in charge of managing the maids at the palace, he said, he didn't care about my sister running off against the contract ^0000cdas long as I would bring someone to fill her position^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
当我告诉负责管理宫殿女仆的人时，他说，他不在乎我姐姐违反契约离开，^0000cd只要我能找个人来填补她的空缺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
He added how ^0000cdan enormous indemnity would be imposed on us^000000 if we fail to do so.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
他还说，如果我们做不到，^0000cd将会对我们处以巨额赔偿金^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told him that I would fill her spot, he said there were enough male chamberlains and ^0000cdhe needed a maid^000000 who would work in the kitchen and run cleaning duties.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
当我告诉他我会填补她的空缺时，他说已经有足够的男性侍从了，^0000cd他需要一名女仆^000000来负责厨房工作和清洁。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I tried to find a replacement for her, but I couldn't. Everyone was already busy working at the palace or supplying the things for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我试着找个人替代她，但找不到。
每个人都已经忙着在宫殿工作，或者为宴会准备物资了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
After consulting my mother, I decided to work here pretending as if I was my sister. Since everyone was so busy, no one paid attention to me who was working quietly in this corner.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
在咨询了我母亲之后，我决定假装是我姐姐在这里工作。
因为大家都很忙，没有人注意到我在这个角落安静地工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have managed not to be busted so far.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您居然一直都没被发现。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Since ^0000cdI look just like my sister^000000, no one seems to notice.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
因为^0000cd我和我姐姐长得一模一样^000000，所以似乎没有人注意到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should we do then? Jurgen really wants you to accept his love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们该怎么办呢？尤尔根真的很希望您能接受他的爱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He is in sorrow saying how difficult it is to get the first thing he has ever wanted in this entire life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他很伤心，说这是他这辈子第一次想要得到的东西，却这么难得到。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I feel sorry for that ^0000cdthe first thing he has ever wanted to get happens to be fake^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我对此感到抱歉，^0000cd他第一次想要得到的东西，竟然是假的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I assumed that the people who have all the money in the world and have seen all the good things in the world must have a keen eye. I stand corrected.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我原以为那些拥有世界上所有金钱、见过世界上所有美好事物的人，眼光一定很敏锐。
看来我错了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You get blinded when you are in love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人在恋爱时，往往会变得盲目。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And, you really are doing so remarkably at what you are doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，你现在的表现真的很出色。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I should go back and tell him the truth.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想我还是回去告诉他真相吧。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh! No, you shouldn't. I told you. You are the only one who knows about it.
^0000cdIf I get busted, I would be in trouble^000000. We don't have the money to pay the compensation.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
哦！不，你不能说。我告诉过你的，只有你知道这件事。
^0000cd如果我被揭穿，我就麻烦了^000000。我们没有钱支付赔偿金。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am keep sending the message to my sister to comeback, but it seems difficult to reach her. Would you please keep it secret until the banquet is over?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我一直在给姐姐发消息让她回来，但似乎很难联系上她。请在宴会结束前帮我保守这个秘密好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen would keep sending me to earn your love, and this means that we are deceiving him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤尔根一直派我来争取您的爱，这意味着我们在欺骗他。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am sorry for him, but my life depends on this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我很同情他，但我的性命系于此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum, I don't feel comfortable doing this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我觉得这样做心里很不舒服...

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It is not my fault to be here in this clothing... Please feel for me.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
穿着这身衣服出现在这里并不是我的错...请体谅一下我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, OK. Calm down. I'll tell Jurgen that you have held off the answer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，好吧。冷静点。我会告诉尤尔根，您暂时还没有做出答复。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please take good care of the stuff. If you return them, he will send me down here again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请好好保管这些东西。如果您把它们还回去，他还会再派我下来。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Really? Then let me return them at once on the last day of the banquet. Please explain him well so that it doesn't hurt his feelings.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
真的吗？那请在宴会最后一天把它们还给我。请好好向他解释，别伤害了他的感情。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I guess I should change my cleaning area so that I don't bump into him.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
哦，我想我应该换个打扫的区域，以免和他碰面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I guess it would work.
Then, let me go tell him that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我想这样可行。
那么，让我去告诉他吧。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it?
I am worried about the consequences if anything goes wrong.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
你告诉王子了吗？
我很担心如果出了差错会有什么后果。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I may have to run off like my sister.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我可能不得不像我姐姐那样逃跑了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it? I hope he gives up from tomorrow without sending you down here again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
你告诉王子了吗？我希望他从明天起就放弃，不要再派你下来了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
噢，什么时候才能结束啊。
我是不会放手的，真的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，我觉得现在不是时候。我可以稍后再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
不，完全不是。
亲爱的冒险者，您的口袋有个洞。您是不是丢了什么东西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢！我的口袋什么时候破的？那^0000cd15个大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰...^000000
不见了！让我稍后再来！我忘了带东西了！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Adventurer? What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
冒险者？您来这里有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen sent me here to deliver his love to you again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤尔根派我再次来向您传达他的爱意。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Again... I really hoped he would have given up by today... I guess it must have been a vain hope.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
又是这样...我本来真希望他今天能放弃的...看来是我一厢情愿了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Please tell him I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
请告诉他，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I really want the banquet to be over soon. Or my sister could just come back.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我真希望宴会快点结束。或者，我姐姐能直接回来就好了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Anyway, I am sorry to put you in the difficult situation again today.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
总之，很抱歉今天又让您陷入这种尴尬的境地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then, since I have delivered you what I have to deliver you, I should get going.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，既然我已经把该传达的都传达给您了，我该走了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, please go back safely. I hope he gives up by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
好的，请路上小心。希望他明天能放弃。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
啊，我受够了打扫！家里已经够多东西要打扫了，我不需要在这里做更多。
我干脆放弃，逃跑算了。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Dear human, are you the one who have waken me up?
After a long sleep, I am waken up before such a mess.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
亲爱的人类，是你唤醒我的吗？
在漫长的沉睡之后，我醒来时面对的却是这样一团糟。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I am the god of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
You shall pay for your sin of interrupting my rest with cleaning.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我是封印在擦洗海绵中的清洁之神。
你打扰我休息的罪过，必须用清洁来偿还。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Let's see. This must be ^0000cda cluster of mold^000000!
You cannot get this mold without borrowing strength from its own race and the god.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
让我看看。这一定是^0000cd一团霉菌^000000！
不借助同族的力量和神明之力，你是无法清除这种霉菌的。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Bring ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
带来^0000cd1个霉菌粉末和1瓶圣水^000000！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Human, what are you doing now?
I told you! You need ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000 to clean up the mold!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
人类，你现在在做什么？
我告诉过你！你需要^0000cd1个霉菌粉末和1瓶圣水^000000才能清除霉菌！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
How can you clean up without them?
Go get them first.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
没有它们你怎么能清洁？
先去把它们找来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since you have the Mold Powder and alcohol with you, try getting rid of the mold now.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
既然你带着霉菌粉末和酒精，那就试着现在清除霉菌吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
This is not the proper way of wiping off the mold, but this is the only way to get rid of such severe mold.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
这不是擦除霉菌的正确方式，但这是清除如此严重霉菌的唯一方法。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Wipe the Mold Power over the mold which resembles demon's skin and sprinkle it with Holy Water.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
将霉菌粉末涂抹在像恶魔皮肤一样的霉菌上，并撒上圣水。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
And wipe it as I tell you. I am not going to tell you again so pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
按照我说的去擦。我不会再说第二遍，所以请专心。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Tap it once gently and tap it three times more. You really need to soak the wall with the Holy Water and Mold Powder to wipe it off. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
轻轻拍一次，然后再拍三次。你必须用圣水和霉菌粉末充分浸湿墙壁才能擦掉它。这非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Then, you need to scrub hard about ten times and wipe it off in circles about five times. Why don't you try now?
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
然后，你需要用力擦洗大约十次，并画圈擦拭大约五次。你不妨现在试试？

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
That's not it! You really need to be determined to get rid of the flower of devil.
Compose yourself and listen again carefully.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不对！你必须下定决心清除这朵恶魔之花。
调整心态，再仔细听一遍。

scripts.text:
Well done. You have cleaned it so well.
As a Scrub Sponge, I am very contented.
scripts.translation:
干得好。你清理得很干净。
作为擦洗海绵，我很满意。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since I have fulfilled my duty, I shall go now!
Thank you, human... Thank you for being with me for this life...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
既然我已经完成了职责，那么我要走了！
谢谢你，人类...谢谢你陪伴我度过这一生...

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
That's not it! Relax your arms a little!
Cleaning is not just about physical strength. You are still too far behind to reach the enlightenment. Ease your mind and body to try again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不对！手臂稍微放松一点！
清洁不仅仅是靠体力。你还差得远，无法领悟其中的真谛。放松身心，再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Wall Which Used to Be Moldy]
The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge which has been through the cleaning duty with me.
scripts.translation:
[曾经发霉的墙]
这面干净的墙壁让我想起了那个曾与我一起完成清洁工作的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Is it you...? Are you the one who has guided me to ^0000cdthe ingrained grease^000000?
Nice to meet you. I have been a sleep in this waiting for someone who would clean up something with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
是你吗...？是你指引我找到了^0000cd顽固的油渍^000000吗？
很高兴见到你。我一直沉睡在这里，等待一个能和我一起清理东西的人。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I am the fairy of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
I wake up when I am near somewhere dirty.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我是封印在擦洗海绵里的清洁妖精。
当我靠近脏的地方时，我就会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Thank you for choosing me to clean the grease.
I always wanted to clean grease in style.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
谢谢你选择我来清理油渍。
我一直想优雅地清理油渍。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Hum... For the ingrained grease, ^0000cdthe mixture of orange and alcohol^000000 works the best.
Would you bring ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000? Let's clean up with them!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
嗯...对于顽固的油渍，^0000cd橙子和酒精的混合物^000000效果最好。
你能带^0000cd1个橙子和1瓶酒精^000000来吗？让我们用它们来清理吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Oh, wait a moment!
You need ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000 to clean up the ingrained grease.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
哦，等一下！
你需要^0000cd1个橙子和1瓶酒精^000000来清理顽固的油渍。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I would like to prepare it myself but I am just a Scrub Sponge.
Please bring them with you.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我想自己准备，但我只是个擦洗海绵。
请把它们带过来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since we have the orange and alcohol, let's clean up together now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
既然我们有橙子和酒精，现在就开始一起清理吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Peel the orange and put the orange peels in the alcohol. Then wait a moment. You may eat the flesh of orange if you want. Yum!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
剥开橙子，把橙皮放进酒精里。然后等一会儿。如果你想吃，可以吃掉橙肉。真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Well, the essence of the orange peels must have been infused in the alcohol by now. Spray it over the grease and wipe with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
好了，现在橙皮的精华应该已经融入酒精中了。把它喷在油渍上，和我一起擦拭。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
It takes some skills to wipe it off.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
擦掉它需要一些技巧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First you need to scrub gently, gently once more and hard! Then scrub with medium strength and scrub harder.
You should then spray the mixture once more and keep wiping with medium strength.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
首先你需要轻轻擦洗，再轻轻擦洗一次，然后用力擦洗！接着用中等力度擦洗，再加大力度。
然后再次喷洒混合物，并持续用中等力度擦拭。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I think you are scrubbing too gently. You should allow sometime for the grease to dissolve in the mixture.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我觉得你擦得太轻了。你应该给油渍一些时间在混合物中溶解。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First, you need to penetrate the grease with the mixture. Then you need to wipe off the grease. Well, let's try again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
首先，你需要用混合物渗透油渍。然后你需要擦掉油渍。嗯，让我们再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Whoa, good job! The grease is gone now!
Even better, the fresh scent remains after cleaning, making the passengers happy.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
哇，干得好！油渍不见了！
更棒的是，清洁后留下了清新的香味，让乘客们都很开心。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I will disappear soon.
It is the fate of dirty Scrub Sponge.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过，我很快就会消失了。
这就是脏兮兮的擦洗海绵的命运。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I was happy to spend the short life of a Scrub Sponge with you.
I want to be born as a human in my next life to be a close... Friend of yours...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过，我很高兴能以擦洗海绵的短暂生命与你共度。
我想在下一世转世为人类，成为你的...亲密...朋友...

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
You shouldn't just wipe it too hard. You need to let the mixture melt into the grease to get it off.
Scrub gently and wipe it off at once. Well, listen up again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
你不应该只是用力擦拭。你需要让混合物渗入油渍才能将其去除。
轻轻擦洗并立即擦掉。嗯，再听一遍。

scripts.text:
[Scrapped-off Wall]
The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge has been really kind to me.
scripts.translation:
[被刮掉的墙]
干净的墙壁让我想起擦洗海绵，它真的对我很好。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Is it you? Are you the one in charge of the cleaning mission today?
Nice to meet you! I am the cleaning instructor sealed in the Scrub Sponge!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
是你吗？你是今天负责清洁任务的人吗？
很高兴见到你！我是封印在擦洗海绵里的清洁教官！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
If you follow my lead, you can get through the most difficult cleaning mission in this world!
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
只要跟着我的指挥，你就能完成世界上最艰难的清洁任务！
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Let's check today's target! It is ^0000cdthe black dirt of devil^000000 stuck in the gaps in the floor!
We have a Thor 3 situation here!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
让我们看看今天的目标！是卡在地板缝隙里的^0000cd恶魔黑垢^000000！
这里情况紧急，需要立即处理！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
In other words, we can resolve it as long as we have all the materials ready!
You need ^0000cd1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon^000000 to get rid of the target!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
也就是说，只要备齐材料就能解决！
你需要^0000cd1个黄晶沙和1个柠檬^000000来清除目标！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Go get them now!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
现在去准备吧！
出发！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
What are you doing now?
You cannot get rid of the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles without the lemon and powdery find sand!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
你现在在做什么？
没有柠檬和黄晶沙，你是无法清除卡在瓷砖缝隙里的黑垢的！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Prepare 1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon now!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
现在准备1个黄晶沙和1个柠檬！
出发！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Good! It has all been prepared!
Let's start cleaning now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
很好！一切都准备好了！
让我们开始清洁吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Squeeze the lemon and sprinkle the juice over the floor. Then sprinkle the powdery fine sand over it!
This will whiten and polish the floor! Not to mention the fresh scent of lemon adding something extra!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
挤开柠檬，把汁液洒在地板上。然后撒上黄晶沙！
这样可以让地板变白变亮！而且柠檬的清新香味还能增添额外效果！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Then you scrub briskly with me!
The method of scrubbing is as follows! It is not difficult if you follow me! Listen up!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
然后和我一起用力擦洗！
擦洗方法如下！只要跟着我就很简单！听好了！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Three times to the left! Once to the right! Once to the left again! Twice to the front!
Then twice to the left to wrap up! Start now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
向左三次！向右一次！再向左一次！向前两次！
最后向左两次收尾！现在开始！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Wrong!
Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
错了！
集中注意力！再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Well done!
You have completed the cleaning mission beautifully!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
做得好！
你完美地完成了清洁任务！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I believe that you can handle cleaning perfectly even without me!
Old soldiers never die! They just fade away! So save the tears!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我相信即使没有我，你也能完美地处理清洁工作！
老兵不死，只会逐渐凋零！所以别哭！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
You may think of me whenever you see and clean the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles!
Now disperse! Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
当你看到并清理卡在瓷砖缝隙里的黑垢时，可能会想起我！
现在解散！去吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
When did I teach you like that? Don't you dare say that you have learned it from me!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我什么时候教过你那样做？不准说那是跟我学的！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
集中注意力！再听一遍！

scripts.text:
[Shining Floor]
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
Let's go back to the maid and report that the cleaning is completed.
scripts.translation:
[闪光的地板]
干净的地板让我想起擦洗海绵，它外表强硬但内心柔软。
让我们回去向女仆报告清洁已完成。

scripts.text:
[Shining Floor]
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
scripts.translation:
[闪光的地板]
干净的地板让我想起擦洗海绵，它外表强硬但内心柔软。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, my arms, legs, back and my entire body hurts. Well, I am just glad that today's work is done. I can take some rest now. I should go have some hot soup. Is it supposed to be the meat soup for today?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哎呀，我的胳膊、腿、背，全身都疼死了。不过还好，今天的工作总算做完了。终于可以休息一下了。我该去喝碗热汤。今天应该是肉汤吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请问可以问你个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Is it about furniture delivery? I am off my duty today. Unless it is really urgent, would you please come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么事？是关于家具配送的吗？我今天已经下班了。除非是特别紧急，否则请明天再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I am exhausted from today's work. I almost cannot stand with my back straight now.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
今天的工作让我精疲力竭。我现在连腰都直不起来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not about that. You are the one who has delivered the furniture to the Wigner family, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不是那件事。你是把家具送到维格纳家的那个人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I have... Is there any problem with the furniture? What should I do? I would never be able to afford the furniture!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
是的，我送过...家具出什么问题了吗？我该怎么办？我可买不起那些家具啊！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What if there is a dent? Should I call James to fix it? Damage? Wrong delivery? What should I do? What is it about?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
如果是磕碰了？要不要叫詹姆斯来修？损坏了？送错了？我该怎么办？到底怎么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing like that. Please relax.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不是那样。请放松。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Additional delivery? I really want to take some rest now... However, I guess I have no choice since it is the Wigners that I am dealing with. Oh, I really hate it... It is just too difficult to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么事？还要额外送货？我现在真的很想休息...不过，既然是维格纳家的事，我也没得选。唉，真讨厌...维持生计真是太难了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I just have a question for you. Have you seen a small box on the table in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我只是想问你一下。你在房间的桌子上看到一个小盒子了吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What box? I was busy delivering the furniture... Wait, I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么盒子？我忙着送家具呢...等等，我想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You mean the ^0000cdsmall box^000000 on the table next to the bed, right? The locked box with no particular decoration.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你是说床边桌子上那个^0000cd小盒子^000000吧？那个没有特别装饰的上锁盒子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I believe so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I remember it. It was a simple box without any decoration, but it looked very classy.
The wood was of the finest quality and the locking device was exquisite. I could tell that it must have been made by a master artisan at a glance.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
是的，我记得。那是一个没有任何装饰的简单盒子，但看起来非常典雅。
木材是一等品，锁具也极其精致。我一眼就能看出，那一定是出自某位工匠大师之手。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Since I work with furniture, a piece like that really catches my eyes. It really was a work of art.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
既然我从事家具行业，这样的作品确实很吸引眼球。那真是一件艺术品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was the box still there after you delivered the furniture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在你送完家具后，那个盒子还在吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, it was. The box cannot move itself, can it?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
在的。盒子又不会自己移动，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, wait? Are you telling me that it is missing? Are you implying that it has been carried out in my carriage?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哦，等等？你是说它不见了？你是暗示它被装在我的马车里带走了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Please calm down. I am not suspecting you. I just want to listen to your story. I am just tracking the whereabouts of the box based on the words of the people who have seen the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。请冷静。我没有怀疑你。我只是想听听你的说法。我只是根据见过那个盒子的人的描述，在追踪它的下落。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If anything goes missing, it is always us, the ordinary people, who are suspected. Do you know that it is just a prejudice?
The people who have less must be hungry for money. And they are unvirtuous...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
如果有东西丢了，总是我们这些普通人被怀疑。你知道这是一种偏见吗？
那些贫穷的人一定很贪财。而且他们品德低劣...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is just a misunderstanding. Trust me, I am not suspecting you.... You know, you look for any witnesses when a person goes missing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这只是个误会。相信我，我没有怀疑你...你知道的，当有人失踪时，你总会寻找目击者。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I don't want to hear it! Why are you scaring an innocent furniture delivery man for some missing box?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我不想听！为什么因为一个丢失的盒子，就要吓唬无辜的家具送货员？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I am just asking everyone who has been in that room. I am not suspecting you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉让你感到不适。我只是在询问所有进过那个房间的人。我没有怀疑你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Heh, not that it makes me feel any better. I think I may be feeling even worse since I am hungry. Oh, my stomach is growling... I don't feel well...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哼，这并没有让我感觉好受一点。我觉得我现在感觉更糟了，因为我饿了。哦，我的肚子在叫...我不太舒服...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you need something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你需要吃点东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
It doesn't change anything even if you say that...Well, I may be able to let it go if I have some Ox Head Slices... I cannot forget the taste from 10 years ago...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
就算你这么说，情况也不会改变...好吧，如果我能吃到一些牛头肉片，我或许就能释怀了...我忘不了10年前那个味道...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it make you feel better?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样会让你感觉好些吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, not that it will... OK, good! I'll let it go for ^0000cd3 Ox Head Slices^000000! Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
嗯，虽然这并不能...好吧，很好！为了^0000cd3牛头肉片^000000，我就原谅你了！毕竟公平就是公平。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it be enough? OK, please wait for me then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样足够吗？好的，请等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset as I get parched with thirst.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你来了。如果你再晚一点来，我会非常生气的，因为我口渴得厉害。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Your hands seem empty.
Did you forget? I said I would let it go with ^0000cd3 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你的手里空空如也。
你忘了吗？我说过只要给我^0000cd3 {0}^000000，我就原谅你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't let it go without them! I won't! I'll tell people that there is an adventurer who frames an innocent person! He!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
没有它们我绝不原谅！绝不！我会告诉所有人，有一个冒险者在诬陷无辜的人！就是他！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset due to my raging stomach.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你来了。如果你再晚一点来，我会非常生气的，因为我的肚子饿得难受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it was very difficult to get them. Here you are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，弄到它们非常困难。给你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Let's see! Oh, this is it! Have you had good wine with some Ox Head Slices? You will never get over this heavenly combination!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
让我看看！哦，就是这个！你吃过搭配美酒吃的牛头肉片吗？这种绝妙的组合让你回味无穷！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
This tastes the same as it did 10 years ago! Now I feel fully recovered from the fatigue! I don't feel tired any more! All the stress is gone!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
这味道和10年前一模一样！现在我感觉疲劳完全恢复了！我不再感到累了！所有的压力都消失了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, it sure looks delicious. I should try some later. Anyways, do you know anything else about the box?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，看起来真美味。我稍后应该也尝尝。总之，关于那个盒子，你还知道些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Are we still talking about it? Let's not talk about such thing while I am enjoying some wine and meat. My carriage is heavy when I get in, but it is as light as a feather when I get out.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我们还在谈论那个吗？当我在享受美酒和肉食时，请不要谈论那种事情。当我上车时，马车很重，但当我下车时，它轻如鸿毛。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If you feel suspicious, ask the Gate Guard. He inspected my carriage.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
如果你觉得可疑，去问问城门卫兵。他检查过我的马车。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, well. By the way...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哦，对了。顺便问一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
顺便问什么？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Have you seen the princess of the family? You must have. Doesn't she appear suspicious to you? I can tell people's character by their faces. She seems to be hiding something. She may stab you in the back.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你见过那位公主了吗？你肯定见过。她看起来不觉得可疑吗？我能从人的脸上看出他们的性格。她似乎在隐瞒着什么。她可能会在背后捅你一刀。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't it called a prejudice to judge some based on the appearance?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
仅凭外表就判断一个人，这难道不是偏见吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are right. I feel sorry, However, there are people talking about it. There's no smoke without fire.
No? Well. Perhaps, there could be smoke without fire.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你说得对。我很抱歉。不过，确实有人在议论此事。无风不起浪。
不是吗？嗯。也许，无火也会有烟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Katrin was not that kind of person as far as I observed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
据我观察，卡特琳并不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, if not, that's fine. Anyways, the box was there in its place when I left the room. You may go if you don't have any business left here.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
嗯，如果不是那样，那就好。总之，我离开房间时，那个盒子就在那里。如果你没有其他事，可以走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Dear adventurer, why are you here again? Didn't you say you were heading back to the palace?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
亲爱的冒险者，你怎么又回来了？你不是说你要回宫殿吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Do you have more things to as me? Or are you going to drink with me?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你还有别的事要问我吗？还是说你要陪我喝酒？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't mind.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I should earn enough money to open a store of my own. The owner only lets me deliver the furniture and never teaches me how to make one.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我应该赚够钱开一家自己的店。老板只让我送家具，从来不教我怎么制作家具。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
All the cutting and delivery work will break my back.
Oh, my back hurts.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
所有的切割和搬运工作都会累坏我的背。
哦，我的背好痛。

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
I finally have the strawberry cake no one has ever touched.
The things I have been through to keep the cake in the expedition camp... I am about to burst into tears... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[良孙]
我终于拿到了那块没人动过的草莓蛋糕。
为了在探险营地保住这块蛋糕，我经历了太多...我快要哭出来了...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
Strawberry! Strawberry! This strawberry cake belongs to Ryosun! I won't give it to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[良孙]
草莓！草莓！这块草莓蛋糕是良孙的！我不会给任何人的。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Are you having a good time?
We have put a lot of efforts since it's a big event in the palace in a long while.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
您玩得开心吗？
这是宫殿里很久以来的一次大型活动，我们投入了很多精力。
希望您喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always my pleasure to attend a banquet. Traveling and learning about different cultures are always interesting. It just makes it better to have good music and delicious food.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
参加宴会总是我的荣幸。旅行和了解不同的文化总是很有趣。如果有美妙的音乐和美味的食物，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always tiring to attend a banquet. I am still tired from the trip, it is just too painful to mingle with people... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
参加宴会总是很累的。我还在旅途的疲劳中，与人应酬实在太痛苦了...呼...

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The Palace of Rune Midgarts is so big and glamourous. It somewhat feels exotic too. It's been a long way, but I am glad to be here.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
伦米德加特的宫殿如此宏大华丽。它甚至带有一点异域风情。路途遥远，但我很高兴能来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Oh, aren't you the adventurer who has saved the world? Please visit Portmalaya someday. Everyone will welcome you there! Your story is known even to a far away place from here!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
哦，您不就是那位拯救了世界的冒险者吗？请有一天来波塔马拉亚。那里的人都会欢迎您！您的故事甚至传到了离这里很远的地方！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The music played by the music makes me so emotional. It is worthwhile to come here for this music alone.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
乐手演奏的音乐让我如此感动。光是为了这音乐，来这里就值得了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Wait, I have been looking at the flowers here. Are they blinking? How wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
等等，我一直在看这里的花。它们在眨眼吗？太美妙了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I visited the Palace of Rune Midgarts long time ago. It has changed a lot ever since. It has become much more glamourous and magnificent that I really enjoy being guided around this place.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我很久以前就参观过伦米德加特的宫殿。自那以后它变化很大，变得更加华丽宏伟，我很享受在这里被引导参观。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
There are a long of people here. I almost feel dizzy. However, still, I like the lively atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
这里人真多。我几乎要头晕了。不过，我依然喜欢这种热闹的氛围。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I have come to Prontera to attend the banquet from Amatsu. It sure feels totally different from Amatsu. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我从樱花城来普隆德拉参加宴会。感觉和樱花城完全不同呢。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Grandfather, don't overtax your strength.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
爷爷，别太勉强自己了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
All the nobility who are in charge of the market in Rune Midgarts are here. We, the Cat Hand Services, shouldn't miss this chance.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
负责伦米德加特市场的所有贵族都在这里。我们“猫爪服务”可不能错过这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I'll score contracts as tall as my height.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我要签下和我身高一样高的契约。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I am an old fan of Orint of the band.
I have spent a lot of money and time not to miss any of his performance.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我是乐队成员奥林的资深粉丝。
我花了很多钱和时间，只为不错过他的任何一场演出。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It was very difficult to get my hands on the invitation to this banquet.
It was so exclusive that I almost joined the expedition!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
拿到这次宴会的邀请函非常困难。
它太专属了，我差点就加入远征队了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The twin sisters of the band are of completely different characters. However, they are good at imitate each other.
When they pretend to be one person, they really looks like Doppelgangers.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
乐队的双胞胎姐妹性格截然不同。不过，她们很擅长模仿对方。
当她们假装是同一个人时，真的看起来像分身。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
You have been invited to the banquet as well.
Well, no wonder... If you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
你也受邀参加宴会了。
嗯，难怪...仔细想想也是。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, you are still alive!
I am glad to see you here. Life must be treating you well!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，你还活着！
很高兴在这里见到你。生活一定对你很好吧！

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
Come to think of it, Kid is here too.
He met the people from the guild and went to see them...
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
说起来，小孩也在这里。
他遇到了公会的人，就过去找他们了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hum... Then he was taken by a strange guy among the bunch to the dining hall.
You may go say hi.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯...然后他被那群人中的一个奇怪的家伙带到了餐厅。
你可以去打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
It is a banquet in a long time. We may as well enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
这是很久以来的一场宴会。我们不妨好好享受一下。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, this is how the aristocrats spend their time!
Haha, let's see which lady is wearing the most beautiful dress.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
原来贵族们是这样打发时间的！
哈哈，让我们看看哪位女士穿着最漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Who are you...?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你是谁...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
...Oh... You have visited us to change your class, I remember.
We have recommended you as a representative of the guild.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
...哦...我记得你来过我们这里转职。
我们推荐你作为公会的代表。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am glad to see you all grown up.
Never forget the weight of the blood to be covered on your hands at all times.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
很高兴看到你长大了。
永远不要忘记你手上沾染的血的重量。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You must have been invited to the banquet.
So are we.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你一定是受邀参加宴会的。
我们也是。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is rare to see the palace open to public like this. Enjoy as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
像这样向公众开放宫殿的机会很少见。
请尽情尽兴吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...I don't like a crowded place like this, but I cannot help it when I am on a mission.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
...我不喜欢这种拥挤的地方，但执行任务时身不由己。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are here too.
Well, I guess you are supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你也在这里。
看来你本该出现在这里。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...What a trouble.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
...真是麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, is it the first time since our last encounter for your class change?
Thanks to your contribution, the position of the guild has been strengthened.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，这是自上次为你办理转职以来我们第一次见面吧？
多亏了你的贡献，公会的地位更加稳固了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I guess you will be the hero of the palace.
I am glad to see you well.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我想你将成为宫殿里的英雄。
很高兴看到你一切安好。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hum... Did we meet at Criatura?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯...我们是在克里阿图拉见过的吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I have dealt with too many people...
Your face seemed familiar...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我接触的人太多了...
你的脸看起来很眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Well whatever.
Are you enjoying the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
算了，无所谓。
你在宴会上玩得开心吗？

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I really like banquets.
The drowsy music, the whispering people and the chamberlains carrying the refreshments. I think I am nobly born to see it.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
我真的很喜欢宴会。
慵懒的音乐，低语的人群，还有端着点心的侍从长。我觉得自己生来就是为了欣赏这一切的。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I know this banquet is held for someone else. However, it still is a great opportunity for me to meet someone I can spend my life with.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
我知道这场宴会是为别人举办的。不过，这对我来说也是一个寻找能共度一生之人的绝佳机会。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
Everyone else seems to love the banquet, but I don't. I am forced by my parents to come here. I really want to go home and take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
其他人都似乎很享受宴会，但我并不喜欢。我是被父母逼着来的。我现在真的很想回家休息。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
This band is pretty good.
I'd like to invite them to the royal villa for my party.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
这支乐队相当不错。
我想邀请他们去皇家别墅参加我的派对。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Ellie]
Dwit! Look at the nobility over there. Aren't they beautiful?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 艾莉]
德威特！看那边的贵族们。他们是不是很迷人？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Hum, yes they are. I think you would fit in there perfectly though.
One day, I'll play the guitar next to you dancing and singing in a blue dress.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
嗯，确实如此。不过我觉得你在那里会非常合拍。
总有一天，我会弹着吉他，看着你穿着蓝色裙子跳舞唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Haha, that woman in the blue dress, it could be me!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
哈哈，那个穿蓝裙子的女人，说不定就是我！

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
You are mistaken if you think I cannot distinguish you twin sisters, Occi. I can tell your differences from the steps you take and the sound of your breath.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
奥奇，如果你认为我分不清你们这对双胞胎姐妹，那就错了。我能从你们的步态和呼吸声中分辨出你们的不同。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
When I first met Orint, I thought he was stoic and unconcerned. However, he turned out to be a man of extraordinary concentration and possessiveness.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
当我第一次见到奥琳特时，我以为他冷漠且漠不关心。然而，事实证明他是一个拥有非凡专注力和占有欲的人。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
He always tries to be the best. That's why he can play the tune like that.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
他总是力求做到最好。这就是为什么他能演奏出那样的旋律。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
However, he doesn't know when to concentrate. His behavior is often misread.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
然而，他不知道何时该专注。他的行为常常被误解。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Anyways, we are invited to an honorable place like this thanks to Orint.
If you want to hear any song, ask him to play it for you.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
总之，多亏了奥林特，我们才能受邀来到如此尊贵的地方。
如果您想听什么曲子，尽管请他为您演奏。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
It has been our dream to ensemble in a place like this. Am I right, Orint?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
能在这里合奏一直是我们的梦想。我说得对吗，奥林特？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
Chatting is forbidden while working.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
工作时禁止闲聊。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Yes, I see. You are so boring. But it is part of your charm, haha.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
好的，我知道了。你真无趣。不过这也是你魅力的一部分，哈哈。

scripts.text: - That lazy-looking cat is sitting near the feet of the musician. It shows no interest in you. -
scripts.translation: - 那只看起来懒洋洋的猫正坐在乐师脚边。它对你毫无兴趣。 -

scripts.text:
[Hiba Ajif]
Since Ashbacuum has been taken care of, I want to go home and take a nap. However, they are holding me here.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉夫]
既然阿什巴克姆的事已经处理好了，我想回家睡个午觉。但他们把我留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
It is the event to praise our contributions. Try to smile a little.
scripts.translation:
[顾问 阿维达尔]
这是为了表彰我们的贡献而举办的活动。试着笑一下。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Brother, these shoes hurt my feet. May I go back to the guest room and sleep?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
哥哥，这双长靴把我的脚磨疼了。我可以回客房睡觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
I have spent too much time in the tension between the two races. It just feels like I am dreaming to be in a happy and relaxing place like this. This must be what they call peace, right?
scripts.translation:
[顾问 阿维达尔]
我在两个种族的紧张关系中耗费了太多时间。身处如此快乐放松的地方，感觉就像在做梦一样。这大概就是所谓的和平吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If they really want to do something for us, they really let us take a rest.
Only the ones who don't work in the field like an event like this. It is true.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
如果他们真的想为我们做点什么，就该让我们好好休息。
只有那些不在前线工作的人才喜欢这种活动。确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Argh... I have never been to a place like this...
I am so nervous... I shouldn't have come...
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
啊...我从来没来过这种地方...
我好紧张...我不该来的...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Everyone dresses so fancy...
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
大家都穿得那么华丽...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
By the way, where has the master gone leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
对了，师父把我一个人丢在这里，他去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Banquets are fun!
Good food! Beautiful music! People talking to one another!
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
宴会真有趣！
美食！美妙的音乐！人们互相交谈！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have heard that my grandson is under indebtedness to your son these days.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我听说最近我的孙子欠了你儿子一笔债。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Not at all. My son is supposed to be learning from your smart grandson. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
哪里哪里。我儿子应该是在向你聪明的孙子学习。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please take care of our son, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
请多关照我们的儿子，艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Many things have changed since the last time we were here in the palace. I want to come here more often, but we cannot find the excuse to come...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
自从我上次来到宫殿以来，很多事情都变了。我想更常来这里，但我们找不到合适的借口...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You can come here with an invitation. It is not difficult visiting here.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
您可以持邀请函前来。来这里并不困难。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know that is not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
你知道我说的不是这个意思...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear Roegenburg, how are your children doing? I often hear about your third grandson from Isaac/
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的罗根堡，您的孩子们近况如何？我经常听艾萨克提起您的第三个孙子。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Oh, they are doing fine. Please visit our home when you get the time.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
哦，他们很好。如果您有空，欢迎来我家做客。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I have a lot of study to do... I feel terrible to be dragged to a banquet like this.
scripts.translation:
[巴盖特·蒂布莱克]
我有很多功课要做...被拉来参加这种宴会，我觉得很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I wonder if Theodor is handling the work well by himself.
scripts.translation:
[巴盖特·蒂布莱克]
不知道西奥多一个人处理工作是否顺利。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
I really like banquets. Especially the ones hosted by the palace! Everything is so glamourous and sparkly!
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
我真的很喜欢宴会。尤其是宫殿举办的！一切都那么华丽闪耀！

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
In a banquet like this, we, women, study other women. About who is wearing which dress and what kind of jewelry she is wearing...
scripts.translation:
[贝阿特丽丝]
在这种宴会上，我们女性会观察其他女性。比如谁穿了哪条裙子，戴了什么首饰...

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
Those judging eyes are as sharp as those of ferocious beasts. If we find a lady who looks fabulous, we admire her looks with pure admiration.
scripts.translation:
[贝阿特丽丝]
那些审视的目光像凶猛的野兽一样锐利。如果我们发现一位看起来很棒的女士，我们会带着纯粹的欣赏去赞美她。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hahahahaha!
I should have seen the face! Please invite me to one of those events next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哈哈哈哈！
我真该看看那表情！下次请邀请我参加这样的活动。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Oh, you are always so busy, Isaac. A banquet like this one is the only occasion I can see your face.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
哦，你总是那么忙，艾萨克。像这样的宴会是我唯一能见到你面的机会。

scripts.text:
[Beitrice]
Yes! You must be ranked in top 3 of the busiest people in Prontera these days, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[贝特丽丝]
是的！艾萨克，你现在肯定是普隆德拉最忙的前三名之一。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
He also comes home late after discussing business with Isaac everyday. I really don't like it.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
他每天和艾萨克谈完生意都很晚才回家。我真的不喜欢这样。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't you say such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
别这么说！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh! I am sorry to keep Bryan with me. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哦！抱歉让布莱恩一直陪着我。请原谅我。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, please understand. It is the most important time for our business. I'll tell him to devote his time to you after this time is over, dear Sophia.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不过，请理解。这是我们要务最关键的时期。等这段时间过去，我会让他把时间都花在你身上，亲爱的索菲娅。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, you should keep those words!
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哦，你可要记住这句话！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll make sure of it. I swear in the name of Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我会做到的。我以艾萨克·维格纳的名义起誓。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Haha, since you have promised me in the name of your family, I guess I can trust you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
哈哈，既然你以家族之名向我承诺，我想我可以信任你，艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't leave me alone today. I feel nervous if you are not next to me.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
今天别丢下我一个人。如果你不在我身边，我会感到紧张。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh dear, I want to catch up with the people whom I haven't been able to see for a long time. You may go talk to other people.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哎呀，我想去见见那些很久没见的人。你可以去和别人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
They only talk about business. I don't enjoy it at all. I don't want to feel like being at work when I am here.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
他们只谈生意。我一点也不喜欢。在这里，我不想有上班的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Then, you should follow me.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
那你应该跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Well.. I don't feel comfortable... With too many ladies around...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
嗯...我不太自在...周围的女士太多了...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, darling, I love to be here in the palace after a long time. There are so many friendly faces around here.
However...
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哦，亲爱的，我很高兴能在这里待这么久。这里有很多熟悉的面孔。
不过...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Everyone else looks so nice, and I feel rather underdressed.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
大家都穿得那么漂亮，我觉得自己穿得有点寒酸。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
It is not true! You are the most beautiful person in this place. You are the only one I see here.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
不是这样的！你是这里最美的人。我只看到你一个人。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, I am so embarrassed...
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哦，我太害羞了...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you are going to borrow a book, you'd better reduce your luggage. It seems that there is no space for a book.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
如果你要借书，最好减少你的行李。看起来没有空间放书了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Have you read the book? Did you come to return the book. Well, seeing your hands empty, it seems that you didn't finished the book yet.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
你读过这本书吗？你是来还书的吗？嗯，看你两手空空，看来你还没读完。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
花点时间四处看看。拿出并阅读任何你喜欢的书。
书籍总是能丰富心灵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, I'm looking for a book. Would you please advice me where it is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，我在找一本书。你能告诉我它在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What kind of book are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
你在找什么书？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A book about history of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一本关于卢恩·米德加兹历史的书。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Hm... history of Rune-Midgarts.
Are you going to borrow the book?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯...卢恩·米德加兹的历史。
你要借这本书吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
May I see your library card, please?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
请出示你的借书证。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Library card? I don't have such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
借书证？我没有这种东西。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, I cannot borrow a book to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
那么，我不能把书借给你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I have a library card?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我怎么才能得到一张借书证？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you present your identification card, we will make you one instantly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
如果你出示你的身份证，我们会立刻为你办理一张。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... I don't have it. I left all my things to attend the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我没有。我把所有东西都留在参加宴会的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Banquet? You mean the banquet held in the palace? Are you the adventurer invited to it?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
宴会？你是说在宫殿里举办的那个宴会吗？你是受邀参加的冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I am...

[Uptight Librarian]
Then you are a person guaranteed by the kingdom and I can borrow a book to you through a simple process.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
那么，你是受王国担保的人，我可以走一个简单的流程把书借给你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The kingdom circulated your details and ordered to provide maximum convenience to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
王国已经传阅了你的资料，并下令为你提供最大的便利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's nice, but I feel that privacy is not protected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很好，但我感觉隐私没有得到保护。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What is you name, sir?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
请问，先生，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Let me see...
Yes, here it is. Sir {0}...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
让我看看...
是的，在这里。{0}先生...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
But this book consists of 12 volumes. Only the first volume is here and the others are already borrowed.
Is it OK with you?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
但这本书共有12卷。这里只有第一卷，其他的都已经被借走了。
这样可以吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is.

[Uptight Librarian]
Hmm. Anyway, can I ask you some questions? I know nothing as I stay in the library all day long.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯。无论如何，我可以问你几个问题吗？因为我整天都待在图书馆里，什么都不知道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I tell you as long as I know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，只要我知道，我就告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd宫殿里正在举办什么样的宴会^000000？为什么你和王室成员都被邀请了？

scripts.text: Birth of prince.
scripts.translation: 王子的出生

scripts.text: Birthday of king.
scripts.translation: 国王的生日

scripts.text: In memory of defeating Morocc.
scripts.translation: 纪念击败摩洛克

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才说错了，因为想到了别的事情。
我搞错了。你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd宫殿里正在举办什么样的宴会^000000？为什么你和王室成员都被邀请了？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Ah, I see.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
啊，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd所有王室成员^000000都参加了宴会吗？

scripts.text: 8 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 8个王室成员参加了

scripts.text: 7 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 7个王室成员参加了

scripts.text: 6 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 6个王室成员参加了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?

[{0}]
