scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd所有王室成员^000000都参加了宴会吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The palace must be crowded. It is very rare that all royal families gather like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
宫殿里一定很拥挤。所有王室成员像这样聚在一起是非常罕见的，但是...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
我听说有王室成员^0000cd不参加皇家议会^000000。那是谁？

scripts.text: Wigner and Heine.
scripts.translation: 维格纳和海尔内

scripts.text: Roegenburg and Richard.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡和理查德

scripts.text: Geoborg and Walther.
scripts.translation: 吉奥堡和瓦尔特

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才说错了，因为想到了别的事情。
我搞错了。你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
我听说有王室成员^0000cd不参加皇家议会^000000。那是谁？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, it is understandable that the Geoborg and the Walther do not attend the assembly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯，吉奥堡和瓦尔特不参加议会是合情合理的。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
前任国王的家族^0000cd因为古老的诅咒^000000才变成了这样...

scripts.text: You mean the Nerius?
scripts.translation: 你是说内里乌斯？

scripts.text: You mean the Geoborg?
scripts.translation: 你是说吉奥堡？

scripts.text: You mean the Richard?
scripts.translation: 你是说理查德？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才说错了，因为想到了别的事情。
我搞错了。你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
前任国王的家族^0000cd因为古老的诅咒^000000才变成了这样...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Yes, you are right. it is ^0000cdthe Geoborg^000000. The queen must be lonely.
Thank you very much for advising me though you are busy.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
是的，你说得对。是^0000cd吉奥堡^000000。女王一定很孤独。
虽然你很忙，但还是非常感谢你的提醒。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I have been alone these days as no one has visited the library due to the banquet.
History of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
这几天因为宴会，没有人来图书馆，我一直很孤单。
《卢恩·米德加兹的历史》。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
You can borrow it for one week. There is a fee for overdue books, but I was instructed to make you exempt from it
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
你可以借阅一周。逾期会有罚款，但我被指示对你免除这项费用。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, if you make much of honor, you will not be overdue.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯，如果你很看重荣誉，就不会逾期的。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, enjoy the book!
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
那么，祝你阅读愉快！

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
花点时间四处看看。拿出并阅读任何你喜欢的书。
书籍总是能丰富心灵。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
There are so many guests attending the banquet.
However, since we are in the library, would you keep it down?
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
参加宴会的客人真多。
不过既然我们在图书馆，请小声一点好吗？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Are you attending the banquet and exchanging greeting with each family?
Then you should go see Spica Nerius, not me.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
你是去参加宴会，和各家族交换问候的吗？
那你应该去找斯皮卡·内里乌斯，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Although Shedhar, the current head of the family, is not here, Spica has all the actual power.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
虽然现任家主谢德哈尔不在这里，但斯皮卡掌握着所有的实权。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am just participating in the Royal Assembly to fill in the place as a Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我只是作为内里乌斯家族的一员，来填补皇家议会的席位罢了。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am not interested in the throne at all.
So you should go see Spica.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我对王位毫无兴趣。
所以你应该去找斯皮卡。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Enjoy the banquet too.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
也请好好享受宴会。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Did you meet Spica?
She is such a cheerful girl, isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
你见到斯皮卡了吗？
她真是个开朗的女孩，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She will be the head of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
她将成为内里乌斯家族的家主。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am treated like a prince since I was adopted against my will. However, Shedhar, the head of the family, has been nice to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我是被违背意愿收养的，因此一直被当作王子对待。不过，家主谢德哈尔对我很好。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She told me to do whatever I wanted.
...She even let me decide whether I should attend the ritual or not,
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
她让我想做什么就做什么。
...甚至让我自己决定要不要参加仪式，

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I think I will be forgiven whatever I do.
I seem to have gained freedom and negligence at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我想无论我做什么都会被原谅。
我似乎同时获得了自由和疏忽。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I like the way it is now though.
I can do whatever I want to do.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
不过我喜欢现在的状态。
我可以做任何我想做的事。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh! This! That! This!
And there it is!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
噢！这个！那个！这个！
还有那个！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, I don't have this book in my collection!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
噢，我的收藏里没有这本书！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
How great to be in the palace! There is everything!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
能在皇宫里真是太好了！这里什么都有！

scripts.text:
[Alf]
Oh! This book must be the one from the legend...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
噢！这本书一定是传说中的那本...

scripts.text:
[Alf]
I wasn't interested in attending the royal banquet...
However, I am glad to be here!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我本来对参加皇家宴会没兴趣...
不过，我很高兴能在这里！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here either....
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
这里也没有....

scripts.text:
[Taunting Man]
Why do you need that book? Just go without it.
scripts.translation:
[出言挑衅的男子]
你为什么要找那本书？没有它也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
The first impression is the most important. The first greeting has a big impact! By the way, what should I speak as a greeting?
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
第一印象最重要。第一次问候影响很大！顺便问一下，我该说什么作为问候？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
'Good morning, sir. I, an unworthy person, live in Prontera....' No. No. I cannot speak like to a person who is younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
“早上好，大人。我，一个不配的人，住在普隆德拉....” 不。不。我不能对比我年轻的人这样说话。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Hi? Your brother told me to attend the banquet. No. No. this is not either. My patner is a princess!
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
嗨？你哥哥让我来参加宴会的。不。不。这也不行。我的搭档是公主！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Why is there no book such as ¡®Royal Etiquette - Meet Princess First Time' It's a royal library.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
为什么没有像《皇家礼仪 - 初次见公主》这样的书？这可是皇家图书馆。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
He sent me on the excuse of being busy. Jonathan, I'll get you.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
他以忙碌为借口把我打发走了。乔纳森，我会收拾你的。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here, either. How can I find it. There are so many books here.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
这里也没有。我该怎么找到它呢？这里有太多的书了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
Would you enter the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation:
[皇家守护骑士]
您愿意进入宴会厅吗？

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
The Banquet Hall will be open at all times. Please honor the banquet with your presence.
scripts.translation:
[皇家守护骑士]
宴会厅将全天候开放。请莅临宴会，以您的出席为荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[皇家守护骑士]
请允许我为您引路。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
Chatting is forbidden while working.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
工作时禁止闲聊。

scripts.text: Please play a song
scripts.translation: 请演奏一首曲子

scripts.text: Wrap up the conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
This is not a song in the program...
How about listening to a song I recommend?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
这不是节目单上的曲子...
不如听听我推荐的曲子？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <I miss you>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《我想你》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Alpen Rose>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《阿尔卑斯玫瑰》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Tales of East>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《东方传说》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Dream of Whale>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《鲸鱼之梦》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Dazzling Snow>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《璀璨之雪》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Marschmallow Waltz>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《棉花糖圆舞曲》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Eclage>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《埃克拉珠》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <One Step Closer>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《更近一步》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Not so Far away>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《并不遥远》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Theme of Alberta>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《艾尔贝塔主题》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Splendide Dreams>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《辉煌之梦》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Jittering Nightmare>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《颤栗梦魇》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Yuna Song>.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《尤娜之歌》。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.
This is not a song in the program...
How about listening to a song I recommend?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
我将演奏《早安》，这首歌背后有一个悲伤的故事。
它并不在节目单上...
不如听听我推荐的歌曲？

scripts.text: I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.
scripts.translation: 我将演奏《早安》，这首歌背后有一个悲伤的故事。

scripts.text: - Unlike her gaze glaring at the table while being cautious about the surroundings, the speed of her eating the food on the table is so remarkable that it is almost artistic. -
scripts.translation: - 尽管她警惕地环顾四周，目光却紧紧盯着餐桌，进食的速度快得惊人，简直堪称艺术。 -

scripts.text: - There is a girl with a expressionless face looking at the table. Her outfit seems rather unusual in Prontera. She could be a guest attending the banquet. -
scripts.translation: - 一个面无表情的少女正看着餐桌。她的穿着在普隆德拉显得颇为独特。她可能是参加宴会的宾客之一。 -

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
...I am hungry.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
......
...我饿了。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Ah....!

[Glamorous Girl]
You... At Cheshrumnir...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
你...在瑟斯隆尼勒...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Hum hum!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
哼哼！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...I am sorry Niren...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...对不起，尼伦...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Shh! Shh! Do not call me by the name, please. We are not officially invited to be here! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
嘘！嘘！请不要叫我的名字。我们并没有正式受邀来到这里！别忘了这一点！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Eh...
How did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么来到这里的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you come here?
Is it something dangerous? Is it about the international affairs or the international situation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎么来到这里的？
是有什么危险吗？是关于国际事务还是国际局势...

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
.....
In secret.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
.....
秘密地。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...The banquet... Something tasty.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...宴会...美味的食物。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
<Miss Lang>
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
《朗小姐》

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Woman with Glasses]
In the <Miss Lang Guide> which is written by Miss Lang who is the most prominent gourmet in Midgards, there is Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
在由米德加尔特最著名的美食家朗小姐所著的《朗小姐指南》中，提到了普隆德拉宫殿。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Good food and drink are the most enjoyable things in life. It is worth pursuing them. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
美食美酒是生活中最享受的事物。追求它们是值得的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
....
...It tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
....
...味道很好。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Anyways, we have managed to find this dining room where aren't many people. But we need to go back soon.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
总之，我们找到了这个没什么人的餐厅。但我们得快点回去了。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
I have been telling people that we are in costumes. I guess our outfits are not very appropriate for this kind of occasion in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
我一直告诉别人我们穿的是戏服。看来我们的穿着并不适合普隆德拉这种场合。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Well, I guess you have looked around enough. Let's go back before anyone comes.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
好了，我想你也看够了。在有人来之前，我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
Yes...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
是的...

scripts.text: - However the cookie plate is held tightly by the right hand of the Pope. -
scripts.translation: - 然而，那块碟仙恶灵被教皇紧紧握在右手中。-

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Oh, who is this.
You are{0}the one who would lead to the highest peaks of dark art, right?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
哦，这位是。
{0}，你就是那位将引领黑暗艺术登上最高峰的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You've been invited to this banquet too?
Hum, are you the hero of the century recommended by the guild?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你也受邀参加这场宴会了吗？
哼，你是公会推荐的本世纪英雄吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ha, what a nonsense to disregard me, Dumk!
I can never agree to that.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
哈，无视我邓克简直是胡闹！
我绝对无法接受这一点。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
By the way, where is Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
顺便问一下，维森特在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hey, you assassin, do you know Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嘿，你个刺客，你认识维森特吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
...Cut it out there, Dumk...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
...别在那儿胡说了，邓克...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's been a long time. Did you catch up with Lin and Ekinasia?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好久不见。你追上琳和埃基纳西亚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
她们在那豪华的地方看起来很兴奋...

scripts.text: ...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...
scripts.translation: ...站在一个不属于你的地方真是让人头疼...

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You are a visitor to the Prontera Palace.
Do you need a guide?
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
你是普隆德拉宫殿的访客。
你需要向导吗？

scripts.text: Valkyrie Realm
scripts.translation: 瓦尔基里雷恩

scripts.text: Royal Villa
scripts.translation: 皇家别墅

scripts.text: Banquet Hall
scripts.translation: 宴会厅

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You may move to the northern corridor from here.
There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
你可以从这里前往北走廊。
北走廊的中间是瓦尔基里雷恩的入口。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
左边的门是皇家别墅的入口。
那里有海尔内、内里乌斯和瓦尔特家族的住所，以及一间为特殊客人预留的房间。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
沿着右边的走廊走到中间，会出现一扇大门，你可以从那里进入宴会厅。

scripts.text:
[Noblesse Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffNoblesse^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[贵族操作员]
您好。
这里有可以用{0}兑换的^4d4dff贵族^000000装备。
我会根据您的职业引导您进行兑换。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
You can exchange the Honor Marks given by the noble people of Rune-Midgarts as the token of trust with some valuable items of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
您可以将卢恩·米德加兹的贵族们作为信任象征赠送的荣誉勋章，兑换成普隆德拉的一些珍贵物品。

scripts.text: Consumables
scripts.translation: 消耗品

scripts.text: Armors
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: View item description
scripts.translation: 查看物品说明

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
Would you view the item description?
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
您要查看物品说明吗？

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
The ^3131FF{0}s^000000 you can exchange with the Honor Marks are as follows.
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
以下是可以用荣誉勋章兑换的^3131FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
^3131FF{0}^000000... You've been looking at this.
It is a useful-looking {1}.
It can be exchanged for ^FF0000{2} Honor Marks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
^3131FF{0}^000000...您一直在看这个。
这是一个看起来很有用的{1}。
可以用^FF0000{2}荣誉勋章^000000兑换。

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
For the glory of Prontera!
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
为了普隆德拉的荣耀！

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
You don't have enough Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
您的荣誉勋章不足。

scripts.text:
[Commissary Arner]
It is the symbol of honor in Prontera. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation:
[军需官 阿纳尔]
这是普隆德拉荣誉的象征。请妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
你就是那个被邀请参加人人都在谈论的宴会的冒险者吗？
你有<荣誉勋章>吗？能给我一些吗？

scripts.text: Why do you need them?
scripts.translation: 你为什么要它们？

scripts.text: Give 30 Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 给予30个荣誉勋章

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
即使我在这里辛苦工作一辈子，也总是活在阴影里。
如果是男人，就应该有远大的梦想。我总是对阿纳尔这么说，但他就是太死板了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我不梦想一夜暴富，但既然我是个男人，我就想要一些荣誉。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
贵族们绝不会让我处理什么大机会。不过，你可能已经获得了一些<荣誉勋章>，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
If you give me ^FF0000 30 <Honor Marks>^000000, I'll give you something really useful.
For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
如果你给我^FF0000 30个<荣誉勋章>^000000，我会给你一些真正有用的东西。
对我们这种人来说，<荣誉勋章>意味着快速晋升。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我手里有一个包裹好的盒子，那是阿纳尔拥有的物品之一。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
它是正品，因为它是专门制作来分发给贵族的。但我不知道里面是什么。这取决于你的运气。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
收集完所有的荣誉勋章后，我要在海边建一座城堡，和那个固执的阿纳尔一起度过余生。
那个愚蠢的阿纳尔。要不是有我，他会在宫殿里一直兑换东西直到老死。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I have told you I need 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我告诉过你，我需要30个。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Thank you. This is the thing I have promised.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
谢谢。这就是我答应给你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
How terrifying.
This must be Prontera in the past?
I guess we have picked the right time to be here-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好可怕。
这应该是过去的普隆德拉吧？
看来我们选对了时间来到这里——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Shall we look around more?
Or go back?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们要不要四处看看？
还是回去？

scripts.text: It that possible?
scripts.translation: 这有可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, don't you underestimate me.
I am a Court Mage.
I studied in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，别小看我。
我是宫廷魔法师。
我在埃克拉珠学习过。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have also learned a lot of things at the Cat Paw Services!
I believe that I have the most thorough knowledge when it comes to the crack of dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我在猫爪服务处也学到了很多！
我相信在维度裂缝这方面，我的知识是最渊博的！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As long as it is from a place on the crack of dimension,
It is a piece of care to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
只要是从维度裂缝中的某个地方出发，
回去就是一件小事！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Since we don't belong to this time, it is much easier to get out than to enter.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
既然我们不属于这个时代，离开比进入要容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So, what are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，你打算怎么办？

scripts.text: Let's get in.
scripts.translation: 让我们进去。

scripts.text: Let's go back to our time.
scripts.translation: 让我们回到我们的时代。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you remember the gate we got out?
It is supposed to be connected to the inside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你还记得我们出来的那个门吗？
它应该连接着宫殿内部。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, we arrived here. I guess the spaces are twisted a little so that they are connected.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
然而我们来到了这里。我想空间稍微扭曲了一下，所以它们连接在了一起。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have already experimented this. If you enter the entrance to the palace,
It is connected to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 which we have just been to.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我已经实验过了。如果你进入宫殿的入口，
它会连接到我们刚才去过的^4d4dff王室往事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, shall we march in?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，我们要不要进去看看？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，我们现在整理一下思路吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意识室^000000里原本的东西一定是...
嗯，这肯定和现在^4d4dff亡灵大军袭击普隆德拉^000000有关。
嗯，一定是^4d4dff被他们拿走了^000000，对吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 没错。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们能阻止这件事吗？
或者，我们能把它带走吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我相信上级会命令我们这样做的。
尽一切办法让它成功吧。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也许，这只是我的想象。
意识室里的东西被拿走了，对吧？
然而，王室家族一直在进行仪式，却对此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他们一定做了什么，或者它已经回来了...
这或许能让我们看到被封印的^4d4dff王室家族的记忆^000000...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说，那些知道真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
是的，我是那个意思。如果这就是打开封印的关键真相，
那么我们就带着重要的情报回来了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们并没有保护或带走那个东西...
但我们现在知道了真相。这会打破文件的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
随着王室秘密的揭露，我们将拼凑出缺失的拼图。
哈哈哈哈哈，而你将成为这一切的中心，我的亲爱的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 别那样叫我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那又怎样？
从现在开始，我们每天都会见面，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，我们回去吧？
我们在这里的任务暂时完成了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们回去吧！
在一个不属于我们时代的地方待太久，不会有什么好事的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，准备好！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha! This place is exciting...
...As always.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈！这个地方真刺激...
...一如既往。

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 让我们离开这里！

scripts.text: I'll look around.
scripts.translation: 我要四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
祝你旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go it!
Forget everything and let's get out-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
让我们走吧！
忘掉一切，让我们离开——

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey, you need to be cured first.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿，你得先接受治疗。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh... Those undead bastards... I'll kill them all...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可恶...那些不死族混蛋...我要杀光他们...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh.... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可恶....那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My colleague who had been laughing with me just... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刚才还和我一起笑的同事...唉...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please. Don't get yourself killed by the enemy.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
拜托了。别被敌人杀了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What was it that had dropped from the sky? How could it bring the undead to the capital?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刚才从天上掉下来的是什么？它怎么能把不死族带到首都？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll... I'll make sure to defend this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我会...我会誓死保卫这里。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless battle against the enemies...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
与敌人的无尽战斗...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
An eccentric scientist, Doyeon, went out there with soldiers, and there has been no message from them. I am getting worried.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
那位古怪的科学家道渊带着士兵们出去了，至今没有消息。我很担心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Damn it... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
该死...那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Scientist Doyeon... Would she be OK? How can she go out there to study in a situation like this?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
科学家道渊...她没事吧？在这种局势下，她怎么能出去研究？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The troops of immortality... They are really strong. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
不死族的军队...他们真的很强。请小心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We will defend the palace of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们要保卫普隆德拉的王宫。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My family live in Prontera. I wonder if they have fled safely.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的家人住在普隆德拉。不知道他们是否安全撤离了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god... The undead are not coming this way much. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
谢天谢地...不死族没有朝这边来。真是松了口气。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My friend has followed Scientist Doyeon. I am worried. I have heard that she really is an oddball.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的朋友跟着科学家道渊出去了。我很担心。听说她真的很古怪。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahaha, I was supposed to have a romantic dinner with my girlfriend, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，我本来要和女朋友吃浪漫晚餐的，该死！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Humph! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哼！来吧！

scripts.text: [Soldier]
scripts.translation: [士兵]

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Are you an adventurer? I am sorry, but I am in the middle of something. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
你是冒险者吗？抱歉，我手头正忙。请别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
谨代表普隆德拉卫兵向您致谢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
We will make sure to end the battle with the undead as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我们会尽快结束与不死族的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听说被派往村公所附近的士兵说，您帮助了村民们。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
他是个在村里待了一段时间的年轻男子。看起来工作很勤勉...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
不过，经营普隆德拉冶炼厂的夸德罗先生似乎在混乱中丢失了一份重要文件。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
他负责管理卫兵使用的武器。我担心这会给他的工作带来麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
哦！总之，感谢您帮助了村民们。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
由于目前局势艰难，我们无法提供太丰厚的奖励，但这是卫兵们为您准备的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldiers dispatched to the Knights' building that you saved Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听说被派往骑士团的士兵说，您救了洛温。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Lowen is a spirited girl who claims that she likes the Crusaders to the Royal Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
洛温是个活泼的女孩，她声称自己从十字军喜欢到了骑士领主。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Rosa who is the younger sister to the girl is also popular among our soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
那个女孩的妹妹罗莎，在我们士兵中也很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
谨代表普隆德拉卫兵向您致谢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
由于目前局势艰难，我们无法提供太丰厚的奖励，但这是卫兵们为您准备的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the village office that a soldier on his vacation has been fled here.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听说被派往村公所的士兵说，一名休假中的士兵逃到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I guess there has been a soldier on vacation during such a difficult time. I had been ignorant of it before I got the report.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我想，在如此艰难的时刻，竟然有士兵在休假。在收到报告之前，我对此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I am faced with my inadequacies as the one in charge of the security of the capital.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
作为负责首都安全的人，我深感自己的不足。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
由于目前局势艰难，我们无法提供太丰厚的奖励，但这是卫兵们为您准备的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier in the cathedral that you saved the couple, Eryus and Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听说大教堂的士兵说，您救了那对情侣，埃里乌斯和艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I think I have heard of their names. I have heard that they irritate the minds of lonely soldiers with their endless public display of affection.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我想我听说过他们的名字。听说他们无休止的公开示爱行为，让那些孤独的士兵们感到心烦。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Everyone in Prontera must know about it. Anyways, thank you for doing this for the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
普隆德拉的人肯定都知道这件事。总之，感谢您为卫兵们做了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
由于目前局势艰难，我们无法提供太丰厚的奖励，但这是卫兵们为您准备的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我会把那些由于情况特殊，未能派遣士兵前往的地方标记在地图上。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Don't stand there in the middle of our line! Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
别站在我们队伍中间！小心点！

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
If you are hurt step back to get yourself cured. If you are recovered, get back in the line.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
如果你受伤了，就退后接受治疗。如果恢复了，就回到队伍中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Huh? I haven't seen you before. You seem like a civilian. Why are you coming from there?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
咦？我没见过你。你看起来像是平民。你为什么会从那里过来？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
What? Have the undead entered the palace already?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
什么？不死族已经攻入宫殿了吗？

scripts.text: No... I don't think so... I am just...
scripts.translation: 不...我不这么认为...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
So you are supposed to be an adventurer invited to the banquet, right?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
所以你是受邀参加宴会的冒险者，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Has there been a banquet in the palace lately? I don't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
最近宫殿里有宴会吗？我不记得了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Well... Since we are busy dealing with
the undead invading the village, as long as the palace is safe from the undead, I won't make a big deal out of it.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
嗯...既然我们正忙于应对入侵村庄的不死族，只要宫殿没有受到不死族的威胁，我就不会深究这件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I won't stop you from moving around the town. I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我不会阻止你在城镇里走动。我会把那些由于情况特殊，未能派遣士兵前往的地方标记在地图上。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... You are not an undead, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...你不是不死族，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Haha... I am alive now.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哈哈...我现在还活着。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know how scare I have been? This place was packed with the undead, and I heard screams from everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你知道我有多害怕吗？这里到处都是不死族，我还听到四面八方传来的尖叫声。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank god... The shelter is supposed to be near the village office over there. Why don't we continue this conversation there?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
谢天谢地...避难所应该就在那边的村委会附近。我们要不去那里继续聊？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Huh...? What a nerve! That guy... Save a stranger from the sea, and heùéll ask for more...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哼...？真是大胆！这家伙...从海里救了一个陌生人，还想要更多...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I wasn't going to eavesdrop. Please don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！我并没有在偷听。请别误会。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Dear adventurer. I believe that uniform is worn by the Guards of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
亲爱的冒险者。我相信那身制服是吉芬卫兵穿的。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Who is that soldier? He seems to enter the shelter so smoothly in a situation like this. He confuses me.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
那个士兵是谁？在这种局势下，他进入避难所的样子如此从容，让我感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
这里是村委会，也就是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I am saved. How fortunate. I guess I am a lucky man.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...我获救了。真幸运。看来我是个幸运的人。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Wait? Where did it go? I think I lost the Tool Bag while I was running.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
等等？它去哪了？我想我逃跑的时候把工具包弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
I can guess where it has been dropped...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
我可以猜到它掉落在哪里了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
You must be pretty tough to roam the village in a situation like this. Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
在这种局势下还能在村里四处走动，你一定很强壮。请帮我一个忙。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know where the Prontera Smelter is?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你知道普隆德拉的冶炼厂在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
It is quite a famous store in Prontera. Someday, I will...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
那是普隆德拉很有名的一家店。总有一天，我会...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! Never mind. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！算了。就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I thought I have lost it. You really found it!
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...我还以为它丢了。你真的找到了！

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This is awesome. Thank you so much. You must be busy, right? I have to go take care of something now...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
太棒了。非常感谢。你肯定很忙吧？我现在得去处理点事情...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I know you are strong enough, but please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！我知道你很强，但请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank you. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
谢谢。再见。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
In front of the Prontera Smelter
There a bag which would be full if you put some items.
scripts.translation:
普隆德拉冶炼厂前
这里有一个袋子，如果你放入一些物品，它会变得很满。

scripts.text: Pick up.
scripts.translation: 捡起

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: You have acquired a bag.
scripts.translation: 你获得了一个袋子。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
这里是村委会，也就是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear {0}... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
哦！亲爱的{0}...那条腰带？看起来像是被不死族杀害的同事的遗物。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
请把它交给我，让我安抚他可怜的灵魂。虽然因为紧急情况服务已暂停，但让我帮你骑乘{0}吧。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服务

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
明白了。那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a {0} first.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您需要先学会如何骑乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您已经在骑乘{0}了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
你需要松开缰绳才能骑乘{0}。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
这里是村委会，也就是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh, dear Mechanic! That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
哦，亲爱的机匠！那条腰带？看起来像是被不死族杀害的同事的遗物。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you borrow a Cart or ride a Magical Gear.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
请把它交给我，让我安抚他可怜的灵魂吧。虽然因为紧急情况服务已经停止，但我可以帮你租用手推车，或者骑乘魔导装甲。

scripts.text: Borrow a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Ride a Magical Gear
scripts.translation: 骑乘魔导装甲

scripts.text: Do not use it.
scripts.translation: 不使用

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You are already using a Cart.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
您已经在骑乘手推车了。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You cannot ride another magical gear since you are already riding one.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
您已经在骑乘魔导装甲了，无法再骑乘另一辆。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Go get a license to ride a magical gear first.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
请先去办理骑乘魔导装甲的许可证。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
噢...是吗。我知道了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: Hey dear, are you OK?
scripts.translation: 嘿，亲爱的，你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
I was running to the church with my sister, Rosa... And I lost her... Awww...
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
我正和姐姐罗莎跑向教堂...然后我弄丢她了...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa should have held on to my hand tightly. How clumsy of her to be lost!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
罗莎应该紧紧抓住我的手的。她怎么这么笨，居然走丢了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Would you take me to the cathedral?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
你能带我去大教堂吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
We promised to meet at the cathedral when we are lost. I believe she would be there in the church.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
我们约定好走散时在大教堂见面。我相信她会在教堂里。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
噢？你能看见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Please take care of Lowen. She is like a mascot to us in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
请照顾好洛温。她对我们普隆德拉来说就像吉祥物一样。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Ellie is really fragile. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
艾莉真的很虚弱。希望她没事。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, my... Ellie is in a critical condition. I hope a priest comes out to help her if there is one in there.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
噢，天哪...艾莉的情况很危急。希望里面有牧师能出来救救她。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you for your effort. We will devote our lives to protect the cathedral from the undead coming this way.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
谢谢你的努力。我们将献出生命，保护大教堂免受涌来的不死族侵害。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
This the cathedral which is the first shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
这里是普隆德拉的第一个避难所——大教堂。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
That belt... It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead. Would you mind giving it to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
那条腰带...看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事的。你介意把它交给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
I know it is an emergency, but I'd like to comfort the soul of my colleague.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
我知道情况紧急，但我想安抚我同事的亡魂。

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Do not give it him.
scripts.translation: 不给他

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, I see. Please bring them to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
噢，我明白了。如果你改变主意，请把它带给我。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
噢，你是在哪里弄丢那条腰带的？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you. I guess the dead may rest in peace now. This is the only thing that I can offer you... However...
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
谢谢。我想逝者终于可以安息了。这是我唯一能给你的...不过...

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
If you find more articles left by the soldiers, would you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
如果你发现更多士兵留下的遗物，请带给我好吗？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear crusader!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢！亲爱的十字军！
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear paladin!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢！亲爱的圣殿十字军！
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me call Pecopeco for you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
请把它交给我，让我安抚他可怜的亡魂吧。虽然因为紧急情况服务暂停了，但我可以为你呼叫大嘴鸟。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服务

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢...真是的。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear crusader
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
亲爱的十字军
噢！你是在哪里弄丢那条腰带的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear paladin
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
亲爱的圣殿十字军
噢！你是在哪里弄丢那条腰带的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢！你是在哪里弄丢那条腰带的？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... I guess you should learn how to ride a Pecopeco first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢...我想你应该先学会怎么骑大嘴鸟。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You are already using the Pecopeco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
你已经在骑大嘴鸟了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride it.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
你需要松开缰绳才能骑上去。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的遗物，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh, I am an uncle now...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
噢，我现在是个叔叔了...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
If you are here to borrow a PecoPeco, I have to say I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
如果您是想借大嘴鸟，我很抱歉，恐怕不行。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Due to the emergency situation, all troops of Prontera are deployed to protect the residents of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
由于紧急情况，普隆德拉的所有部队都已部署，以保护普隆德拉的居民。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Whoa, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
哇，太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa! Rosa!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
萝莎！萝莎！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh, Uncle Peco, did you see my sister here?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
噢，大嘴鸟叔叔，你看到我的姐姐了吗？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Cough... Uncle...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
咳...叔叔...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You mean Rosa? Do you mean Rosa? I haven't seen Rosa here. Wasn't she coming with you?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
你是说萝莎？你是说萝莎吗？我没在这里见到萝莎。她不是和你一起来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Aww... Rosa, where are you now?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
唉...萝莎，你现在在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
She could have gone to the Knights' building. Weren't you sisters supposed to go to the shelter there?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
她可能去了骑士团的大楼。你们姐妹不是应该去那里的避难所吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Eh? It must have not been the cathedral then... Huh? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
咦？那就不是大教堂了...啊？我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear adventurer, if you are not in a hurry, would you help Lowen flee to the Knights' building?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
亲爱的冒险者，如果您不赶时间，能帮洛温逃往骑士团的大楼吗？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Lowen's sister is a careful girl, unlike Lowen. She must have fled to the Knights' building.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
洛温的姐姐是个细心的女孩，不像洛温。她一定已经逃往骑士团的大楼了。

scripts.text: Since I am here already, let me keep helping her.
scripts.translation: 既然我已经在这里了，就让我继续帮她吧。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. Please take care of her.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
谢谢你。请照顾好她。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
噢？你能看见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
This the knight's building which is the second shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
这里是骑士团的大楼，是普隆德拉的第二避难所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
Are you the one who has helped Sister Erinin? What a relief that we have someone like you?
scripts.translation:
[骑士 格雷]
你是帮助了艾琳姐姐的人吗？有你在真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
With the honor of the knight, I'll protect the villagers inside.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 格雷]
以骑士的荣誉，我会保护里面的村民。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
Are you here to hire a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
您是来雇佣佣兵的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry, but all mercenaries dispatched in this area have been hired by the palace.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
很抱歉，这个区域的所有佣兵都已被宫殿征召。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Lowen, where did you go this time?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
洛温，你这次又跑到哪里去了？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Hehe... Thank you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
嘿嘿... 谢谢你，亲爱的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Oh! Dear adventurer, thank you. She is so handful, you know.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
哦！亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你。这孩子总是让人操心。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
She is so delicate, but she is reckless. I am worried about her.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
她虽然很娇弱，但做事却总是鲁莽。我很担心她。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Well, we shall go hide in there so that the knights here don't need to worry about us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
好了，我们进去躲起来吧，这样这里的骑士们就不用再为我们担心了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Thank you. Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
谢谢。再见！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
噢？你能看见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Dear adventurer, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
亲爱的冒险者，你看得见我吗？奇怪，我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh! The undead! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊！亡灵！来吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, what would be the use of telling them to bring it on when you are hiding in there...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你自己都躲在这里，喊他们“来吧”有什么用...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You adventurer don't understand it. I am pushed to this corner after a long battle against the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你不懂，冒险者。在与亡灵激战许久之后，我被逼到了这个角落。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be quite courageous for walking around the town in a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
在这种局势下还能在镇上走动，你一定很勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be as brave as I am... The hero who has subjugated the Kobolds in Geffen...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你一定和我一样勇敢... 在吉芬降服了刺锤犬妖的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahahahaha
Just in time. I was getting exhausted by the attacks of the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈哈哈哈
来得正好。我已经被亡灵的袭击弄得精疲力竭了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I am on the way to go hide in the shelter nearby. Would you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我正打算去附近的避难所躲起来。你愿意跟我一起吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, sure.

[Soldier]
Good. Since I am tired from the previous battle, please escort me to the Knight's building.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
很好。既然我之前的战斗已经让我累了，请护送我去骑士团的大楼。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得见我吗？奇怪，我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god, you heard my voice.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
谢天谢地，你听到了我的声音。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I was going to help the knights defending the knight's building since I heard that many residents had been fled there. However, there seem to be enough troops here.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我本来想去帮助守卫骑士团大楼的骑士们，因为我听说很多居民都逃到了那里。不过，这里的兵力似乎已经足够了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If I show my face, it may just disturb their concentration. I'd rather go without seeing them.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果我露出脸来，可能会打扰到他们的注意力。我宁愿就这样不见面地离开。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I shall go join the defense on another place. I guess I can join the troops at the village office down there.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我要去别的地方支援防御了。我想去下面那个村庄办公室，加入那里的部队。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Since I want to save my energy for the battle, please escort me to the village office.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
为了在战斗中保留体力，请护送我去村庄办公室。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得见我吗？奇怪，我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
There are not many people guarding this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
这里守卫的人不多。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I should go help them now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我现在应该去帮助他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is such a secluded place, and there are 3 soldiers here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里很偏僻，而且有3名士兵。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Dear adventurer, you know nothing.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
亲爱的冒险者，你一无所知。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Oh, I wasn't going to tell you this story, because I didn't want to boast...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
噢，我本来不想告诉你这件事的，因为我不想炫耀...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Millions of Kobolds have invaded Geffen before.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
以前曾有数百万只刺锤犬妖入侵吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless march of the Kobolds...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刺锤犬妖无尽的行军...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh... Thinking about it makes me sweat...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
呼...想想就让我冷汗直流...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Well,, from my experience, a place like this is the toughest to guard when the enemies march in out of blue.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯，根据我的经验，当敌人突然来袭时，像这样的地方是最难防守的。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It is a secret that it is the greatest timing for the rise of a hero.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
这是一个秘密，这正是英雄崛起的最佳时机。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll take a rest inside, and come out to save these people when this place is in danger. You shall go save another place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我会在里面休息，当这里陷入危险时再出来拯救这些人。你去拯救其他地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得见我吗？奇怪，我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Are you an adventurer?
Oh, Odin... Thank you! Dear adventurer, please find my wife.
scripts.translation:
[埃里乌斯]
你是冒险者吗？
噢，奥丁...谢谢你！亲爱的冒险者，请帮我找到我的妻子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
It happened in the evening, at dusk.
With a roaring sound, we heard that something dropped near the old swordsmen's guild.
scripts.translation:
[埃里乌斯]
那是傍晚，黄昏时分。
伴随着轰鸣声，我们听到有什么东西掉落在老剑士公会附近。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Many residents gathered around the area to find out what had caused such a commotion.
scripts.translation:
[埃里乌斯]
许多居民聚集在那片区域，想弄清楚是什么引起了这么大的骚动。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
I went down there with my wife Ellie.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Welcome to Prontera
in the heart of Rune-Midgarts!
Prontera is located
in the center of the continent,
and it is famous as the busy city
of commerce and trade.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩·米德加兹王国首都 普隆德拉]
欢迎来到卢恩·米德加兹心脏地带的普隆德拉！
普隆德拉位于大陆中心，
以繁忙的商业和贸易城市而闻名。

[卢恩·米德加兹王国首都 普隆德拉]
这里有主要建筑，包括可以进行十字军转职的普隆德拉宫殿；
可以进行服事、牧师转职并举行婚礼仪式的普隆德拉大教堂；
以及骑士团建筑等。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
There are many people and stores
as well so make sure to look around.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩·米德加兹王国首都 普隆德拉]
这里有许多人和商店，
请务必四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Also, in the south east of the central fountain,
there is the historic Quadro Blacksmith's Workshop.
Drop by the place if you want to get
your equipment
repaired.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩·米德加兹王国首都 普隆德拉]
此外，在中央喷泉的东南方，
有历史悠久的夸德罗铁匠铺。
如果你想修理装备，
不妨去那里看看。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
There is Izlude in the south east, Payon in the south, Geffen in the west and Al De Baran in the north.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩·米德加兹王国首都 普隆德拉]
东南方是依斯鲁得岛，南方是斐扬，西方是吉芬，北方是艾尔帕兰。
